body.translated_text:
1.01.001 <s>Vṛddhi</s> (strengthened vowel grade) consists of [the sounds denoted by] <s>āṬ</s> and <s>aiC</s> (ā, ai, au)
1.01.002 [The sounds denoted by] <s>aṬ</s> and <s>eṄ</s> (a, e, o) are [called] <s>Guṇa</s> (vowel grade)
1.01.003 <s>Guṇa</s> and <s>Vṛddhi</s> are [substitutes] of [the vowels denoted by] <s>iK</s> (i, u, ṛ, ḷ)
1.01.004 Not when the root is elided before an <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> (secondary verbal) suffix
1.01.005 And when [the suffix is marked with] <s>K</s>, <s>Ṅ</s>, or <s>I</s> as <s>IT</s> (indicatory marker)
1.01.006 [Also applies to the roots] <s>dīdhī</s> and <s>vevī</s> before [suffixes of the] <s>iṬ</s> [group]
1.01.007 Consecutive sounds among <s>haL</s> (consonants) [form] a <s>saṃyoga</s> (consonant cluster)
1.01.008 A sound articulated through both mouth and nose is [called] <s>anunāsika</s> (nasalized)

1.03.036 [After the prefix] <s>ni</s>, [the root] <s>yam</s> [takes ātmanepada in the senses of] honoring (<s>sammānana</s>), abandoning (<s>utsañjana</s>), teaching (<s>ācāryakaraṇa</s>), knowing (<s>jñāna</s>), hiring (<s>bhṛti</s>), disregarding (<s>vigaṇana</s>), and spending (<s>vyaya</s>)

1.03.038 [The root] <s>kram</s> (to stride) [takes ātmanepada in the senses of] livelihood (<s>vṛtti</s>), emission (<s>sarga</s>), and passing over (<s>tātyāna</s>)
1.03.039 [And kram takes ātmanepada] after [the prefixes] <s>upa</s> and <s>parā</s>
1.03.040 [After the prefix] <s>āṅ</s>, [the root takes ātmanepada when meaning] rising (<s>udgamana</s>)

1.03.042 [After the prefixes] <s>pra</s> and <s>upa</s> when both are meaningfully connected
1.03.043 Optionally without a prefix (<s>an-upasarga</s>)
1.03.044 [The root] <s>jñā</s> (to know) [takes ātmanepada when meaning] denial (<s>apahnava</s>)
1.03.045 And [jñā takes ātmanepada] when intransitive
1.03.046 [After the prefixes] <s>sam</s> and <s>prati</s>, [the root takes ātmanepada] when not [meaning] meditation (<s>ādhyāna</s>)
1.03.047 [The root] <s>vad</s> (to speak) [takes ātmanepada in the senses of] shining (<s>bhāsana</s>), conversing (<s>upasambhāṣā</s>), knowing (<s>jñāna</s>), striving (<s>yatna</s>), differing in opinion (<s>vimati</s>), and counseling (<s>upamantraṇa</s>)
1.03.048 [And vad takes ātmanepada when used] for the pronunciation of articulate [speech]
1.03.049 [After the prefix] <s>anu</s>, [vad takes ātmanepada] when intransitive
1.03.050 Optionally [after the prefixes] <s>vi</s> and <s>pra</s> when meaning contradiction (<s>lāpa</s>)
1.03.051 [After the prefix] <s>ava</s>, [the root] <s>gṝ</s> (to swallow) [takes ātmanepada]
1.03.052 [After the prefix] <s>sam</s>, [gṝ takes ātmanepada when meaning] promising (<s>pratijñāna</s>)
1.03.053 [After the prefix] <s>ud</s>, [the root] <s>car</s> (to move) [takes ātmanepada when] transitive (<s>sa-karmaka</s>)
1.03.054 [After the prefix] <s>sam</s>, [a root takes ātmanepada when] accompanied by a word in the instrumental (third case)
1.03.055 And [the root] <s>dāṆ</s> (to give) [takes ātmanepada after sam] when [the giving] has the sense of the dative (fourth case)
1.03.056 [After the prefix] <s>upa</s>, [the root] <s>yam</s> (to restrain) [takes ātmanepada when meaning] doing by oneself (<s>sva-karaṇa</s>)
1.03.057 [The roots] <s>jñā</s> (to know), <s>śru</s> (to hear), <s>smṛ</s> (to remember), and <s>dṛś</s> (to see) [take ātmanepada] with the <s>saN</s> (desiderative) suffix
1.03.058 Not [for the root] <s>jñā</s> [after the prefix] <s>anu</s>
1.03.059 [After the prefixes] <s>prati</s> and <s>āṅ</s>, [the root] <s>śru</s> (to hear) [takes ātmanepada]
1.03.060 [The root] <s>śad</s> (to fall) [takes ātmanepada] when [its suffix] has <s>Ś</s> as IT
1.03.061 [The root] <s>mṛ</s> (to die) [takes ātmanepada] in <s>lUṄ</s> (aorist) and <s>lIṄ</s> (optative) also
1.03.062 [The previous rules apply] similarly to [roots with] <s>saN</s> (desiderative)
1.03.063 [The root] <s>kṛ</s> (to do) when used as an auxiliary [takes ātmanepada] like [a form with] the <s>ām</s> suffix
1.03.064 [After the prefixes] <s>pra</s> and <s>upa</s>, [the root] <s>yuj</s> (to join) [takes ātmanepada] except in sacrificial vessel [contexts]
1.03.065 [After the prefix] <s>sam</s>, [the root] <s>kṣṇu</s> (to sharpen) [takes ātmanepada]
1.03.066 [The root] <s>bhuj</s> (to enjoy) [takes ātmanepada] when not [meaning] protecting (<s>avana</s>)
1.03.067 When a causal agent (<s>Ṇ</s>) [is used], the object of the non-causal [form] becomes the agent [in the causal], when not [in the sense of] meditation
1.03.068 [The roots] <s>bhī</s> (to fear) and <s>smi</s> (to smile) [take ātmanepada] when the fear has a cause (<s>hetu-bhaya</s>)
1.03.069 [The roots] <s>gṛdh</s> (to covet) and <s>vañc</s> (to deceive) [take ātmanepada when meaning] cheating (<s>pralambhana</s>)
1.03.070 [The root] <s>lī</s> (to cling) [takes ātmanepada when meaning] honoring (<s>sammānana</s>) and making beautiful (<s>śālinī-karaṇa</s>)
1.03.071 [The root] <s>kṛ</s> (to do) [takes ātmanepada] with <s>mithyā</s> (falsely) as <s>upapada</s> in repetitive [action] (<s>abhyāsa</s>)
1.03.072 [A root marked with] <s>svarita</s> (circumflex) or <s>Ñ</s> as IT [takes ātmanepada when the] agent intends [the result of the] action for himself
1.03.073 [After the prefix] <s>apa</s>, [the root] <s>vad</s> (to speak) [takes ātmanepada]
1.03.074 And [ātmanepada is used for roots in] the <s>Ṇic</s> (causative) [formation]
1.03.075 [After the prefixes] <s>sam</s>, <s>ud</s>, and <s>āṅ</s>, [the root] <s>am</s> [takes ātmanepada] not in the context of a text (<s>grantha</s>)
1.03.076 Without a prefix, [the root] <s>jñā</s> (to know) [takes ātmanepada]
1.03.077 Optionally when [the meaning] is understood from the accompanying word (<s>upapada</s>)
1.03.078 In the remaining [cases, a root takes] <s>parasmaipada</s> (active voice) for the agent
1.03.079 [After the prefixes] <s>anu</s> and <s>parā</s>, [the root] <s>kṛ</s> (to do) [takes parasmaipada]
1.03.080 [After the prefixes] <s>abhi</s>, <s>prati</s>, and <s>ati</s>, [the root] <s>kṣip</s> (to throw) [takes parasmaipada]
1.03.081 [After the prefix] <s>pra</s>, [the root] <s>vah</s> (to carry) [takes parasmaipada]
1.03.082 [After the prefix] <s>pari</s>, [the root] <s>mṛṣ</s> (to endure) [takes parasmaipada]
1.03.083 [After the prefixes] <s>vi</s>, <s>āṅ</s>, and <s>pari</s>, [the root] <s>ram</s> (to delight) [takes parasmaipada]
1.03.084 And [after the prefix] <s>upa</s>
1.03.085 Optionally when intransitive (<s>akarmaka</s>)
1.03.086 [After the roots] <s>budh</s> (to know), <s>yudh</s> (to fight), <s>naś</s> (to perish), <s>jan</s> (to be born), <s>iṅ</s> (to go), <s>pru</s> (to go), <s>dru</s> (to run), and <s>sru</s> (to flow), [the suffix] <s>Ṇe</s> (causal) [takes parasmaipada]
1.03.087 [Also roots meaning] swallowing (<s>nigaraṇa</s>) and moving (<s>calana</s>)
1.03.088 [The causal <s>Ṇi</s> takes parasmaipada when the original root is] intransitive with a sentient agent
1.03.089 Not [for the roots] <s>pā</s> (to drink), <s>dam</s> (to tame), <s>āṅ-yam</s> (to restrain), <s>āṅ-yas</s> (to strive), <s>pari-muh</s> (to be bewildered), <s>ruc</s> (to shine), <s>nṛt</s> (to dance), <s>vad</s> (to speak), and <s>vas</s> (to dwell)
1.03.090 Optionally [for the suffix] <s>KyaṢ</s>
1.03.091 [After the roots of the] <s>dyut</s> [class, parasmaipada is used] in <s>lUṄ</s> (aorist)
1.03.092 [After the roots of the] <s>vṛt</s> [class] before <s>sya</s> (future) and <s>saN</s> (desiderative) [suffixes]
1.03.093 And in <s>lUṬ</s> (periphrastic future) also, [for the root] <s>kḷp</s> (to be fit)
1.04.001 Up to [the rule about] <s>kaḍāra</s>, only one technical term (<s>saṃjñā</s>) [applies to any given element]
1.04.002 In a conflict [between two applicable rules], the later rule prevails
1.04.003 Feminine [stems] ending in long <s>ī</s> or <s>ū</s> are [called] <s>nadī</s>
1.04.004 Not [when the <s>ī</s> or <s>ū</s> is] a substitute for <s>iyaṄ</s> or <s>uvaṄ</s>, or non-feminine
1.04.005 Optionally [nadī designation applies to feminine stems] before <s>āmi</s>
1.04.006 [A stem ending in] short [<s>i</s> or <s>u</s>] marked with <s>Ṅ</s> as IT [is also nadī]
1.04.007 The remaining [feminine stems are called] <s>GHI</s>, except <s>sakhi</s> (friend)
1.04.008 <s>pati</s> (husband/lord) [is GHI] only in a compound (<s>samāsa</s>)
1.04.009 [A stem] joined with the genitive (sixth case) [is also GHI] optionally in Vedic [usage]
1.04.010 A short [vowel] is [called] <s>laghu</s> (light syllable)
1.04.011 [A short vowel followed by] a conjunct consonant (<s>saṃyoga</s>) is [called] <s>guru</s> (heavy syllable)
1.04.012 And a long [vowel is also guru]
1.04.013 [The base] beginning with that [element] from which a suffix is prescribed is [called the] <s>aṅga</s> (stem) before that suffix
1.04.014 [A word] ending in a <s>sUP</s> (nominal case ending) or <s>tiṄ</s> (verbal personal ending) is [called a] <s>pada</s> (word)
1.04.015 [The final] <s>n</s> [of a stem is termed pada] before [the suffix] <s>Kya</s>
1.04.016 And before [a suffix] marked with <s>S</s> as IT
1.04.017 And before suffixes beginning with <s>s</s>, not in the <s>sarvanāmasthāna</s>
1.04.018 Before [a suffix beginning with] <s>y</s> or a vowel (<s>aC</s>), [the stem is called] <s>BHA</s>
1.04.019 [The suffixes] <s>ta</s> and <s>sau</s> [are treated as sārvadhātuka] in the sense of <s>matU</s> (possessive)
1.04.020 <s>ayasmaya</s> and similar [words are termed BHA] in Vedic [usage]
1.04.021 [The case endings denoting] the many [are called] <s>bahuvacana</s> (plural)
1.04.022 [The case endings denoting] two and one [are called] <s>dvivacana</s> (dual) and <s>ekavacana</s> (singular) [respectively]
1.04.023 [These terms apply] in <s>kāraka</s> (case relations)
1.04.024 A fixed point from which departure [occurs] is [called] <s>apādāna</s> (ablative relation)
1.04.025 The cause of fear for [one who] fears (<s>bhī</s>) or is anxious (<s>trā</s>) [is also apādāna]
1.04.026 [The apādāna is that from which one] is defeated (<s>a-soḍha</s>) [in relation to the roots] <s>parā</s> and <s>ji</s> (to conquer)
1.04.027 The desired [object from which one is] prevented (<s>vāraṇa</s>) [is apādāna]
1.04.028 In concealment (<s>antardhā</s>), [the apādāna is the person] from whom one wishes non-perception
1.04.029 [The apādāna is the person to whom something is] reported (<s>ākhyāta</s>) or made useful (<s>upayoga</s>)
1.04.030 The material cause (<s>prakṛti</s>) of the one born [is apādāna]
1.04.031 The source (<s>prabhava</s>) [is apādāna for the root] <s>bhū</s> (to be/originate)
1.04.032 The [person] whom the agent approaches with the object [is called] <s>sampradāna</s> (dative relation)
1.04.033 The one who is pleased [is sampradāna for verbs meaning] liking (<s>ruci</s>)
1.04.034 The one whom one wishes to know [is sampradāna for the roots] <s>ślāgh</s> (to praise), <s>hnuṅ</s> (to conceal), <s>sthā</s> (to stand firm), and <s>śap</s> (to curse)
1.04.035 The creditor (<s>uttamarṇa</s>) [is sampradāna for the root] <s>dhṛ</s> (to owe)
1.04.036 The desired [object is sampradāna for the root] <s>spṛh</s> (to desire)
1.04.037 [The sampradāna applies] for [the roots] <s>krudh</s> (to be angry), <s>druh</s> (to be hostile), <s>īrṣy</s> (to envy), and <s>asūy</s> (to be displeased)
1.04.038 [However, after the roots] <s>krudh</s> and <s>druh</s>, when [used] with a prefix, [the person is treated as] <s>karman</s> (object)
1.04.039 [The sampradāna is the person] about whom there is inquiry [for the roots] <s>rādh</s> (to succeed) and <s>īkṣ</s> (to see)
1.04.040 [After the prefixes] <s>prati</s> and <s>āṅ</s>, for [the root] <s>śru</s> (to hear), the agent of the prior [action is sampradāna]
1.04.041 And for [the roots] <s>anu-gṝ</s> (to recite after) and <s>prati-gṝ</s> (to recite in response)
1.04.042 The most effective means [is called] <s>karaṇa</s> (instrumental relation)
1.04.043 [For the root] <s>div</s> (to play), [the karaṇa is] also [treated as] <s>karman</s> (object)
1.04.044 In buying (<s>parikrayaṇa</s>), [the price is treated as] <s>sampradāna</s> (dative), optionally
1.04.045 The locus (<s>ādhāra</s>) [is called] <s>adhikaraṇa</s> (locative relation)
1.04.046 [After the prefix] <s>adhi</s>, for [the roots] <s>śīṅ</s> (to lie), <s>sthā</s> (to stand), and <s>ās</s> (to sit), [the adhikaraṇa is treated as] <s>karman</s> (object)
1.04.047 And for [the root] <s>viś</s> (to enter) [after the prefixes] <s>abhi</s> and <s>ni</s>
1.04.048 And for [the roots after the prefixes] <s>upa</s>, <s>anu</s>, <s>adhi</s>, and <s>āṅ</s> with <s>as</s> (to be)
1.04.049 The most desired [thing] of the agent is [called] <s>karman</s> (object)
1.04.050 And that which is similarly connected [with the action] even if not desired [is also karman]
1.04.051 And that which is not [otherwise] stated [by the other kāraka relations is also karman]
1.04.052 For intransitive roots [denoting] motion (<s>gati</s>), cognition (<s>buddhi</s>), consumption (<s>pratyavasāna</s>), verbal expression (<s>śabda-karma</s>), the agent [of the base verb] becomes [the object] in the <s>Ṇi</s> (causative)
1.04.053 [For the roots] <s>hṛ</s> (to take) and <s>kṛ</s> (to do), optionally
1.04.054 An independent [agent] is [called] <s>kartṛ</s> (agent)
1.04.055 And the one who causes [the agent to act] is [called the] <s>hetu</s> (instigator/causal agent)
1.04.056 [The particles] up to [but not including] <s>īśvara</s> [in the list are called] <s>nipāta</s> (indeclinable particles)
1.04.057 <s>ca</s> (and) and the others [in the list are nipātas when they do] not [denote a] substance (<s>sattva</s>)
1.04.058 <s>pra</s> and the others [in the list are also nipātas]
1.04.059 [These same particles are called] <s>upasarga</s> (verbal prefixes) when connected with a verb (<s>kriyā-yoga</s>)
1.04.060 And [they function as] <s>gati</s> (verbal complement) [in certain contexts]
1.04.061 And <s>ūrī</s> and similar [words], <s>Cvi</s>-derivatives, and <s>ḌāC</s>-derivatives [are also gati]
1.04.062 And an onomatopoeia (<s>anukaraṇa</s>) not followed by <s>iti</s> [is also gati]
1.04.063 <s>sat</s> and <s>asat</s> [are gati when used] in [the senses of] respect (<s>ādara</s>) and disrespect (<s>an-ādara</s>)
1.04.064 <s>alam</s> [is gati when meaning] adornment (<s>bhūṣaṇa</s>)
1.04.065 <s>antar</s> (within) [is gati when] not [meaning] inclusion (<s>parigraha</s>)
1.04.066 <s>kaṇe</s> and <s>manas</s> (mind) [are gati when used in the senses of] faith (<s>śraddhā</s>) and opposition (<s>pratīghāta</s>)
1.04.067 <s>puras</s> (before) is an <s>avyaya</s> (indeclinable) [and also a gati]
1.04.068 And <s>astam</s> (to the setting)
1.04.069 <s>accha</s> (towards) [is gati when used with roots of] going (<s>gati</s>), purpose (<s>artha</s>), and speaking (<s>vada</s>)
1.04.070 <s>adaḥ</s> (that) [is gati when] not [used in] instruction (<s>upadeśa</s>)
1.04.071 <s>tiras</s> (across/hidden) [is gati when meaning] concealment (<s>antardhā</s>)
1.04.072 Optionally [tiras is gati before the root] <s>kṛ</s> (to do)
1.04.073 <s>upāja</s> (driving towards) and <s>anvāja</s> (driving along) [are gati]
1.04.074 <s>sākṣāt</s> (directly) and the others [in the list are also gati]
1.04.075 <s>urasi</s> (on the chest) and <s>manasi</s> (in the mind) [are gati] when not [meaning] placing upon (<s>atyādhāna</s>)
1.04.076 And <s>madhye</s> (in the middle), <s>pade</s> (at the step), and <s>nivacana</s> (reproof) [are also gati]
1.04.077 <s>haste</s> and <s>pāṇau</s> (in the hand) are invariably [gati when meaning] marrying (<s>upayamana</s>)
1.04.078 <s>prādhvam</s> (along the road) [is gati when meaning] binding (<s>bandhana</s>)
1.04.079 <s>jīvikā</s> (livelihood) and <s>upaniṣad</s> (secret teaching) [are gati when used in] comparison (<s>aupamya</s>)
1.04.080 These [gatis stand] before the verbal root (<s>dhātu</s>)
1.04.081 In Vedic [usage], they may also [stand] after [the verb]
1.04.082 And [they may be] separated [from the verb in Vedic usage]
1.04.083 [Certain particles function as] <s>karma-pravacanīya</s> (case-governing particles)
1.04.084 <s>anu</s> [is karma-pravacanīya when denoting] a characteristic mark (<s>lakṣaṇa</s>)
1.04.085 [And anu is karma-pravacanīya when used] in the sense of the instrumental (third case)
1.04.086 [And anu is karma-pravacanīya when meaning] inferiority (<s>hīna</s>)
1.04.087 <s>upa</s> [is karma-pravacanīya when meaning] excess (<s>adhika</s>), and also [hīna]
1.04.088 <s>apa</s> and <s>pari</s> [are karma-pravacanīya when meaning] exclusion (<s>varjana</s>)
1.04.089 <s>āṅ</s> [is karma-pravacanīya] in [expressions denoting] a limit (<s>maryādā</s>)
1.04.090 <s>prati</s>, <s>pari</s>, and <s>anu</s> [are karma-pravacanīya] in [the senses of] indication (<s>lakṣaṇa</s>), 'being such' (<s>ittham-bhūta</s>), declaration (<s>ākhyāna</s>), distribution (<s>bhāga</s>), and repetition (<s>vīpsā</s>)
1.04.091 <s>abhi</s> [is karma-pravacanīya when] not [meaning] a portion (<s>bhāga</s>)
1.04.092 <s>prati</s> [is karma-pravacanīya in the senses of] substitution (<s>pratinidhi</s>) and exchange (<s>pratidāna</s>)
1.04.093 <s>adhi</s> and <s>pari</s> [are karma-pravacanīya though] meaningless [in certain usages]
1.04.094 <s>su</s> [is karma-pravacanīya when meaning] honor (<s>pūjā</s>)
1.04.095 <s>ati</s> [is karma-pravacanīya when meaning] surpassing (<s>atikramaṇa</s>), and also [pūjā]
1.04.096 <s>api</s> [is karma-pravacanīya in the senses of] connection with a matter (<s>padārtha-sambhāvana</s>), permission (<s>anvavasarga</s>), reproach (<s>garhā</s>), and aggregation (<s>samuccaya</s>)
1.04.097 <s>adhi</s> [is karma-pravacanīya when meaning] sovereignty (<s>īśvara</s>)
1.04.098 Optionally [adhi is karma-pravacanīya before the root] <s>kṛ</s> (to do)
1.04.099 <s>laḥ</s> (the ten <s>lakāras</s>) [denote] <s>parasmaipada</s> (active voice endings)
1.04.100 <s>taṄ</s> and <s>āmau</s> [are the] <s>ātmanepada</s> (middle voice endings)
1.04.101 The <s>tiṄ</s> (personal endings) [are divided into] three groups of three: <s>prathama</s> (third person), <s>madhyama</s> (second person), and <s>uttama</s> (first person)
1.04.102 Those [groups denote] <s>ekavacana</s> (singular), <s>dvivacana</s> (dual), and <s>bahuvacana</s> (plural) individually
1.04.103 Similarly [the seven endings] of <s>sUP</s> (nominal case endings) [are divided into groups of three]
1.04.104 And [each group of sUP is called a] <s>vibhakti</s> (case)
1.04.105 When <s>yuṣmad</s> (you) is the correlative word, in co-reference, even when a substitute [form is present], [the verbal ending is] <s>madhyama</s> (second person)
1.04.106 In jest (<s>prahāsa</s>), when <s>manya</s> (think) is the correlative and [the root is] <s>man</s> (to think), [the ending is] <s>uttama</s> (first person), and [treated as] singular
1.04.107 [When] <s>asmad</s> (I/we) [is the correlative, the ending is] <s>uttama</s> (first person)
1.04.108 In the remaining [cases, the ending is] <s>prathama</s> (third person)
1.04.109 Close proximity [of sounds] is [called] <s>saṃhitā</s> (euphonic combination/connected speech)
1.04.110 A pause (<s>virāma</s>) is [called] <s>avasāna</s> (conclusion)

body.translated_text:
2.01.001 A word-rule applies [only] to syntactically connected [words] (<s>samartha</s>)
2.01.002 A <s>sUP</s> (nominal ending) in the vocative is treated like the preceding [word] in accent
2.01.003 Up to [the rule of] <s>kaḍāra</s>, [the topic is] compound (<s>samāsa</s>)
2.01.004 Together with a <s>sUP</s> (case ending) [the compound is formed]
2.01.005 [The first type is] <s>avyayībhāva</s> (indeclinable compound)
2.01.006 An indeclinable [forms an avyayībhāva] in the senses of case-relation, proximity, prosperity, adversity, absence, passing beyond, non-currency, the word itself, manifestation, posteriority, sequence, simultaneity, similarity, fitness, totality, and limit
2.01.007 <s>yathā</s> in the sense of non-resemblance
2.01.008 <s>yāvat</s> in the sense of limitation
2.01.009 A <s>sUP</s> with <s>prati</s> and <s>nā</s> in the sense of 'measure'
2.01.010 Dice, sticks, and numbers [combine] with <s>pari</s> and <s>nā</s>
2.01.011 Optionally
2.01.012 <s>apa</s>, <s>pari</s>, <s>bahis</s>, and words ending in <s>-añc</s> [combine] with the ablative
2.01.013 <s>ā</s> in the senses of limit and extent
2.01.014 With a characteristic (<s>lakṣaṇa</s>), <s>abhi</s> and <s>prati</s> in the sense of 'facing toward'
2.01.015 <s>anu</s> with what is concurrent
2.01.016 And that of which there is extent
2.01.017 <s>tiṣṭhadgu</s> and others also [form avyayībhāva]
2.01.018 <s>pāre</s> and <s>madhye</s> optionally with the genitive
2.01.019 A numeral with a member of a lineage
2.01.020 And with rivers
2.01.021 And in a proper name when the meaning is of another word
2.01.022 [The second type of compound is] <s>tatpuruṣa</s>
2.01.023 And <s>dvigu</s> [is a type of tatpuruṣa]
2.01.024 The accusative [combines] with [words meaning] resorted to, passed beyond, fallen, gone, surpassed, reached, and obtained
2.01.025 [A word meaning] 'by oneself' with a <s>Kta</s> (past participle) suffix
2.01.026 <s>khaṭvā</s> in the sense of contempt
2.01.027 <s>sāmi</s> [combines to form tatpuruṣa]
2.01.028 Words denoting time [combine]
2.01.029 And in the sense of complete conjunction
2.01.030 The instrumental [combines] with a word formed by <s>Kta</s> suffix denoting purpose, or with a quality-word
2.01.031 With [words meaning] prior, similar, same, deficient, quarrel, skilled, mixed, and smooth
2.01.032 Agent and instrument with <s>Kṛt</s> [suffix], frequently
2.01.033 With <s>Kṛtya</s> [suffixes] when expressing excess of meaning
2.01.034 A condiment with [the word for] food
2.01.035 An ingredient for mixing with [the word for] food to be eaten
2.01.036 The dative [combines] with [words meaning] intended for that, purpose, offering, beneficial, pleasant, and protected
2.01.037 The ablative [combines] with [the word for] fear
2.01.038 With [words meaning] departed, removed, released, fallen, and frightened, slightly
2.01.039 [Words meaning] little, near, far, purpose, and difficulty with a <s>Kta</s> (past participle)
2.01.040 The locative [combines] with [words meaning] addicted
2.01.041 And with [words meaning] accomplished, dried, cooked, and bound
2.01.042 <s>dhvā</s> and <s>ṛkṣa</s> in the sense of contempt
2.01.043 With <s>kṛtya</s> [suffixes] in the sense of debt
2.01.044 In a proper name
2.01.045 Parts of day and night with a <s>Kta</s> suffix
2.01.046 <s>tatra</s> [combines]
2.01.047 In the sense of contempt
2.01.048 <s>pātre-samita</s> and others also [form compounds]
2.01.049 [Words meaning] prior, former, one, all, old, ancient, new, and sole [combine] with a word having the same case-referent
2.01.050 Direction and number words in a proper name
2.01.051 And in the sense of a <s>taddhita</s> suffix, a latter member, or a collective
2.01.052 [A compound] preceded by a numeral is <s>dvigu</s>
2.01.053 A despised [thing] with [words of] contempt
2.01.054 <s>pāpa</s> and <s>aṇaka</s> with despised [words]
2.01.055 Terms of comparison with words expressing generality

2.01.057 A qualifier with a qualified [word], frequently
2.01.058 And [words meaning] prior, subsequent, first, last, lowest, same, middle, intermediate, and hero
2.01.059 <s>śreṇi</s> and others with <s>kṛta</s> and others

2.01.062 <s>vṛndāraka</s>, <s>nāga</s>, and <s>kuñjara</s> with something honored
2.01.063 <s>katara</s> and <s>katama</s> in inquiring about species
2.01.064 <s>kim</s> in the sense of contempt

2.02.012 And with a <s>Kta</s> suffix in the sense of honor
2.02.013 And with a word denoting location
2.02.014 And in the object [relation]
2.02.015 <s>tṛC</s> and <s>aka</s> [suffixes] for the agent

2.02.017 Always in [the senses of] play and livelihood
2.02.018 <s>ku</s>, <s>gati</s>, <s>pra</s>, and other [prefixes form compounds]
2.02.019 A subordinate word (<s>upapada</s>) [combines] with a non-finite verb form (non-<s>tiṄ</s>)
2.02.020 <s>amā</s> only with an indeclinable
2.02.021 [Cases] from the third onward, optionally
2.02.022 And <s>Ktvā</s> (absolutive suffix) [combines]
2.02.023 The remainder [of compound types] is <s>bahuvrīhi</s>
2.02.024 [A compound] of more than one [word] denoting the meaning of another word
2.02.025 A numeral with an indeclinable, near, not-far, excess-number in [reference to] a countable [thing]
2.02.026 Direction-names in an interval
2.02.027 'This by that' when having the same form
2.02.028 'Together with that' in the sense of equal connection
2.02.029 In the sense of 'and,' [the compound is] <s>dvandva</s>
2.02.030 The subordinate [member comes] first
2.02.031 In <s>rāja-danta</s> and others, [the subordinate member comes] last
2.02.032 In <s>dvandva</s>, [the ending is] <s>GHI</s> (dual or plural)
2.02.033 [The member] beginning with a vowel and ending in a short [vowel comes first]
2.02.034 [The member with] fewer vowels [comes first]
2.02.035 [When] locative and qualifier [occur together] in <s>bahuvrīhi</s>
2.02.036 <s>niṣṭhā</s> (past participle suffix) [comes last]
2.02.037 Optionally in <s>āhitāgni</s> and similar [compounds]
2.02.038 [Sūtras from] <s>kaḍāra</s> [onward deal with] <s>karmadhāraya</s> [compound]
2.03.001 When [the kāraka relation is] not expressed [by another element]
2.03.002 The accusative [is used] for the object (<s>karman</s>)
2.03.003 And the instrumental optionally in Vedic [usage]
2.03.004 <s>antarā</s> and <s>antareṇa</s> [govern] an associated [word in the accusative]
2.03.005 The accusative for time and distance in complete conjunction

2.03.008 The accusative [is used] with a <s>karmapravacanīya</s> [preposition]
2.03.009 Where there is [the sense of] 'more than which' and the statement of being master, the locative [is used]
2.03.010 The ablative with <s>apa</s>, <s>ā</s>, and <s>pari</s>
2.03.011 And the ablative for substitute and recompense, from whom [given]
2.03.012 The accusative and dative for the object of a verb of motion, in activity, not on a road
2.03.013 The dative for the recipient (<s>sampradāna</s>)
2.03.014 And the accusative for the object of a word denoting an action as purpose, when the standing [word] is a subordinate
2.03.015 And from [a word with] the sense of the infinitive (<s>tum</s>), from an abstract noun
2.03.016 And with <s>namas</s>, <s>svasti</s>, <s>svāhā</s>, <s>svadhā</s>, <s>alam</s>, <s>vaṣaṭ</s>, and <s>ogāt</s>
2.03.017 Optionally the dative for the object of <s>man</s> (to think) when there is disrespect, with non-living beings
2.03.018 The instrumental for the agent and instrument
2.03.019 With [the word] <s>saha</s> (together with) for a subordinate [element]
2.03.020 [The instrumental is used] for that by which there is a change of limb
2.03.021 For a characteristic of the state 'being thus' (<s>ittham-bhūta-lakṣaṇa</s>)
2.03.022 Optionally the accusative for the object of <s>jña</s> (to know)
2.03.023 [The instrumental is used] for the cause
2.03.024 The ablative for a non-agent in [expressing] debt
2.03.025 Optionally [the ablative] for a quality, not feminine
2.03.026 The genitive in causal expression
2.03.027 And the instrumental for a pronoun
2.03.028 The ablative for the point of departure (<s>apādāna</s>)
2.03.029 [The ablative with words meaning] other, far, different, without, direction-words, words ending in <s>-añc</s>, latter member, and [words] governed by <s>ā</s> and <s>āhi</s>
2.03.030 The genitive with <s>atas</s> and a suffix denoting meaning
2.03.031 The accusative with <s>enam</s>
2.03.032 The instrumental optionally with <s>pṛthak</s>, <s>vinā</s>, <s>nānā</s>, and similar [words]
2.03.033 And the instrumental for instrument, when <s>stoka</s>, <s>alpa</s>, <s>kṛcchra</s>, and <s>katipaya</s> are not denoting an entity
2.03.034 The genitive optionally with words meaning far and near
2.03.035 And the accusative with words meaning far and near
2.03.036 The locative for the locus (<s>adhikaraṇa</s>)
2.03.037 And that whose state characterizes [another] state
2.03.038 And the genitive in [the sense of] disrespect
2.03.039 And with [words meaning] owner, lord, master, heir, witness, surety, and one who has given birth
2.03.040 And with <s>āyukta</s> and <s>kuśala</s> in the sense of devoted practice
2.03.041 And the locative or ablative in partitive [construction]
2.03.042 The ablative when separated
2.03.043 The locative with <s>sādhu</s> and <s>nipuṇa</s> in the sense of skill, not with <s>prati</s>
2.03.044 And the instrumental with <s>prasita</s> and <s>utsuka</s>
2.03.045 And [the locative] with a <s>nakṣatra</s> (constellation) name when <s>luP</s> [elision applies]
2.03.046 The nominative for mere expression of the stem-meaning, gender, measure, and number
2.03.047 And in address
2.03.048 That [vocative form] is called <s>āmantrita</s> (vocative)
2.03.049 The singular [vocative] is called <s>saṃbuddhi</s>
2.03.050 The genitive [is used] in the remaining [relations]
2.03.051 [The genitive] for the instrument of <s>jña</s> (to know) when not in the sense of <s>vid</s>
2.03.052 The accusative for the object of [verbs with] <s>adhi</s>, <s>iṄ</s>, <s>artha</s>, <s>dayā</s>, and <s>īś</s>
2.03.053 [The accusative] for [the object of] <s>kṛñ</s> in the sense of effort
2.03.054 [The dative] for words meaning pain in abstract sense, except <s>jvara</s> (fever)
2.03.055 <s>nātha</s> [takes the dative] in benediction
2.03.056 [The accusative for] <s>jāsi</s>, <s>ni</s>, <s>prahaṇ</s>, <s>nāṭa</s>, <s>krātha</s>, and <s>piṣ</s> in the sense of violence
2.03.057 [The genitive for] <s>vyavahṛ</s> and <s>paṇ</s> when having a similar meaning
2.03.058 [The accusative for] <s>div</s> (to play) when that is the purpose
2.03.059 Optionally with a prefix
2.03.060 The accusative in <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> [texts]
2.03.061 [The dative for] the deity as recipient when <s>preṣya</s> and <s>brū</s> [are used] with an oblation
2.03.062 [The dative] frequently in the sense of the dative in Vedic [texts]
2.03.063 And [the dative] for the instrument of <s>yaj</s> (to sacrifice)
2.03.064 [The accusative for] time as locus when used in the sense of <s>kṛtvas</s> (number of times)
2.03.065 The genitive [is used] for the agent and object of a <s>kṛt</s> [suffix]
2.03.066 When both [agent and object] are possible, [the genitive is used] for the object
2.03.067 And [the genitive] for [a word with] <s>Kta</s> suffix in the present [sense]
2.03.068 And for a word denoting location
2.03.069 Not for [words with] <s>la</s>, <s>u</s>, <s>uka</s>, indeclinable, <s>niṣṭhā</s>, <s>KHaL</s>, <s>artha</s>, and <s>tṛṇ</s> [suffixes]
2.03.070 [The genitive for words with] <s>aka</s> and <s>ina</s> in future [sense] and debtor [sense]
2.03.071 Optionally the genitive for the agent of <s>kṛtya</s> [suffixes]
2.03.072 The instrumental optionally with words having the same meaning as <s>tulya</s> (equal), except <s>tulā</s> and <s>upamā</s>
2.03.073 And the dative in benediction with [words meaning] long life, joy, prosperity, well-being, happiness, benefit, and welfare
2.04.001 <s>dvigu</s> [takes] singular [number]
2.04.002 And <s>dvandva</s> [takes singular] for living beings, musical instruments, armies, and hymns
2.04.003 In repetition, [the singular is used] for [Vedic] schools
2.04.004 <s>adhvaryu-kratu</s> [takes] non-neuter [gender]
2.04.005 [Names] not far separated from [their] study
2.04.006 Species-words [take singular] for non-living beings
2.04.007 A river having a distinctive gender [retains it]; a country [does], except a village
2.04.008 Small creatures [take singular in dvandva]
2.04.009 And those whose enmity is perpetual
2.04.010 Of <s>Śūdras</s> who have not performed the ritual
2.04.011 <s>gavāśva</s> and others also [take singular in dvandva]
2.04.012 Optionally [singular for dvandva of] trees, animals, grasses, grains, condiments, cattle, birds, horses and mares, and prior-posterior, lower-upper [pairs]
2.04.013 [Two rules that are] contradictory and not denoting location [are not compounded]
2.04.014 Not <s>dadhi-payas</s> and similar [compounds]
2.04.015 And [singular] for location and that much
2.04.016 Optionally [singular] in proximity
2.04.017 That [singular dvandva] is neuter
2.04.018 And <s>avyayībhāva</s> [is neuter singular]
2.04.019 <s>tatpuruṣa</s> that is not <s>naÑ</s> or <s>karmadhāraya</s>
2.04.020 In proper names, [the rule applies to] <s>kanthā</s> and <s>uśīnara</s>
2.04.021 <s>upajñā</s> and <s>upakrama</s> [take] that at the beginning when intending to declare
2.04.022 <s>chāyā</s> (shadow) in [the sense of] abundance
2.04.023 <s>sabhā</s> (assembly) [takes the gender of the latter member] when preceded by <s>rājan</s> or non-human [words]
2.04.024 And [not] <s>śālā</s> (hall)
2.04.025 Optionally [for compounds with] <s>senā</s>, <s>surā</s>, <s>chāyā</s>, <s>sālā</s>, and <s>niśā</s>
2.04.026 The gender [follows] the latter member in <s>dvandva</s> and <s>tatpuruṣa</s>
2.04.027 Like the former [member for] <s>aśva-vaḍava</s>
2.04.028 <s>hemanta-śiśirau</s> and <s>aho-rātre</s> [take dual] in Vedic [usage]
2.04.029 <s>rātra</s>, <s>ahna</s>, and <s>ahāḥ</s> are masculine
2.04.030 <s>apatha</s> is neuter
2.04.031 <s>ardharca</s> is also masculine
2.04.032 Of <s>idam</s> in anaphoric reference, <s>aŚ</s> is unaccented, beginning from the third [case]
2.04.033 Of <s>etad</s>, <s>tra</s> and <s>tas</s> [substitutes are] <s>tra</s> and <s>tas</s>, and [they are] unaccented
2.04.034 In the second [case] and <s>Ṭā</s> and <s>os</s> [cases], <s>ena</s> [is substituted]
2.04.035 Before an <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> [suffix]
2.04.036 For <s>ad</s> (to eat), <s>jagdhi</s> [is substituted] when <s>LyaP</s>, <s>ti</s>, or <s>K-IT</s> [follows]
2.04.037 In <s>lUṄ</s> and <s>saN</s>, <s>ghas</s> [is substituted]
2.04.038 And before <s>GHaÑ</s> and <s>aP</s>
2.04.039 Frequently in Vedic [texts]
2.04.040 Optionally in <s>lIṬ</s> (perfect)
2.04.041 Of <s>veÑ</s>, <s>vayi</s> [is substituted]
2.04.042 Of <s>han</s> (to kill), <s>vadha</s> [is substituted] in <s>lIṄ</s> (benedictive)
2.04.043 And in <s>lUṄ</s> (aorist)
2.04.044 Optionally in <s>ātmanepada</s> (middle voice)
2.04.045 Of <s>iṆ</s> (to go), <s>gā</s> [is substituted] in <s>lUṄ</s>
2.04.046 In <s>Ṇi</s> (causative), <s>gami</s> [is substituted for <s>gam</s>] except in the sense of understanding
2.04.047 And in <s>saN</s> (desiderative)
2.04.048 And of <s>iṄ</s>
2.04.049 <s>gāṄ</s> [is substituted] in <s>lIṬ</s> (perfect)
2.04.050 Optionally in <s>lUṄ</s> and <s>lṚṄ</s> (conditional)
2.04.051 And in <s>Ṇi</s> (causative) with <s>saN</s> and <s>CaṄ</s>
2.04.052 Of <s>as</s> (to be), <s>bhū</s> [is substituted]
2.04.053 Of <s>brū</s> (to speak), <s>vac</s> [is substituted]
2.04.054 Of <s>cakṣiṄ</s> (to see), <s>khyāÑ</s> [is substituted]
2.04.055 Optionally in <s>lIṬ</s> (perfect)
2.04.056 Of <s>aj</s> (to drive), <s>vī</s> [is substituted] except before <s>GHaÑ</s> and <s>aP</s>
2.04.057 Optionally [substitution takes place for] both
2.04.058 <s>Ṇya</s>, <s>kṣatriya</s>, <s>ārṣa</s>, and <s>Ñ-IT</s> [suffixes undergo] <s>luK</s> elision of <s>aṆ</s> and <s>iÑ</s> for a young [descendant]
2.04.059 And after <s>Paila</s> and others
2.04.060 Of <s>iÑ</s> in the eastern [region]
2.04.061 Not after <s>Taulvali</s> and others
2.04.062 Of that patronymic, when [denoting] many, by that very [suffix], not in feminine
2.04.063 [The suffix is retained] after <s>Yaska</s> and others in <s>gotra</s> (lineage)
2.04.064 And of <s>yaÑ</s> and <s>aÑ</s>
2.04.065 And after <s>Atri</s>, <s>Bhṛgu</s>, <s>Kutsa</s>, <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, <s>Gotama</s>, and <s>Aṅgiras</s>
2.04.066 Of many-voweled <s>iÑ</s> among the eastern [people] and <s>Bharatas</s>
2.04.067 Not after <s>Gopavana</s> and others
2.04.068 After <s>Tika</s>, <s>Kitava</s>, and others in <s>dvandva</s>
2.04.069 After <s>Upaka</s> and others, optionally in non-<s>dvandva</s>
2.04.070 Of <s>Āgastya</s> and <s>Kauṇḍinya</s>, <s>Agasti</s> and <s>Kuṇḍina</s> [are substituted]
2.04.071 <s>sUP</s> [is elided] for verbal roots and nominal stems
2.04.072 <s>ŚaP</s> [vikaraṇa is elided] after <s>adādi</s> (second conjugation) and others
2.04.073 Frequently in Vedic [texts]
2.04.074 And <s>yaṄ</s> [is elided] before a vowel
2.04.075 <s>Ślu</s> [elision applies] after <s>juhotyādi</s> (third conjugation) roots
2.04.076 Frequently in Vedic [texts]
2.04.077 <s>siC</s> [is elided] after <s>gā</s>, <s>sthā</s>, <s>GHU</s>, <s>pā</s>, <s>bhū</s>, and other [roots] in <s>parasmaipada</s> (active voice)
2.04.078 Optionally after <s>ghrā</s>, <s>dheṬ</s>, <s>śā</s>, <s>chā</s>, and <s>sas</s>
2.04.079 After <s>tan</s> and others, [elision applies] for <s>ta</s> and <s>thās</s> [endings]
2.04.080 In <s>mantra</s> [texts], [special substitutions apply] after <s>ghas</s>, <s>hvara</s>, <s>naś</s>, <s>vṛ</s>, <s>dah</s>, <s>āṬ</s>, <s>vṛc</s>, <s>kṛ</s>, <s>gam</s>, and <s>jan</s> in <s>lE</s> [substitution]
2.04.081 Of <s>ām</s>
2.04.082 <s>āP</s> and <s>sUP</s> [are elided] after an indeclinable
2.04.083 Not <s>aṬ</s> [after] <s>avyayībhāva</s>; but <s>am</s> [is retained] except in the ablative
2.04.084 [The elision of case endings occurs] frequently in the third and seventh [cases]
2.04.085 Of <s>lUṬ</s> (periphrastic future), [the endings] <s>Ḍā</s>, <s>rau</s>, and <s>ras</s> [replace] those of the first [person]

body.translated_text:
3.01.001 (What follows is a) <s>pratyaya</s> (affix).
3.01.002 And (it is placed) after (the base).
3.01.003 And (its) first (syllable is) <s>udātta</s> (acute-accented).
3.01.004 <s>sUP</s> and (affixes marked with) <s>P-IT</s> are <s>anudātta</s> (grave-accented).
3.01.005 After <s>gup</s> (to protect), <s>tij</s> (to be sharp), and <s>kit</s> (to cure), <s>saN</s> (is added).
3.01.006 After <s>mān</s>, <s>badhā</s>, <s>dān</s>, and <s>śān</s>, (the desiderative <s>saN</s> is added,) and the <s>abhyāsa</s> (reduplicative syllable) is lengthened.
3.01.007 Optionally, (the desiderative <s>saN</s> is added) to a <s>dhātu</s> (root) when the object (of the desiderative action) has the same agent (as the original action), in the sense of wishing.
3.01.008 <s>KyaC</s> (is added) after a <s>sUP</s> (nominal stem) in the sense of 'making oneself (like that)'.
3.01.009 And <s>kāmyaC</s> (is also added in that sense).
3.01.010 (These affixes are added) after a word denoting comparison, in the sense of behaving (like the referent).
3.01.011 <s>KyaṄ</s> (is added when the agent is expressed), and there is deletion of <s>sā</s>.
3.01.012 After words beginning with <s>bhṛśa</s> (intensely), in the sense of 'becoming' (but not from <s>Cvi</s> derivatives), there is also deletion of the <s>haL</s> (final consonant).
3.01.013 <s>KyaṢ</s> (is added) after words beginning with <s>lohita</s> (red) and after <s>ḌāC</s>-derivatives.
3.01.014 <s>kaṣṭāya</s> (is formed with <s>KyaC</s>) in the sense of difficult movement.
3.01.015 (The affix <s>KyaṢ</s> is used) when the object is from <s>romantha</s> (rumination) or <s>tapas</s> (penance), with the verbs <s>vṛt</s> (to exist) and <s>car</s> (to move).
3.01.016 (The affix <s>KyaṢ</s> is used) with <s>bāṣpa</s> (tears) and <s>ūṣman</s> (heat) in the sense of emitting upward.
3.01.017 (The affix <s>KyaṢ</s> is used) after <s>śabda</s> (sound), <s>vaira</s> (enmity), <s>kalaha</s> (quarrel), <s>abhra</s> (cloud), <s>kaṇva</s>, and <s>megha</s> (cloud), in the sense of making.
3.01.018 After words beginning with <s>sukha</s> (happiness), (the affix <s>KyaṢ</s> is used) when the agent experiences (the state).
3.01.019 <s>KyaC</s> (is added) after <s>namas</s> (homage), <s>varivas</s> (wide space), and <s>citraṄ</s>.
3.01.020 <s>ṆiṄ</s> (is added) after <s>puccha</s> (tail), <s>bhāṇḍa</s> (vessel), and <s>cīvara</s> (robe).
3.01.021 <s>ṆiC</s> (is added) after <s>muṇḍa</s> (shaven), <s>miśra</s> (mixed), <s>ślakṣṇa</s> (smooth), <s>lavaṇa</s> (salt), <s>vrata</s> (vow), <s>vastra</s> (cloth), <s>hala</s> (plough), <s>kala</s> (soft), <s>kṛta</s> (done), and <s>tūsta</s>.
3.01.022 <s>yaṄ</s> (is added) to a <s>dhātu</s> (root) that is monosyllabic and consonant-initial, in the sense of repeated or intensive action.
3.01.023 (The intensive <s>yaṄ</s> is) obligatory (with roots denoting) crooked movement.
3.01.024 After <s>lup</s> (to cut), <s>sad</s> (to sit), <s>car</s> (to move), <s>jap</s> (to mutter), <s>jabhā</s>, <s>dah</s> (to burn), <s>daś</s> (to bite), and <s>gṝ</s> (to swallow), (the intensive is used) in the sense of censuring the action.
3.01.025 <s>ṆiC</s> (is added) after <s>satyāpa</s>, <s>pāśa</s>, <s>rūpa</s>, <s>vīṇā</s>, <s>tūla</s>, <s>śloka</s>, <s>senā</s>, <s>loman</s>, <s>tvac</s>, <s>varman</s>, <s>varṇa</s>, <s>cūrṇa</s>, and roots of the <s>cur</s>-class.
3.01.026 And (the causative <s>ṆiC</s> is added) when the action has a cause (i.e., in causative sense).
3.01.027 <s>yaK</s> (is added) after roots beginning with <s>kaṇḍū</s> (to itch).
3.01.028 <s>āyaḥ</s> (is added) after <s>gupŪ</s> (to protect), <s>dhūp</s> (to fumigate), <s>vicchī</s> (to go), <s>paṇ</s> (to trade), and <s>pan</s> (to praise).
3.01.029 <s>īyaṄ</s> (is added) after <s>ṛ</s> (to go).
3.01.030 <s>ṆiṄ</s> (is added) after <s>kam</s> (to desire).
3.01.031 <s>āya</s> and other (affixes) are optionally (added) in the <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> domain.
3.01.032 (Bases ending in) <s>saN</s> and other (affixes) up to (the end of this section) are (called) <s>dhātus</s> (verbal roots).
3.01.033 <s>sya</s> and <s>tāsī</s> (are added in) <s>lṚ</s> (future) and <s>lṚṬ</s> (periphrastic future).
3.01.034 <s>siP</s> (is added) variously in <s>lEṬ</s> (Vedic subjunctive).
3.01.035 After a <s>kās</s>-affix, <s>ām</s> (is added) in <s>lIṬ</s> (perfect), except in <s>mantras</s>.
3.01.036 And the <s>iC</s> substitute (is used for a root that is) heavy, except for <s>ṛcch</s>.
3.01.037 And (this applies to) <s>day</s> (to give), <s>ay</s> (to go), and <s>ās</s> (to sit).
3.01.038 Optionally after <s>uṣ</s> (to burn), <s>vid</s> (to know), and <s>jāgṛ</s> (to be awake).
3.01.039 And for <s>bhī</s> (to fear), <s>hrī</s> (to be ashamed), <s>bhṛ</s> (to bear), and <s>hu</s> (to sacrifice), (the treatment is) like <s>Ślu</s> (elision).
3.01.040 And <s>kṛÑ</s> (to do) is used (with <s>ām</s>) in <s>lIṬ</s> (perfect) as an auxiliary.
3.01.041 (The forms) <s>vidām kurvanti</s> etc. are optionally (used).
3.01.042 (Forms like) <s>abhyutsādayām</s>, <s>prajanayām</s>, <s>cikayām</s>, <s>ramayām</s>, <s>akāḥ</s>, <s>pāvayām</s>, <s>kriyāt</s>, <s>vidām akran</s> — these (occur) in Vedic usage.
3.01.043 <s>Cli</s> (is added) in <s>lUṄ</s> (aorist).
3.01.044 <s>siC</s> (replaces) <s>Cli</s>.
3.01.045 <s>Ksa</s> (replaces <s>Cli</s>) after a root with a <s>śaL</s> (sibilant/stop) as penultimate, when (the root is) without <s>iṬ</s> (augment).
3.01.046 (But not) for <s>śliṣ</s> (to embrace) in the sense of clinging.
3.01.047 Not for <s>dṛś</s> (to see).
3.01.048 After <s>Ṇi</s> (causative), <s>śri</s> (to resort to), <s>dru</s> (to run), and <s>sru</s> (to flow), <s>CaṄ</s> (replaces <s>Cli</s>) in the active voice.
3.01.049 Optionally for <s>dheṬ</s> (to suck) and <s>śvi</s> (to swell).
3.01.050 For <s>gup</s> (to protect) in Vedic usage.
3.01.051 Not from (the derived forms) <s>ūnayati</s>, <s>dhvanayati</s>, <s>elayati</s>, and <s>ardayati</s>.
3.01.052 <s>aṄ</s> (replaces <s>Cli</s>) after <s>asyati</s> (to throw), <s>vakti</s> (to speak), and <s>khyāti</s> (to tell).
3.01.053 And after <s>lip</s> (to smear), <s>sic</s> (to sprinkle), and <s>hve</s> (to call).
3.01.054 Optionally in <s>ātmanepada</s> (middle voice).
3.01.055 After roots of the <s>puṣ</s>-class and <s>dyut</s>-class, when (the root has) <s>iṬ</s>, in <s>parasmaipada</s> (active voice).
3.01.056 And after <s>sṛ</s> (to go), <s>śās</s> (to instruct), and <s>ṛ</s> (to go) (with certain forms).
3.01.057 Optionally when (the root has) <s>IR-IT</s>.
3.01.058 And after <s>jṝ</s> (to grow old), <s>stambhU</s> (to prop), <s>mruc</s>, <s>mluc</s>, <s>gruc</s>, <s>gluc</s>, <s>glunc</s>, and <s>śvi</s> (to swell).
3.01.059 After <s>kṛ</s> (to do), <s>mṛ</s> (to die), <s>dṛ</s> (to tear), and <s>ruh</s> (to grow), in Vedic usage.
3.01.060 <s>CiṆ</s> (replaces <s>Cli</s>) when the word ends in a <s>pada</s>.
3.01.061 Optionally after <s>dīp</s> (to shine), <s>jan</s> (to be born), <s>budhA</s> (to know), <s>pūr</s> (to fill), <s>tāy</s> (to spread), and <s>pyāy</s> (to swell).
3.01.062 (And <s>CiṆ</s> is used) after a vowel-ending (root) when the object acts upon itself.
3.01.063 And after <s>duh</s> (to milk).
3.01.064 Not after <s>rudh</s> (to obstruct).
3.01.065 And after <s>tap</s> (to heat) in the sense of remorse.
3.01.066 <s>CiṆ</s> (is used) in <s>bhāva</s> (impersonal) and <s>karman</s> (passive) constructions.
3.01.067 <s>yaK</s> (is added) in the <s>sārvadhātuka</s> (domain).
3.01.068 <s>ŚaP</s> (is added) in the active voice (for <s>bhvādi</s> roots).
3.01.069 <s>ŚyaN</s> (is added) after roots of the <s>div</s>-class.
3.01.070 Optionally (for) <s>bhrāś</s> (to fall), <s>bhlāś</s>, <s>bhram</s> (to wander), <s>kram</s> (to step), <s>klam</s> (to be tired), <s>tras</s> (to tremble), <s>truṭ</s> (to break), and <s>laṣ</s> (to desire).
3.01.071 (And) <s>yas</s> (to strive) without a prefix.
3.01.072 And <s>saṃyas</s> (with the prefix <s>sam</s>).
3.01.073 <s>Śnu</s> (is added) after roots of the <s>su</s>-class.
3.01.074 And <s>śṛ</s> replaces <s>śru</s> (to hear) (before <s>Śnu</s>).
3.01.075 Optionally for <s>akṣ</s> (to pervade).
3.01.076 For <s>takṣ</s> (to fashion) in the sense of making thin.
3.01.077 <s>Śa</s> (is added) after roots of the <s>tud</s>-class.
3.01.078 <s>ŚnaM</s> (is added) after roots of the <s>rudh</s>-class.
3.01.079 <s>u</s> (is added) after roots of the <s>tan</s>-class and <s>kṛÑ</s> (to do).
3.01.080 And <s>a</s> (is substituted) for <s>dhinv</s> and <s>kṛṇv</s>.
3.01.081 <s>Śnā</s> (is added) after roots of the <s>krī</s>-class.
3.01.082 And <s>Śnu</s> (is also added) after <s>stambh</s> (to prop), <s>stunbh</s>, <s>skanbh</s>, <s>skunbh</s>, and <s>skuÑ</s>.
3.01.083 <s>ŚānaC</s> (replaces) <s>Śna</s> of a consonant-ending (root) before <s>hau</s>.
3.01.084 In Vedic usage, <s>ŚāyaC</s> also (occurs).
3.01.085 Interchange (of <s>parasmaipada</s> and <s>ātmanepada</s> affixes occurs) variously.
3.01.086 <s>aṄ</s> (is added) in <s>lIṄ</s> (optative) in the sense of benediction.
3.01.087 (A verb in passive form is used when the subject is) acted upon like an object, performing the same action as the object.
3.01.088 (The passive is used with) <s>tap</s> (to perform penance) only when penance is the object.
3.01.089 <s>yaK</s> and <s>CiṆ</s> are not (used) for <s>duh</s> (to milk), <s>snu</s> (to drip), and <s>nam</s> (to bow).
3.01.090 For <s>kuṣ</s> and <s>raj</s>, the eastern (grammarians prescribe) <s>ŚyaN</s> and <s>parasmaipada</s>.
3.01.091 (The following affixes are added) after a <s>dhātu</s> (verbal root).
3.01.092 In that (rule), the <s>upapada</s> (co-occurring word) is what stands in the locative case.
3.01.093 A <s>kṛt</s> (primary affix is one that is) not a <s>tiṄ</s> (finite verb ending).
3.01.094 Optionally (an affix with) different form (may be used), except in the feminine.
3.01.095 The <s>kṛtya</s> (potential passive participle) affixes are (taught) up to <s>ṆvuL</s>.
3.01.096 <s>tavyaT</s>, <s>tavya</s>, and <s>anīyaR</s> (are the <s>kṛtya</s> affixes).
3.01.097 <s>yaT</s> (is added) after a vowel-ending (root).
3.01.098 After (a root ending in a consonant with) <s>aT</s> as penultimate.
3.01.099 And after <s>śak</s> (to be able) and <s>śah</s>.
3.01.100 And after <s>gad</s> (to speak), <s>mad</s> (to rejoice), <s>car</s> (to move), and <s>yam</s> (to restrain), without a prefix.
3.01.101 <s>avadya</s> (blameworthy), <s>paṇya</s> (saleable), and <s>varya</s> (to be chosen) are used in the senses of censure, being valued, and not being prevented, respectively.
3.01.102 <s>vahya</s> (to be carried) (is used in the sense of) a vehicle.
3.01.103 <s>arya</s> (is used in the sense of) master and <s>Vaiśya</s>.
3.01.104 <s>upasaryā</s> (means) a young woman fit for procreation.
3.01.105 <s>ajarya</s> (means) united, assembled.
3.01.106 After <s>vad</s> (to speak), (when a) <s>sUP</s> (nominal form is present), <s>KyaP</s> (is also added).
3.01.107 (The affix is added after) <s>bhū</s> (to be) in the sense of <s>bhāva</s> (being, state).
3.01.108 After <s>han</s> (to kill), and <s>ta</s> (is substituted for the final).
3.01.109 <s>KyaP</s> (is added) after <s>i</s> (to go), <s>stu</s> (to praise), <s>sās</s>, <s>vṛ</s> (to cover), <s>dṛ</s> (to tear), and <s>juṣ</s> (to enjoy).
3.01.110 And after a root with <s>ṛ</s> as penultimate, except <s>kḷp</s> and <s>cṛt</s>.
3.01.111 And <s>ī</s> (is substituted) for <s>khan</s> (to dig).
3.01.112 After <s>bhṛÑ</s> (to bear), except in the sense of a proper name.
3.01.113 Optionally after <s>mṛj</s> (to wipe).
3.01.114 <s>rājasūya</s>, <s>sūrya</s>, <s>mṛṣodya</s>, <s>rucya</s>, <s>kupya</s>, <s>kṛṣṭapacya</s>, and <s>avyathya</s> (are irregularly formed).
3.01.115 <s>bhidya</s> and <s>uddhya</s> (are used) in the sense of a river.
3.01.116 <s>puṣya</s> and <s>siddhya</s> (are used as names of) a <s>nakṣatra</s> (lunar mansion).
3.01.117 <s>vipūya</s>, <s>vinīya</s>, and <s>jitya</s> (are used in connection with) <s>muñja</s> (grass), <s>kalka</s> (paste), and <s>hali</s> (plough).
3.01.118 After <s>grah</s> (to seize) with prefixes <s>prati</s> and <s>api</s>, in Vedic usage.
3.01.119 And in (the words for) foot, <s>asvairin</s>, <s>bāhya</s> (outer), and <s>pakṣya</s> (relating to wings).
3.01.120 Optionally after <s>kṛ</s> (to do) and <s>vṛṣ</s> (to rain).
3.01.121 And <s>yugyam</s> (yokeable) in relation to a leaf.
3.01.122 <s>amāvasyaT</s> (new moon) is optionally (formed with this affix).
3.01.123 In Vedic usage, (the following irregular forms occur:) <s>niṣṭarkya</s>, <s>devahūya</s>, <s>praṇīya</s>, <s>unnīya</s>, <s>ucchiṣya</s>, <s>marya</s>, <s>starya</s>, <s>dhvarya</s>, <s>khanya</s>, <s>khānya</s>, <s>devayajya</s>, <s>āpṛcchya</s>, <s>pratiṣīvya</s>, <s>brahmavādya</s>, <s>bhāvya</s>, <s>stāvya</s>, <s>upacāyya</s>, and <s>pṛḍa</s>.
3.01.124 <s>ṆyaT</s> (is added) after a root ending in <s>ṛ</s> or <s>haL</s> (a consonant).
3.01.125 After <s>o</s> (roots), in the sense of necessity.
3.01.126 And after <s>āsu</s>, <s>yu</s> (to join), <s>vap</s> (to sow), <s>rap</s> (to talk), <s>lap</s> (to speak), <s>trap</s> (to be ashamed), and <s>cam</s> (to sip).
3.01.127 <s>ānāyya</s> (is used) in the sense of non-permanence.
3.01.128 <s>praṇāyya</s> (is used) in the sense of disapproval.
3.01.129 <s>pāyya</s>, <s>sāṃnāyya</s>, <s>nikāyya</s>, and <s>dhāyya</s> (are used) in connection with a measure, <s>havis</s> (oblation), dwelling, and <s>sāmidhenī</s> (kindling verses), respectively.
3.01.130 In a sacrifice, <s>kuṇḍapāyya</s> and <s>saṃcāyya</s> (are used).
3.01.131 In connection with fire, <s>paricāyya</s>, <s>upacāyya</s>, and <s>samūhya</s> (are used).
3.01.132 <s>citya</s> (is used in the sense of) building a fire-altar.
3.01.133 <s>ṆvuL</s> and <s>tṛC</s> (are added to denote the agent).
3.01.134 After roots of the <s>nandi</s>-class, <s>grahi</s>-class, and <s>paca</s>-class, <s>Lyu</s>, <s>Ṇini</s>, and <s>aC</s> (are added).
3.01.135 <s>Ka</s> (is added) after a root with <s>iK</s> (vowel <s>i</s> or <s>u</s>) as penultimate, and after <s>jñā</s> (to know), <s>prī</s> (to please), and <s>kir</s> (to scatter).
3.01.136 And (after a root beginning with) <s>āṬ</s> (a long vowel), when a prefix is present.
3.01.137 <s>Śa</s> (is added) after <s>pā</s> (to drink), <s>ghrā</s> (to smell), <s>dhmā</s> (to blow), <s>dheṬ</s> (to suck), and <s>dṛś</s> (to see).
3.01.138 Without a prefix, also after <s>limp</s> (to smear), <s>vind</s> (to find), <s>dhāri</s>, <s>pāri</s>, <s>vedi</s>, <s>udeji</s>, <s>ceti</s>, <s>sāti</s>, <s>sāhi</s> (and others).
3.01.139 Optionally after <s>dadāti</s> (to give) and <s>dadhāti</s> (to place).
3.01.140 <s>Ṇa</s> (is added) after roots from <s>jval</s> (to blaze) up to those ending in <s>kas</s>.
3.01.141 And after <s>śyā</s>, <s>āṬ</s>-initial (roots), <s>vyadh</s> (to pierce), <s>āsru</s>, <s>saṃsru</s>, <s>atiṇ</s>, <s>avasā</s>, <s>avahṛ</s>, <s>lih</s> (to lick), <s>śliṣ</s> (to cling), and <s>śvas</s> (to breathe).
3.01.142 (And after) <s>du</s> and <s>ni</s>, without a prefix.
3.01.143 Optionally after <s>grah</s> (to seize).
3.01.144 <s>Ka</s> (is added after <s>grah</s>) in the sense of a house.
3.01.145 <s>ṢvuN</s> (is added) when (denoting) a craftsman.
3.01.146 <s>thaKaN</s> (is added after) <s>gas</s>.
3.01.147 And <s>ṆyuṬ</s> (is also added).
3.01.148 And <s>ha</s> (is used) in connection with rice and time.
3.01.149 <s>vuN</s> (is added) after <s>pru</s> (to leap), <s>sṛ</s> (to go), and <s>lu</s> (to cut), in the sense of repeated action.
3.01.150 And in benedictions.
3.02.001 <s>aṆ</s> (is added to a root when the object is expressed).
3.02.002 And (after) <s>hvā</s> (to call), <s>vā</s> (to blow), and <s>am</s>.
3.02.003 <s>Ka</s> (is added after a root beginning with) <s>āṬ</s> (a long vowel), without a prefix.
3.02.004 After a <s>sUP</s> (nominal form), <s>stha</s> (to stand takes <s>Ka</s>).
3.02.005 (The affix <s>Ka</s> is added to) <s>parimṛj</s> (to wipe off) and <s>apanud</s> (to remove) in connection with a navel and grief.
3.02.006 After the prefix <s>pra</s>, (the affix is added to) <s>dā</s> (to give) and <s>jñā</s> (to know).
3.02.007 (After) <s>sam</s> and <s>i</s> (to go), <s>khya</s> (to count, takes the affix).
3.02.008 <s>ṬaK</s> (is added after) <s>gā</s> (to sing) and <s>pa</s> (to drink).
3.02.009 After <s>harati</s> (to carry), <s>aC</s> (is added) when there is no effort.
3.02.010 And in connection with age.
3.02.011 In the sense of habitual behavior, (when prefixed with) <s>āṄ</s>.
3.02.012 (After) <s>arh</s> (to deserve).
3.02.013 (After) <s>ram</s> (to delight) and <s>jap</s> (to mutter) in connection with a post and an ear.
3.02.014 In a proper name, after <s>śam</s> (to be calm) with a <s>dhātu</s> (root).
3.02.015 After <s>śī</s> (to lie down) in the sense of location.
3.02.016 <s>Ṭa</s> (is added) after <s>car</s> (to move).
3.02.017 And in the senses of alms, army, and taking.
3.02.018 After <s>sṛ</s> (to go) with <s>puras</s> (before), <s>agratas</s> (in front), and <s>agre</s> (ahead).
3.02.019 The preceding (rules teach affixes) in the sense of the agent.
3.02.020 After <s>kṛÑ</s> (to do), in the senses of cause, habitual disposition, and conformity.
3.02.021 (The affix <s>aṆ</s> is added after <s>kṛÑ</s>) in compounds with <s>divā</s> (day), <s>vibhā</s> (splendor), <s>niśā</s> (night), <s>prabhā</s> (radiance), <s>bhāskāra</s> (sun), words ending in <s>anta</s> and <s>ananta</s>, <s>ādi</s>, <s>bahu</s>, <s>nāndī</s>, <s>kim</s>, <s>lipi</s>, <s>libi</s>, <s>bali</s>, <s>bhakti</s>, <s>kartṛ</s>, <s>citra</s>, <s>kṣetra</s>, <s>saṃkhyā</s>, <s>jaṅghā</s>, <s>bāhu</s>, <s>ahan</s>, <s>yad</s>, <s>tad</s>, <s>dhanus</s>, and <s>aruṣ</s>.
3.02.022 After <s>bhṛ</s> (to bear) when the object (is expressed) in a compound.
3.02.023 Not in compounds with <s>śabda</s> (sound), <s>śloka</s> (verse), <s>kalaha</s> (quarrel), <s>gāthā</s> (song), <s>vaira</s> (enmity), <s>cāṭu</s> (flattery), <s>sūtra</s> (thread), <s>mantra</s> (hymn), and <s>pada</s> (word).
3.02.024 <s>iN</s> (is added) after (the words) <s>stamba</s> (tuft) and <s>śakṛt</s> (dung).
3.02.025 After <s>hṛ</s> (to seize) with <s>dṛti</s> (leather bag) and <s>nātha</s> (protector), in connection with cattle.
3.02.026 And (after) <s>grah</s> (to seize) in the context of fruit, and <s>ātmambhari</s> (self-nourishing).
3.02.027 In Vedic usage, (the affixes are added to) <s>van</s> (to desire), <s>san</s>, <s>rakṣ</s> (to protect), and <s>math</s> (to churn).
3.02.028 <s>KHaŚ</s> (is added) after <s>ej</s> (to tremble).
