3.02.184 <s>itra</s> (is added after) <s>ar</s> (to go), <s>lū</s> (to cut), <s>dhū</s> (to shake), <s>sū</s> (to impel), <s>khan</s> (to dig), <s>śahā</s> (to endure), and <s>car</s> (to move).
3.02.185 After <s>pu</s> (to purify) in a proper name.
3.02.186 And in the sense of agent, when (denoting) a <s>ṛṣi</s> (sage) or <s>devatā</s> (deity).
3.02.187 <s>Kta</s> (is added after a root marked with) <s>ÑI-IT</s>.
3.02.188 And after (roots) in the senses of thinking, understanding, and honoring.
3.03.001 <s>uṆ</s> and other (affixes are used) variously.
3.03.002 (They) are also seen in the past (tense).
3.03.003 In the future, <s>gamin</s> and other (forms are used).
3.03.004 <s>lAṬ</s> (present tense is used) with the particles <s>yāvat</s> (as long as) and <s>purā</s> (before).
3.03.005 Optionally with <s>kadā</s> (when) and <s>karhi</s> (when).
3.03.006 When inquiring about an action, in the sense of wishing to obtain.
3.03.007 And when what is desired is being accomplished.
3.03.008 And <s>lOṬ</s> (imperative is used) when the meaning of the rule (requires it).
3.03.009 And <s>lIṄ</s> (optative) when the period is more than a <s>muhūrta</s> (48 minutes).
3.03.010 <s>tumuN</s> and <s>ṆvuL</s> (are used) when one action is the purpose of another action.
3.03.011 And (they function as) expressions of <s>bhāva</s> (abstract state).
3.03.012 <s>aṆ</s> (is used) in the sense of the object as well.
3.03.013 <s>lṚṬ</s> (future is used) in the remaining (cases).
3.03.014 <s>SAT</s> (participle) optionally (replaces) <s>lṚṬ</s>.
3.03.015 <s>lUṬ</s> (periphrastic future is used) for the non-today (future).
3.03.016 <s>GHaÑ</s> (is added after) <s>pad</s> (to go), <s>ruj</s> (to break), <s>viś</s> (to enter), and <s>spṛś</s> (to touch).
3.03.017 After <s>sṛ</s> (to go) in the sense of firmness.
3.03.018 In the sense of <s>bhāva</s> (action/state).
3.03.019 And in the sense of a non-agent <s>kāraka</s> (case relation), in a proper name.
3.03.020 (The affix <s>GHaÑ</s> is added) after all (roots) in the designation of measure.
3.03.021 And after <s>iṄ</s> (to go).
3.03.022 After <s>ru</s> (to sound) with a prefix.
3.03.023 After <s>yu</s> (to join), <s>dru</s> (to run), and <s>du</s> (to go) with the prefix <s>sam</s> and <s>i</s>.
3.03.024 Optionally after <s>śri</s> (to resort), <s>ṇī</s>, and <s>bhū</s> (to be).
3.03.025 After <s>kṣu</s> (to sneeze) and <s>sru</s> (to flow) with <s>va</s>.
3.03.026 After <s>ni</s> and <s>ya</s> with (the prefixes) <s>ava</s> and <s>ud</s>.
3.03.027 After <s>dru</s> (to run), <s>stu</s> (to praise), and <s>sru</s> (to flow) with the prefix <s>pra</s>.
3.03.028 After <s>pū</s> (to purify) and <s>lū</s> (to cut) with (the prefixes) <s>nis</s> and <s>abhi</s>.
3.03.029 After <s>gṛ</s> (to swallow) with (the prefixes) <s>ud</s> and <s>ni</s>.
3.03.030 After <s>kṝ</s> (to scatter) in connection with grain.
3.03.031 After <s>stu</s> (to praise) with <s>sam</s> and <s>i</s>, in a sacrifice.
3.03.032 After <s>stṛ</s> (to spread) with the prefix <s>pra</s>, not in a sacrifice.
3.03.033 In the sense of expansion, with <s>va</s>, not in the sense of sound.
3.03.034 And in the name of a Vedic meter.
3.03.035 After <s>grah</s> (to seize) with (the prefix) <s>ud</s>.
3.03.036 After <s>muṣṭi</s> (fist) with <s>sam</s> and <s>i</s>.
3.03.037 After <s>nī</s> (to lead) and <s>iṆ</s> (to go) with <s>pari</s> and <s>ni</s>, in the senses of gambling and wandering.
3.03.038 After <s>iṆ</s> (to go) with <s>pari</s>, when there is no transgression.
3.03.039 After <s>śī</s> (to lie) with <s>vi</s> and <s>upa</s>, in the sense of a seat.
3.03.040 After <s>ci</s> (to gather) in the sense of taking in hand, not in the sense of theft.
3.03.041 <s>ka</s> (is added) after <s>ā</s> and <s>deś</s>, in the senses of dwelling, thought, body, and concentration.
3.03.042 And in the sense of a group, when there is no hierarchical relationship.
3.03.043 <s>ṆaC</s> (is added) in the sense of reciprocal action, (taking) the feminine (gender), with the object.
3.03.044 <s>inuṆ</s> (is added) in the sense of pervasion, in the <s>bhāva</s> (abstract) sense.
3.03.045 After <s>grah</s> (to seize) with <s>ava</s> and <s>ni</s>, in the sense of abuse.
3.03.046 After (the prefix) <s>pra</s>, in the sense of desiring to obtain.
3.03.047 With <s>pari</s> in a sacrifice.
3.03.048 After <s>vṛ</s> (to choose) with <s>ni</s>, in connection with grain.
3.03.049 After <s>śray</s> (to resort), <s>ati</s>, <s>yau</s>, <s>ti</s>, <s>pū</s> (to purify), and <s>dru</s> (to run), with <s>ud</s>.
3.03.050 Optionally after <s>ru</s> (to sound) and <s>plu</s> (to float) with <s>āṄ</s>.
3.03.051 After <s>grah</s> (to seize) with <s>ava</s>, in the sense of obstruction of rain.
3.03.052 After (the prefix) <s>pra</s>, (in connection with) merchants.
3.03.053 And in connection with a rein.
3.03.054 After <s>vṛṇoti</s> (to cover) in the sense of covering.
3.03.055 After <s>bhū</s> (to be) with <s>pari</s>, in the sense of contempt.
3.03.056 <s>aC</s> (is added) after <s>e</s> (to go).
3.03.057 <s>aP</s> (is added) after <s>ṝd</s> (to go).
3.03.058 And after <s>grah</s> (to seize), <s>vṛ</s> (to cover), <s>dṛ</s> (to tear), <s>nisci</s> (to ascertain), and <s>gam</s> (to go).
3.03.059 After <s>ad</s> (to eat) with a prefix.
3.03.060 After <s>ni</s>, and <s>Ṇa</s> (is also added).
3.03.061 After <s>vyadh</s> (to pierce) and <s>jap</s> (to mutter), without a prefix.
3.03.062 Optionally after <s>svan</s> (to sound) and <s>has</s> (to laugh).
3.03.063 After <s>yam</s> (to restrain) with <s>sam</s>, <s>upa</s>, <s>ni</s>, and <s>vi</s>.
3.03.064 After <s>gad</s> (to speak), <s>nad</s> (to roar), <s>paṭh</s> (to recite), and <s>svan</s> (to sound) with <s>ni</s>.
3.03.065 And after <s>kvaṇ</s> (to tinkle) in connection with a <s>vīṇā</s> (lute).
3.03.066 Always after <s>paṇ</s> (to trade) in the sense of measure.
3.03.067 After <s>mad</s> (to rejoice) without a prefix.
3.03.068 <s>pramada</s> and <s>sammada</s> (are formed) in the sense of joy.
3.03.069 After <s>aj</s> (to drive) with <s>sam</s> and <s>ud</s>, in connection with cattle.
3.03.070 After <s>glah</s> (to gamble) in connection with dice.
3.03.071 After <s>sṛ</s> (to go) with <s>pra</s>, in the sense of progeny.
3.03.072 After <s>hu</s> (to sacrifice) with <s>samprasāraṇa</s> and with <s>ni</s>, <s>abhi</s>, <s>upa</s>, and <s>vi</s>.
3.03.073 With <s>āṄ</s> in the sense of battle.
3.03.074 <s>nipāna</s> (watering place) and <s>āhāva</s> (invocation, are formed).
3.03.075 In the sense of <s>bhāva</s> (action), without a prefix.
3.03.076 And for <s>han</s> (to kill), <s>vadha</s> (killing) is (the substitute).
3.03.077 <s>ghana</s> (compact mass is formed) in the sense of a solid body.
3.03.078 <s>antarghana</s> (inner solid is used) in the sense of a place.
3.03.079 <s>praghaṇa</s> and <s>praghāṇa</s> (portico are used) in the sense of part of a house.
3.03.080 <s>udghana</s> (is used in the sense of) a chopping board.
3.03.081 <s>apaghana</s> (is used in the sense of) a limb.
3.03.082 (The affix is added) in the sense of instrument, in connection with metal and woodwork.
3.03.083 And <s>Ka</s> (is added) in the sense of a pillar.
3.03.084 <s>gha</s> (is used) with (the prefix) <s>pari</s>.
3.03.085 <s>upaghna</s> (is used) in the sense of a shelter.
3.03.086 <s>saṃgha</s> (assembly) and <s>udgha</s> (are used) in the senses of a group and praise.
3.03.087 <s>nigha</s> (is used in the sense of) a cause.
3.03.088 <s>Ktri</s> (is added after a root marked with) <s>ḌU-IT</s>.
3.03.089 <s>athuC</s> (is added after a root marked with) <s>ṬU-IT</s>.
3.03.090 <s>naṄ</s> (is added after) <s>yaj</s> (to sacrifice), <s>yāc</s> (to beg), <s>yat</s> (to strive), <s>vicch</s> (to desire), <s>pracch</s> (to ask), and <s>rakṣ</s> (to protect).
3.03.091 <s>naN</s> (is added after) <s>svap</s> (to sleep).
3.03.092 <s>Ki</s> (is added) after <s>GHO</s> (= <s>GHaÑ</s>-ending stems) with a prefix.
3.03.093 And in the senses of object and location.
3.03.094 <s>KtiN</s> (is added) in the feminine.
3.03.095 (The affix <s>KtiN</s> is added) after <s>sthā</s> (to stand), <s>gā</s> (to go), <s>pā</s> (to drink), and <s>pac</s> (to cook), in the sense of <s>bhāva</s> (action).
3.03.096 In <s>mantras</s>, (the forms) <s>vṛṣa</s>, <s>iṣā</s>, <s>pacā</s>, <s>manā</s>, <s>vid</s>, <s>bhū</s>, <s>vī</s>, and <s>rā</s> have <s>udātta</s> (acute accent).
3.03.097 And (the forms) <s>ūti</s>, <s>yūti</s>, <s>jūti</s>, <s>sāti</s>, <s>heti</s>, and <s>kīrti</s> (are so formed).
3.03.098 <s>KyaP</s> (is added) after <s>vraj</s> (to go) and <s>yaj</s> (to sacrifice) in the sense of <s>bhāva</s> (action).
3.03.099 In proper names, (the affix is added after) <s>samaj</s> (to assemble), <s>niṣad</s> (to sit down), <s>nipat</s> (to fall), <s>man</s> (to think), <s>vid</s> (to know), <s>suÑ</s> (to press), <s>śīṄ</s> (to lie), <s>bhṛÑ</s> (to bear), and <s>iṆ</s> (to go).
3.03.100 And <s>Śa</s> (is added) after <s>kṛÑ</s> (to do).
3.03.101 (The word) <s>icchā</s> (desire is irregularly formed).
3.03.102 <s>a</s> (is the affix added) after the (remaining) affixes.
3.03.103 And after a heavy (syllable ending in) a consonant.
3.03.104 <s>aṄ</s> (is added) after roots marked with <s>Ṣ-IT</s> and those of the <s>bhidā</s>-class.
3.03.105 And after <s>cint</s> (to think), <s>pūj</s> (to worship), <s>kath</s> (to narrate), <s>kumb</s>, and <s>carc</s> (to study).
3.03.106 And after (a root beginning with) <s>āṬ</s> with a prefix.
3.03.107 <s>yuC</s> (is added) after <s>Ṇi</s> (causative), <s>āsā</s>, and <s>sranth</s>.
3.03.108 <s>ṆvuL</s> (is added) variously in the designation of a disease.
3.03.109 In proper names.
3.03.110 Optionally (the affix <s>ṆvuL</s> is used) in narration and inquiry, and <s>iÑ</s> also.
3.03.111 <s>ṆvuC</s> (is added) in the senses of turn, worthiness, debt, and origin.
3.03.112 In abuse, <s>naÑ</s> and <s>ani</s> (are added) after <s>ākrośa</s> (abusive words).
3.03.113 <s>kṛtya</s> (affixes) and <s>LyuṬ</s> (are used) variously.
3.03.114 <s>Kta</s> (is added) in the neuter, in the sense of <s>bhāva</s> (action/state).
3.03.115 And <s>LyuṬ</s> (is also added in that sense).
3.03.116 And in the sense of an object whose contact causes bodily pleasure to the agent.
3.03.117 And in the senses of instrument and location.
3.03.118 <s>GHa</s> (is added) generally in the masculine, in a proper name.
3.03.119 And (the words) <s>gocara</s> (pasture), <s>saṃcara</s> (passage), <s>vaha</s> (carrying), <s>vraja</s> (cowpen), <s>vyaja</s> (fan), <s>āpaṇa</s> (market), and <s>nigama</s> (market town, are so formed).
3.03.120 <s>GHaÑ</s> (is added) after <s>tṝ</s> (to cross) and <s>stṛ</s> (to spread) with (the prefix) <s>ava</s>.
3.03.121 And after a consonant-ending (root).
3.03.122 And (the words) <s>adhyāya</s> (study), <s>nyāya</s> (logic), <s>udyāva</s>, <s>saṃhāra</s> (destruction), <s>ādhāra</s> (support), and <s>āvaya</s> (are so formed).
3.03.123 <s>udarka</s> (future consequence is formed) not in connection with water.
3.03.124 <s>jāla</s> (net) is (called) <s>ānāya</s>.
3.03.125 And <s>GHa</s> (is added) after <s>khan</s> (to dig).
3.03.126 <s>KHaL</s> (is added) with <s>īṣat</s> (slightly), <s>dus</s> (with difficulty), and <s>su</s> (easily), in the senses of difficulty and ease.
3.03.127 And in the senses of agent and object, after <s>bhū</s> (to be) and <s>kṛÑ</s> (to do).
3.03.128 <s>yuC</s> (is added after a root beginning with) <s>āṬ</s>.
3.03.129 In Vedic usage, after (roots) in the sense of motion.
3.03.130 (These affixes) are also seen from other (roots).
3.03.131 <s>lAṬ</s> (present tense is used) in the sense of present or near-present.
3.03.132 In expectation, the past (form) is also (used).
3.03.133 <s>lṚṬ</s> (future is used) in the sense of quick action.
3.03.134 <s>lIṄ</s> (optative is used) in the sense of expectation.
3.03.135 Not (used) like the non-today past, in continuity of action and proximity.
3.03.136 In the future, <s>lṚṬ</s> (is used) when specifying a limit or boundary, for the nearer (time).
3.03.137 And in the division of time, excluding days and nights.
3.03.138 Optionally for the farther (time).
3.03.139 <s>lṚṄ</s> (conditional is used) when the condition for <s>lIṄ</s> (optative) exists but the action has not occurred.
3.03.140 And (when the action was) in the past.
3.03.141 Optionally with <s>vā</s>, <s>ā</s>, <s>uta</s>, and <s>api</s>.
3.03.142 <s>lAṬ</s> (present is used) in censure, with <s>api</s> and <s>jātu</s>.
3.03.143 Optionally with <s>katham</s> (how), and <s>lIṄ</s> (optative) also.
3.03.144 <s>lIṄ</s> and <s>lṚṬ</s> (are used) when inquiring about an action.
3.03.145 Even without inquiry, in (the senses of) inability and impatience.
3.03.146 <s>lṚṬ</s> (is used) with <s>kim</s> (what), <s>kila</s> (indeed), and in the sense of <s>asti</s> (is it so?).
3.03.147 <s>lIṄ</s> (is used) with <s>jātu</s> (ever) and <s>yad</s> (if).
3.03.148 And with <s>yac</s> (since) and <s>yatra</s> (where).
3.03.149 And in censure.
3.03.150 And in astonishing (i.e., expressing wonder).
3.03.151 <s>lṚṬ</s> (is used) in the remaining (cases), without <s>yad</s>.
3.03.152 <s>lIṄ</s> (is used) with <s>uta</s> and <s>api</s> when they are coordinated.
3.03.153 In expressing desire and longing, without <s>kaccit</s> (I hope).
3.03.154 In the sense of possibility, when <s>alam</s> (enough) implies a proven non-occurrence.
3.03.155 Optionally (when used) with a <s>dhātu</s> (root), in expressing possibility, without <s>yadi</s> (if).
3.03.156 <s>lIṄ</s> (is used) for (expressing) cause and effect.
3.03.157 <s>lIṄ</s> and <s>lOṬ</s> (are used) in the senses of desiring.
3.03.158 <s>tumuN</s> (infinitive is used) when the actions have the same agent.
3.03.159 And <s>lIṄ</s> (optative is also used).
3.03.160 Optionally after (verbs) denoting desire, when (the action) is ongoing.
3.03.161 <s>lIṄ</s> (optative is used) in injunction, invitation, polite address, command, inquiry, and request.
3.03.162 And <s>lOṬ</s> (imperative is also used).
3.03.163 <s>kṛtya</s> (potential participle affixes are also used) in command, permission, and appropriate time.
3.03.164 And <s>lIṄ</s> (is used) when the period exceeds a <s>muhūrta</s>.
3.03.165 <s>lOṬ</s> (imperative is used) with <s>sma</s>.
3.03.166 And in a command.
3.03.167 <s>tumuN</s> (infinitive is used) with (words denoting) time, appointment, and occasion.
3.03.168 <s>lIṄ</s> (is used) with <s>yadi</s> (if).
3.03.169 <s>kṛtya</s> (affixes) and <s>tṛC</s> (are used) after <s>arh</s> (to deserve).
3.03.170 <s>Ṇini</s> (is added) in the senses of necessity and indebtedness.
3.03.171 And <s>kṛtya</s> (affixes are also used).
3.03.172 And <s>lIṄ</s> (is used) after <s>śak</s> (to be able).
3.03.173 <s>lIṄ</s> and <s>lOṬ</s> (are used) in benedictions.
3.03.174 <s>KtiC</s> and <s>Kta</s> (are added) in proper names.
3.03.175 <s>lUṄ</s> (aorist is used) with <s>māṄ</s> (prohibitive particle).
3.03.176 And <s>lAṄ</s> (imperfect) after <s>sma</s>.
3.04.001 The <s>pratyayas</s> (affixes taught so far) are (added) in connection with a <s>dhātu</s> (verbal root).
3.04.002 <s>lOṬ</s> (imperative is used) in repeated action; and optionally <s>hi</s> and <s>sva</s> replace <s>lOṬ</s> for <s>ta</s> and <s>dhvam</s>.
3.04.003 Optionally in aggregation.
3.04.004 The application follows the prescribed rules for the prior (element).
3.04.005 (In) aggregation, (the affix) of the general term (is used).
3.04.006 In Vedic usage, <s>lUṄ</s>, <s>lAṄ</s>, and <s>lIṬ</s> (are interchangeable).
3.04.007 <s>lEṬ</s> (Vedic subjunctive is used) in the sense of <s>lIṄ</s> (optative).
3.04.008 And in conciliation and apprehension.
3.04.009 In the sense of <s>tumun</s> (infinitive), (the following affixes are used:) <s>se</s>, <s>seN</s>, <s>ase</s>, <s>aseN</s>, <s>Kse</s>, <s>KaseN</s>, <s>adhyai</s>, <s>adhyaiN</s>, <s>Kadhyai</s>, <s>KadhyaiN</s>, <s>Śadhyai</s>, <s>ŚadhyaiN</s>, <s>tavai</s>, <s>taveṄ</s>, and <s>taveN</s>.
3.04.010 (The forms) <s>prayai</s>, <s>rohiṣyai</s>, and <s>avyathiṣyai</s> (are used in Vedic infinitive sense).
3.04.011 (The forms) <s>dṛśe</s> and <s>vikhye</s> (are used as infinitives).
3.04.012 After <s>śak</s> (to be able), <s>ṆamuL</s> and <s>KamuL</s> (are added).
3.04.013 (In the sense of) a lord/ruler, <s>tosuN</s> and <s>KasuN</s> (are added).
3.04.014 In the sense of <s>kṛtya</s> (obligation), <s>tavai</s>, <s>Ken</s>, <s>Kenya</s>, and <s>tvaN</s> (are added).
3.04.015 And after <s>avacakṣ</s> (to declare).
3.04.016 In expressing the characteristic of an action, <s>tosuN</s> (is added) after <s>sthā</s> (to stand), <s>iṆ</s> (to go), <s>kṛ</s> (to do), <s>vad</s> (to speak), <s>car</s> (to move), <s>hu</s> (to sacrifice), <s>tam</s> (to desire), and <s>jan</s> (to be born).
3.04.017 <s>KasuN</s> (is added after) <s>sṛp</s> (to creep) and <s>tṛd</s> (to split).
3.04.018 <s>Ktvā</s> (is added) with <s>alam</s> (enough) and <s>khalv</s> (indeed) in prohibitions, according to eastern (grammarians).
3.04.019 (According to) northern (grammarians), after <s>māṄ</s> (prohibitive), in reciprocal action.
3.04.020 And in connection with prior and subsequent.
3.04.021 (The affix <s>Ktvā</s> is added) when the two actions have the same agent, for the prior action.
3.04.022 And <s>ṆamuL</s> (is also added) in the sense of repetition.
3.04.023 Not with <s>yadi</s> (if), when there is no expectation.
3.04.024 Optionally with <s>agre</s> (first), <s>prathama</s> (first), and <s>pūrva</s> (before).
3.04.025 <s>KHamuÑ</s> (is added) after <s>kṛÑ</s> (to do) in abuse, when the object (is expressed).
3.04.026 <s>ṆamuL</s> (is added in the word) <s>svādum</s>.
3.04.027 With <s>anyathā</s> (otherwise), <s>evam</s> (thus), <s>katham</s> (how), and <s>ittham</s> (in this way), when a proven non-occurrence (is expressed).
3.04.028 With <s>yathā</s> (as) and <s>tathā</s> (so), in the sense of envious retort.
3.04.029 After <s>dṛś</s> (to see) and <s>vid</s> (to know) when the object denotes totality.
3.04.030 After <s>vind</s> (to find) and <s>jīv</s> (to live) with <s>yāvat</s> (as long as).
3.04.031 After <s>pūr</s> (to fill) in connection with leather and belly.
3.04.032 In the sense of a year's measure, and optionally with <s>ulpa</s> (small).
3.04.033 (The affix is used after) <s>knop</s> in connection with a covering.
3.04.034 After <s>kaṣ</s> (to scrape) in connection with uprooting and planting.
3.04.035 After <s>piṣ</s> (to grind) in connection with dry, powdered, and rough.
3.04.036 After <s>han</s> (to kill), <s>kṛÑ</s> (to do), and <s>grah</s> (to seize) in connection with uprooted, uncultivated, and living.
3.04.037 After <s>han</s> (to kill) in the sense of instrument.
3.04.038 After <s>piṣ</s> (to grind) in connection with anointing.
3.04.039 After <s>vṛt</s> (to exist) and <s>grah</s> (to seize) in connection with the hand.
3.04.040 After <s>puṣ</s> (to nourish) in connection with one's own (property).
3.04.041 After <s>bandh</s> (to bind) in the sense of location.
3.04.042 In proper names.
3.04.043 After <s>naś</s> (to perish) and <s>vah</s> (to carry) when the agent is a living person.
3.04.044 After <s>śuṣ</s> (to dry) and <s>pūr</s> (to fill) in an upward (direction).
3.04.045 In comparison, and in the sense of the object.
3.04.046 For the <s>kaṣ</s>-class and others, application follows the prescribed rules.
3.04.047 <s>upadaṃśa</s> (side dish is expressed) with the instrumental case.
3.04.048 And for (roots) meaning harm that are synonymous.
3.04.049 And with the locative case, after <s>upapīḍ</s> (to press), <s>rudh</s> (to obstruct), and <s>karṣ</s> (to drag).
3.04.050 In close contact.
3.04.051 And in the sense of measure.
3.04.052 In the sense of desire to take away, with <s>apa</s> and <s>ā</s>.
3.04.053 And with the accusative case.
3.04.054 When one's own limb is not permanent.
3.04.055 And when (the limb is) being afflicted.
3.04.056 After <s>viś</s> (to enter), <s>pat</s> (to fall), <s>pad</s> (to go), and <s>skand</s> (to leap), when being pervaded or being served.
3.04.057 After <s>as</s> (to throw), <s>ati-tṛṣ</s> (to be very thirsty), in intermediate times of action.
3.04.058 After <s>ādiś</s> (to point out) and <s>grah</s> (to seize) in connection with a name.
3.04.059 <s>Ktvā</s> and <s>ṆamuL</s> (are added) after <s>kṛÑ</s> (to do) with an indeclinable, when the expression is not as intended.
3.04.060 In a transverse direction, in the sense of completion.
3.04.061 After <s>kṛ</s> (to do) and <s>bhū</s> (to be) with the <s>tas</s>-affix, in connection with one's own limb.
3.04.062 (Not used) with an affix in the sense of name or <s>dhā</s> (to place), nor in the <s>Cvi</s>-sense.
3.04.063 After <s>bhū</s> (to be) with <s>tūṣṇīm</s> (silently).
3.04.064 After <s>añc</s> (to bend) in the sense of going along.
3.04.065 <s>tumuN</s> (infinitive is added) after <s>śak</s> (to be able), <s>dhṛṣ</s> (to dare), <s>jñā</s> (to know), <s>glā</s> (to be weary), <s>ghaṭ</s> (to strive), <s>rabh</s> (to begin), <s>labh</s> (to obtain), <s>kram</s> (to step), <s>sah</s> (to endure), <s>arh</s> (to deserve), and in the sense of <s>asti</s> (being).
3.04.066 In expressions meaning 'sufficient', in the sense of <s>alam</s> (enough).
3.04.067 <s>kṛt</s> (primary affixes denote) the agent.
3.04.068 (The words) <s>bhavya</s> (fit to be), <s>geya</s> (to be sung), <s>pravacanīya</s> (to be expounded), <s>upasthānīya</s> (to be attended), <s>janya</s> (to be born), <s>āplāvya</s> (to be bathed), and <s>āpātyā</s> are optional.
3.04.069 <s>la</s> (tense-affixes denote) the object and the action for intransitive (roots).
3.04.070 In those two (senses), the <s>kṛtya</s>, <s>Kta</s>, and <s>KHaL</s> affixes have (the same) meaning.
3.04.071 <s>Kta</s> (denotes) the object, and in some cases the agent.
3.04.072 (The affix <s>Kta</s> denotes the agent) after roots denoting motion, intransitive roots, <s>śliṣ</s> (to cling), <s>śīṄ</s> (to lie), <s>sthā</s> (to stand), <s>ās</s> (to sit), <s>vas</s> (to dwell), <s>jan</s> (to be born), <s>ruh</s> (to grow), and <s>jīryati</s> (to grow old).
3.04.073 <s>dāśa</s> (fisherman) and <s>goghna</s> (cow-killer) (are used) in the sense of gift.
3.04.075 Other than those two, <s>uṆ</s> and other (affixes are used).
3.04.076 <s>Kta</s> (is added) in the sense of location as well, after (roots meaning) permanence, motion, and conclusion.
3.04.077 (The following is about the personal endings) of <s>la</s> (tense-mood affixes).
3.04.078 <s>tiP</s>, <s>tas</s>, <s>jhi</s>, <s>siP</s>, <s>thas</s>, <s>tha</s>, <s>miP</s>, <s>vas</s>, <s>mas</s>, <s>ta</s>, <s>ātām</s>, <s>jha</s>, <s>thās</s>, <s>āthām</s>, <s>dhvam</s>, <s>iṬ</s>, <s>vahi</s>, and <s>mahiṄ</s> (are the eighteen personal endings).
3.04.079 <s>e</s> replaces <s>Ṭe</s> of the <s>ātmanepada</s> (middle voice) endings (marked with <s>Ṭ-IT</s>).
3.04.080 <s>se</s> (replaces) <s>thās</s>.
3.04.081 <s>eŚ</s> and <s>ireC</s> (replace) <s>ta</s> and <s>jha</s> of <s>lIṬ</s> (perfect).
3.04.082 (The <s>parasmaipada</s> endings of <s>lIṬ</s> are) <s>ṆaL</s>, <s>atus</s>, <s>us</s>, <s>thaL</s>, <s>athus</s>, <s>a</s>, <s>ṆaL</s>, <s>va</s>, and <s>ma</s>.
3.04.083 Optionally (these <s>lIṬ</s> endings are used) for <s>vid</s> (to know) in <s>lAṬ</s> (present).
3.04.084 <s>āha</s> (replaces the endings) of the first five (persons) of <s>brū</s> (to speak), being (forms) of <s>brū</s>.
3.04.085 The (endings) of <s>lOṬ</s> (imperative are) like those of <s>lAṄ</s> (imperfect).
3.04.086 <s>u</s> (replaces) <s>e</s> (of <s>lOṬ</s>).
3.04.087 <s>hi</s> (replaces) <s>se</s> (of <s>lOṬ</s>), and (the ending is marked with) <s>P-IT</s>.
3.04.088 Optionally in Vedic usage.
3.04.089 <s>ni</s> (replaces) <s>me</s> (of <s>lOṬ</s>).
3.04.090 <s>ām</s> (is added) after <s>eṬ</s>.
3.04.091 <s>va</s> and <s>am</s> (replace the endings) of <s>sva</s> and <s>ām</s>.
3.04.092 <s>āṬ</s> (replaces the ending) of the first person, and (it is marked with) <s>P-IT</s>.
3.04.093 <s>ai</s> (replaces) <s>eṬ</s>.
3.04.094 <s>aṬ</s> and <s>āṬ</s> (are added in) <s>lEṬ</s> (Vedic subjunctive).
3.04.095 <s>ai</s> (replaces) <s>āṬ</s>.
3.04.096 Optionally, <s>eṬ</s> (is replaced) elsewhere.
3.04.097 And <s>iṬ</s> is deleted in <s>parasmaipada</s> (active voice).
3.04.098 <s>s</s> (is deleted) of the first person.
3.04.099 Always (when the affix is marked with) <s>Ṅ-IT</s>.
3.04.100 And (when marked with) <s>iṬ</s>.
3.04.101 <s>tām</s>, <s>tam</s>, <s>ta</s>, and <s>am</s> (replace) <s>tas</s>, <s>thas</s>, <s>tha</s>, and <s>miP</s>.
3.04.102 <s>sīyuṬ</s> (is the ending) of <s>lIṄ</s> (optative).
3.04.103 <s>yāsuṬ</s> (is the ending) in <s>parasmaipada</s> (active voice), (with) <s>udātta</s> (accent) and (marked with) <s>Ṅ-IT</s>.
3.04.104 (The ending is marked with) <s>K-IT</s> in benedictions.
3.04.105 <s>raN</s> (replaces) <s>jha</s>.
3.04.106 <s>aṬ</s> (replaces) <s>iṬ</s>.
3.04.107 <s>suṬ</s> (is added after) <s>ti</s> and <s>th</s>.
3.04.108 <s>Jus</s> (replaces) <s>jhi</s>.
3.04.109 And after <s>sīC</s>, reduplicated (roots), and <s>vid</s> (to know).
3.04.110 (This applies) after <s>āṬ</s>.
3.04.111 (The substitution of <s>lAṄ</s> endings) according to <s>Śākaṭāyana</s> only.
3.04.112 And (after) <s>dviṣ</s> (to hate).
3.04.113 (An affix that is) <s>tiṄ</s> or (marked with) <s>Ś-IT</s> is (called) <s>sārvadhātuka</s>.
3.04.114 The rest is (called) <s>ārdhadhātuka</s>.
3.04.115 And <s>lIṬ</s> (perfect, is <s>ārdhadhātuka</s>).
3.04.116 <s>lIṄ</s> (optative is <s>ārdhadhātuka</s>) in benedictions.

body.translated_text:
4.01.001 After a <s>prātipadika</s> (nominal stem) [ending in <s>ṄīP</s> or <s>āP</s>, the following suffixes are added].
4.01.002 [The case-endings are:] <s>sU</s>, <s>au</s>, <s>Jas</s>; <s>am</s>, <s>auṬ</s>, <s>Śas</s>; <s>Ṭā</s>, <s>bhyām</s>, <s>bhis</s>; <s>Ṅe</s>, <s>bhyām</s>, <s>bhyas</s>; <s>ṄasI</s>, <s>bhyām</s>, <s>bhyas</s>; <s>Ṅas</s>, <s>os</s>, <s>ām</s>; <s>Ṅi</s>, <s>os</s>, <s>suP</s>.
4.01.003 In the feminine [gender, the following suffixes are added].
4.01.004 The suffix <s>ṬāP</s> [is added] after [stems belonging to] the <s>ajādi</s> class and after [stems ending in] <s>a</s>.
4.01.005 The suffix <s>ṄīP</s> [is added] after [stems ending in a consonant of the] <s>ṛT</s> [pratyāhāra] and after [stems ending in] <s>n</s>.
4.01.006 And after [stems ending in] <s>uK</s> and <s>iT</s> [pratyāhāra sounds].
4.01.007 And after [stems ending in] <s>van</s> and <s>ra</s>.
4.01.008 Optionally after [stems ending in] <s>pād</s>.
4.01.009 <s>ṬāP</s> [is added] in the <s>Ṛc</s> (Vedic hymns).
4.01.010 Not after [stems belonging to the class beginning with] <s>ṣaṭ</s> and <s>svasṛ</s>.
4.01.011 [Not after stems ending in] <s>man</s>.
4.01.012 [Not] after [stems ending in] <s>an</s> in a <s>bahuvrīhi</s> (possessive compound).
4.01.013 <s>ḌāP</s> [is added] optionally after both [forms].
4.01.014 [When the stem is] not a subordinate member [of a compound].
4.01.015 After [suffixes] <s>ṬIT</s>, <s>ḍha</s>, <s>aṆ</s>, <s>aÑ</s>, <s>dvayasaC</s>, <s>daghnaC</s>, <s>mātraC</s>, <s>tayaP</s>, <s>ṭhaÑ</s>, <s>kaÑ</s>, and <s>KvaraP</s>.
4.01.016 And after [suffixes] <s>yaÑ</s> and [those with] <s>as</s>.
4.01.017 In the eastern [dialects], <s>Ṣpha</s> [is used as] the <s>taddhita</s> [suffix].
4.01.018 [The suffix <s>ṄīP</s> is added] everywhere after [stems from the class beginning with] <s>lohita</s>, and after [stems ending in] <s>kata</s>.
4.01.019 And after <s>Kauravya</s> and <s>Māṇḍūka</s>.
4.01.020 In the first [stage] of age.
4.01.021 After a <s>dvigu</s> (numeral) compound.
4.01.022 Not after [stems from the class beginning with] <s>aparimāṇa</s>, <s>bista</s>, <s>ācita</s>, and <s>kambalya</s>, when there is <s>luK</s> (elision) of the <s>taddhita</s> [suffix].
4.01.023 After [stems ending in] <s>kāṇḍa</s> when [denoting] a field.
4.01.024 After <s>puruṣa</s> optionally when [denoting] a measure.
4.01.025 After <s>ūdhas</s> in a <s>bahuvrīhi</s> compound, [the suffix] <s>ṄīṢ</s> [is added].
4.01.026 After a numeral or an indeclinable, <s>ṄīP</s> [replaces the final] <s>e</s>.
4.01.027 And after [stems] ending in <s>dāman</s> or <s>hāyana</s>.
4.01.028 Optionally after [stems ending in] <s>an</s>, and after <s>upadhā</s> and <s>opin</s>.
4.01.029 Always in proper names and in Vedic [usage].
4.01.030 And after <s>kevala</s>, <s>māmaka</s>, <s>bhāgadheya</s>, <s>pāpa</s>, <s>apara</s>, <s>samāna</s>, <s>ārya</s>, <s>kṛta</s>, <s>su</s>, <s>maṅgala</s>, and <s>bheṣaja</s>.
4.01.031 And after <s>rātri</s> (night), except before <s>Jas</s> and <s>au</s>.
4.01.032 [The augment] <s>nuK</s> [is added] after <s>antarvatī</s> (pregnant) and <s>pativatī</s> (having a husband).
4.01.033 [The word] <s>pati</s> [takes] <s>naḥ</s> in connection with a sacrifice.
4.01.034 Optionally when preceded by <s>sa</s>.
4.01.035 Always in [compounds beginning with] <s>sapatnī</s> and the like.
4.01.036 And <s>ai</s> [is substituted] after <s>Pūtakratu</s>.
4.01.037 After <s>Vṛṣākapi</s>, <s>Agni</s>, <s>Kusita</s>, and <s>Kusīda</s>, the accent is <s>udātta</s>.
4.01.038 Or <s>au</s> after <s>Manu</s>.
4.01.039 After a stem with <s>t</s> as penultimate, ending in an unaccented vowel, <s>naḥ</s> [is added].
4.01.040 <s>ṄīṢ</s> [is added] after [other stems, denoting] one of two.
4.01.041 After [stems from the class beginning with] <s>Gaura</s>, with <s>Ṣ</s> as <s>IT</s> marker.
4.01.042 After <s>jānapada</s>, <s>kuṇḍa</s>, <s>goṇa</s>, <s>sthala</s>, <s>bhāja</s>, <s>nāga</s>, <s>kāla</s>, <s>nīla</s>, <s>kuśa</s>, <s>kāmuka</s>, and <s>kabara</s>, in the senses of livelihood, vessel, place of shaving, non-artificial, cooked, stoutness, color, non-covering, iron-product, sexual intercourse, desire, hair, and dress.
4.01.043 After <s>Śoṇa</s> in the eastern [dialects].
4.01.044 Optionally after [stems ending in] <s>uT</s> when denoting a quality.
4.01.045 And after [stems from the class beginning with] <s>Bahu</s>.
4.01.046 Always in Vedic [usage].
4.01.047 And after <s>bhū</s> (earth).
4.01.048 After a masculine stem, when [it is] a proper name.
4.01.049 The augment <s>ānuK</s> [is added] after <s>Indra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Bhava</s>, <s>Śarva</s>, <s>Rudra</s>, <s>Mṛḍa</s>, <s>Hima</s>, <s>Araṇya</s>, <s>Yava</s>, <s>Yavana</s>, <s>Mātula</s>, and <s>Ācārya</s>.
4.01.050 After a <s>kṛt</s> [suffix] preceded by an instrument.
4.01.051 After a <s>kṛt</s> [suffix] when [the name is] a diminutive.
4.01.052 And after a <s>bahuvrīhi</s> compound with final <s>udātta</s> accent.
4.01.053 Optionally when the prior member is not <s>svarga</s>.
4.01.054 And after <s>svarga</s> when [the stem is] a subordinate member, without <s>a</s> as penultimate in conjunction.
4.01.055 And after [compounds ending in] <s>nāsikā</s> (nose), <s>udara</s> (belly), <s>oṣṭha</s> (lip), <s>jaṅghā</s> (shin), <s>danta</s> (tooth), <s>karṇa</s> (ear), and <s>śṛṅga</s> (horn).
4.01.056 Not after [stems from the class beginning with] <s>kroḍa</s> or polysyllabic [stems].
4.01.057 After [stems] preceded by <s>saha</s>, <s>naÑ</s>, <s>vid</s>, <s>ya</s>, and <s>māna</s>.
4.01.058 After [compounds ending in] <s>nakha</s> (nail) or <s>mukha</s> (face) in a proper name.
4.01.059 And <s>dīrgha-jihvī</s> (long-tongued) in Vedic [usage].
4.01.060 <s>ṄīP</s> [is added] after [a compound] with a directional word as prior member.
4.01.061 After <s>vāh</s> (carrier).
4.01.062 <s>sakhī</s> (female friend) and <s>aśiśvī</s> in common speech.
4.01.063 After a word denoting a caste, when not referring specifically to women, and not having <s>ya</s> as penultimate.
4.01.064 And after [compounds] with <s>pāka</s>, <s>karṇa</s>, <s>parṇa</s>, <s>puṣpa</s>, <s>phala</s>, <s>mūla</s>, and <s>vāla</s> as the final member.
4.01.065 After [stems ending in] <s>iT</s> when denoting a human caste.
4.01.066 <s>ūṄ</s> [is added] after [stems ending in] <s>uT</s>.
4.01.067 After [stems] ending in <s>bāhu</s> in a proper name.
4.01.068 And after <s>paṅgu</s> (lame).
4.01.069 After [compounds] with <s>ūru</s> (thigh) as the final member, in the sense of comparison.
4.01.070 And after [compounds beginning with] <s>saṃhita</s>, <s>śapha</s>, <s>lakṣaṇa</s>, <s>vāma</s>, and the like.
4.01.071 After <s>Kadru</s> and <s>Kamaṇḍalu</s> in Vedic [usage].
4.01.072 In a proper name.
4.01.073 <s>ṄīN</s> [is added] after [stems taking] <s>aÑ</s> from the <s>Śārṅgarava</s> class.
4.01.074 <s>CāP</s> [is added] after [stems taking] <s>yaÄ</s>.
4.01.075 And after <s>āvaṭī</s>.
4.01.076 [These are the] <s>taddhita</s> [suffixes for feminine formation].
4.01.077 After <s>yūvan</s> (young), [the suffix] <s>tih</s> [is added].
4.01.078 After <s>aṆ</s> or <s>iÑ</s>, when not from a Vedic seer, and when [the base is] heavy or [from] <s>Pottamaya</s>, <s>ṢyaṄ</s> [is added] in <s>gotra</s> (patronymic) [formation].
4.01.079 After a subdivision of a <s>gotra</s>.
4.01.080 And after [stems from the class beginning with] <s>Krauḍi</s>.
4.01.081 Optionally after <s>Daivayajñi</s>, <s>Śauci</s>, <s>Vṛkṣi</s>, <s>Sātyamugri</s>, and <s>Kāṇṭheviddhi</s>.
4.01.082 Optionally after the first [member] of a semantically connected [compound].
4.01.083 The suffix <s>aṆ</s> [is applied in the sūtras] up to [the sūtra containing] <s>dīvyat</s>.
4.01.084 And after [stems from the class beginning with] <s>Aśvapati</s>.
4.01.085 The suffix <s>Ṇya</s> [is added] after [compounds] with <s>Diti</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, <s>Āditya</s>, or <s>Pati</s> as the final member.
4.01.086 The suffix <s>aÑ</s> [is added] after [stems from the class beginning with] <s>Utsa</s>.
4.01.087 The suffixes <s>naÑ</s> and <s>snaÑ</s> [are added] after masculine and feminine [stems] respectively, [when meaning] 'born of'.
4.01.088 <s>luK</s> (elision) of [the suffix] in a <s>dvigu</s> compound when not [denoting] offspring.
4.01.089 In <s>gotra</s> [formation], no <s>luK</s> [of the suffix] before a vowel-initial [suffix].
4.01.090 <s>luK</s> [of the suffix occurs] in the <s>yūvan</s> (younger descendant) [formation].
4.01.091 <s>phaK</s> and <s>phiÑ</s> optionally.
4.01.092 [In the sense of] 'his offspring'.
4.01.093 A single [suffix is used] in <s>gotra</s> [formation].
4.01.094 After a <s>gotra</s> [name], in the <s>yūvan</s> [formation], when not feminine.
4.01.095 The suffix <s>iÑ</s> [is added] after [stems ending in] <s>a</s>.
4.01.096 And after [stems from the class beginning with] <s>Bāhu</s>.
4.01.097 After <s>Sudhātu</s>, [the suffix] <s>akaÄ</s> also [is added].
4.01.098 The suffix <s>CphaÑ</s> [is added] after [stems from the class beginning with] <s>Kuñja</s> in <s>gotra</s> [formation].
4.01.099 The suffix <s>phaK</s> [is added] after [stems from the class beginning with] <s>Naḍa</s>.
4.01.100 The suffix <s>aÑ</s> [is added] after [stems from the class beginning with] <s>Harita</s>.
4.01.101 And after [stems taking] <s>yaÑ</s> and <s>iÑ</s>.
4.01.102 After <s>Śaradvatśunaka</s> and <s>Darbha</s> in the senses of <s>Bhṛgu</s>, <s>Vatsa</s>, and <s>Āgrāyaṇa</s>.
4.01.103 Optionally after <s>Droṇa</s>, <s>Parvata</s>, and <s>Jīvanta</s>.
4.01.104 The suffix <s>aÑ</s> [is added] after [stems from the class beginning with] <s>Biḍa</s>, when [the descendant is] not an immediate successor of a Vedic seer.
4.01.105 The suffix <s>yaÑ</s> [is added] after [stems from the class beginning with] <s>Garga</s>.
4.01.106 After <s>Madhu</s> and <s>Babhru</s> among Brāhmaṇa <s>Kauśikas</s>.
4.01.107 After <s>Kapi</s> and <s>Bodha</s> among <s>Āṅgirasas</s>.
4.01.108 And after <s>Vataṇḍa</s>.
4.01.109 <s>luK</s> (elision) in the feminine.
4.01.110 The suffix <s>phaK</s> [is added] after [stems from the class beginning with] <s>Aśva</s>.
4.01.111 After <s>Bharga</s> among <s>Traigartas</s>.
4.01.112 The suffix <s>aṆ</s> [is added] after [stems from the class beginning with] <s>Śiva</s>.
4.01.113 After non-<s>vṛddhi</s> [stems], except those [which are] rivers, human [names], or [from the class ending with] <s>anāmikā</s>.
4.01.114 And after <s>Ṛṣi</s>, <s>Andhaka</s>, <s>Vṛṣṇi</s>, and <s>Kuru</s>.
4.01.115 After a mother's [name], [the augment] <s>uT</s> [is added] when preceded by a numeral, <s>sama</s>, <s>bhadra</s>, or <s>pūrva</s>.
4.01.116 And <s>kanīna</s> [is the suffix] after <s>kanyā</s> (maiden).
4.01.117 After <s>Vikarṇa</s>, <s>Śuṅga</s>, and <s>Chagala</s> among <s>Vatsa</s>, <s>Bharadvāja</s>, and <s>Atri</s> [descendants].

4.04.063 [In the sense of] 'engaged in an occupation or study'.
4.04.064 The suffix <s>ṬhaC</s> after [compounds] with a polysyllabic prior member.
4.04.065 [In the sense of] 'beneficial food'.
4.04.066 [In the sense of] 'that is given to him as an assigned [share]'.
4.04.067 The suffix <s>ṬiṭhaN</s> after <s>śrāṇā</s> (cooked), <s>māṃsa</s> (meat), and <s>odana</s> (rice).
4.04.068 Optionally the suffix <s>aṆ</s> after <s>bhakta</s> (cooked rice).
4.04.069 [In the sense of] 'appointed there'.
4.04.070 The suffix <s>ṬhaN</s> after [compounds] ending in <s>agāra</s> (house).
4.04.071 [After a stem denoting] a student, when not [referring to] a place or time.
4.04.072 [In the sense of] 'distributes' in [the contexts of] <s>kaṭhina</s> (robe-offering), spreading, and arrangement.
4.04.073 [In the sense of] 'dwells nearby'.
4.04.074 The suffix <s>ṢṭhaL</s> after <s>āvasatha</s> (dwelling).
4.04.075 The suffix <s>yaT</s> [is added in the sūtras] up to [the one containing] <s>hita</s> (beneficial).
4.04.076 [In the sense of] 'carries that', [referring to] a chariot, yoke, or accessory.
4.04.077 The suffixes <s>yaT</s> and <s>ḌhaK</s> after <s>dhur</s> (yoke-pole).
4.04.078 The suffix <s>kha</s> after <s>sarvadhur</s> (all yoke-poles).
4.04.079 And <s>luK</s> (elision) after <s>ekadhur</s> (single yoke-pole).
4.04.080 The suffix <s>aṆ</s> after <s>śakaṭa</s> (cart).
4.04.081 The suffix <s>ṬhaK</s> after <s>hala</s> (plough) and <s>sīra</s> (plough).
4.04.082 In a proper name, [they are called] <s>janya</s> (battle-worthy).
4.04.083 [In the sense of] 'pierces without a bow'.
4.04.084 [In the sense of] 'has obtained a host of wealth'.
4.04.085 The suffix <s>Ṇa</s> after <s>anna</s> (food).
4.04.086 [In the sense of] 'come under control'.
4.04.087 [In the sense of] 'his footprint is visible in this'.
4.04.088 [In the sense of] 'its root extends to the edge'.
4.04.089 In a proper name, <s>dhenuṣyā</s> [is the form].
4.04.090 The suffix <s>Ñya</s> [in the sense of] 'associated with a <s>gṛhapati</s> (householder)'.
4.04.091 [The suffixes mean] 'navigable, commensurable, attainable by dharma, measurable at the root, equivalent, weighed, comparable, measured, and commensurate' after <s>nau</s> (boat), <s>vayas</s> (age), <s>dharma</s>, <s>visa</s>, <s>mūla</s> (root), <s>sītā</s> (furrow), and <s>tulā</s> (balance).
4.04.093 [In the sense of] 'composed in a meter' in Vedic [usage].
4.04.094 And the suffix <s>aṆ</s> after <s>uras</s> (chest).
4.04.095 [In the sense of] 'dear to the heart'.
4.04.096 And [in the sense of] 'bound' in [the context of] a <s>ṛṣi</s> (seer).
4.04.097 After <s>mata</s> (thought), <s>jana</s> (people), and <s>hala</s> (plough), in the senses of instrument, speech, and ploughing.
4.04.098 [In the sense of] 'skilled in that'.
4.04.099 The suffix <s>khaÑ</s> after [stems from the class beginning with] <s>Pratijana</s>.
4.04.100 The suffix <s>Ṇa</s> after <s>bhakta</s> (devotee/food).
4.04.101 The suffix <s>Ṇya</s> after <s>pariṣad</s> (assembly).
4.04.102 The suffix <s>ṬhaK</s> after [stems from the class beginning with] <s>Kathā</s> (story).
4.04.103 The suffix <s>ṬhaÑ</s> after [stems from the class beginning with] <s>Guḍa</s> (jaggery).
4.04.105 The suffix <s>ya</s> after <s>sabhā</s> (assembly hall).
4.04.106 The suffix <s>Ḍha</s> in Vedic [usage].
4.04.107 [In the sense of] one who dwells at the same <s>tīrtha</s> (holy place/school).
4.04.108 [In the sense of] one who has lain in the same womb, and [the accent is] <s>udātta</s>.
4.04.109 The suffix <s>ya</s> after <s>sodara</s> (born of the same womb).
4.04.110 [In the sense of] 'being/existence' in Vedic [usage].
4.04.111 The suffix <s>ḌyaṆ</s> after <s>pāthas</s> (water) and <s>nadī</s> (river).
4.04.112 The suffix <s>aṆ</s> after <s>Veśanta</s> and <s>Himavat</s> (Himālaya).
4.04.113 Optionally the suffixes <s>ḌyaT</s> and <s>Ḍya</s> after <s>srotas</s> (stream).
4.04.114 The suffix <s>yaN</s> after [compounds meaning] 'with the same embryo', 'with the same herd', and 'with the same <s>nuta</s>'.
4.04.115 The suffix <s>ghaN</s> after <s>Tugra</s>.
4.04.116 The suffix <s>yaT</s> after <s>agra</s> (front/top).
4.04.117 And [the suffixes] <s>gha</s> and <s>cha</s>.
4.04.118 The suffix <s>gha</s> after <s>samudra</s> (ocean) and <s>abhra</s> (cloud).
4.04.119 [In the sense of] 'offered upon the <s>barhis</s> (sacred grass)'.
4.04.120 [In the senses of] 'a messenger's gift and duty'.
4.04.121 [In the sense of] 'a slayer of <s>Rākṣasas</s> (demons) and <s>Yātudhānas</s> (sorcerers)'.
4.04.122 After <s>Revatī</s>, <s>Jagatī</s>, and <s>Haviṣyā</s> in [the sense of] something praiseworthy.
4.04.123 [In the sense of] 'the property of an <s>Asura</s> (demon)'.
4.04.124 The suffix <s>aṆ</s> in [the sense of] <s>māyā</s> (illusion).
4.04.125 [In the sense of] 'possessing that as its foundation in a mantra', in [naming] <s>iṣṭakās</s> (bricks), <s>luK</s> (elision) of <s>matUP</s>.
4.04.126 [In the sense of] 'possessing <s>Aśvins</s>', the suffix <s>aṆ</s>.
4.04.127 The suffix <s>matUP</s> after <s>mūrdhan</s> (head) in <s>vayasyā</s> (friendship) [contexts].
4.04.128 [The suffix] <s>matUP</s> in its meaning, after <s>māsa</s> (month) and <s>tanu</s> (body).
4.04.129 And the suffix <s>Ña</s> after <s>madhu</s> (honey/sweet).
4.04.130 The suffixes <s>yaT</s> and <s>kha</s> after <s>ojas</s> (vigor) [in the context of] a day.
4.04.132 And [the suffix] <s>kha</s>.
4.04.133 And [the suffixes] <s>ini</s> and <s>ya</s> [in the sense of] 'done by former [sages]'.
4.04.134 [In the sense of] 'consecrated with waters'.
4.04.135 The suffix <s>gha</s> [in the sense of] 'measured by a thousand'.
4.04.136 And [the suffix] <s>matUP</s>.
4.04.137 [In the sense of] 'one who deserves <s>Soma</s>'.
4.04.138 And [the suffix] <s>maya</s> [is used].
4.04.139 After <s>madhu</s> (honey).
4.04.140 And after <s>vasas</s> (cloth) in [the sense of] a collection.
4.04.141 The suffix <s>gha</s> after a <s>nakṣatra</s> (constellation).
4.04.142 The suffix <s>tātiL</s> after <s>sarvadeva</s> (all gods).
4.04.143 [In the sense of] 'producing auspiciousness, peace, and freedom from harm'.
4.04.144 And in [the sense of] a state of being.

body.translated_text:
5.01.001 Before [the sūtra containing] 'krīta' [5.1.37], [the suffix] <s>cha</s> [is the default].
5.01.002 After [stems of] the <s>ugava</s> class and others, [the suffix] <s>aṬ</s> [is added].
5.01.003 And after <s>kambala</s> (blanket), in a proper name.
5.01.004 Optionally, after <s>havis</s> (oblation), <s>apūpa</s> (cake), and others.
5.01.005 [In the sense of] 'beneficial for that.'
5.01.006 After [a word denoting] a body part, [the suffix] <s>yaṬ</s>.
5.01.007 And after <s>khala</s> (threshing floor), <s>yava</s> (barley), <s>māṣa</s> (bean), <s>tila</s> (sesame), <s>vṛṣa</s> (bull), and <s>brahman</s> (priest).
5.01.008 After <s>aja</s> (goat) and <s>avi</s> (sheep), [the suffix] <s>thyaÑ</s>.
5.01.009 After <s>ātman</s> (self), <s>viśvajana</s> (all people), <s>bhoga</s> (enjoyment), <s>uttara</s> (subsequent), and <s>ada</s> (eating), [the suffix] <s>kha</s>.
5.01.010 After <s>sarva</s> (all) and <s>puruṣa</s> (person), [the suffixes] <s>Ṇa</s> and <s>ḍhaÑ</s>.
5.01.011 After <s>māṇava</s> and <s>caraka</s>, [the suffix] <s>khaÑ</s>.
5.01.012 [In the sense of] 'intended for that,' [the suffix is added] to a modified form [to denote] the original.
5.01.013 After <s>chadis</s> (roof), <s>upadhi</s> (cushion), and <s>bala</s> (strength), [the suffix] <s>ḍhaÑ</s>.
5.01.014 After <s>ṛṣabha</s> (bull) and <s>upānaha</s> (sandal), [the suffix] <s>Ñya</s>.
5.01.015 After <s>carman</s> (leather), [the suffix] <s>aÑ</s>.
5.01.016 [In the sense of] 'that is his' or 'that should be in it.'
5.01.017 After <s>parikhā</s> (moat), [the suffix] <s>ḍhaÑ</s>.
5.01.018 Before [the sūtra containing] <s>vata</s>, [the suffix] <s>ṭhaÑ</s> [is prescribed].
5.01.019 [The suffix] <s>ṭhaK</s> [is added] up to [stems meaning] 'deserving,' excluding those denoting cow-tail, number, or measure.
5.01.020 After <s>niṣka</s> and similar words, when not in a compound.
5.01.021 And after <s>śata</s> (hundred), [the suffixes] <s>ṭhaN</s> and <s>yaT</s>, but not when <s>śata</s> is part of another <s>śata</s>-compound.
5.01.022 After a numeral not ending in <s>śata</s>, [the suffix] <s>kaN</s>.
5.01.023 Optionally, <s>iṬ</s> [is the augment] of [suffix] <s>vatu</s>.
5.01.024 After <s>viṃśati</s> (twenty) and <s>triṃśat</s> (thirty), [the suffix] <s>ḌvuN</s>, except in proper names.
5.01.025 After <s>kaṃsa</s> (a measure), [the suffix] <s>ṬiṭhaN</s>.
5.01.026 After <s>śūrpa</s> (winnowing basket), [the suffix] <s>aÑ</s>, optionally.
5.01.027 After <s>śatamāna</s>, <s>viṃśatika</s>, <s>sahasra</s>, and <s>vasana</s>, [the suffix] <s>aÆ</s>.
5.01.028 In a <s>dvigo</s> (numeral) compound with <s>adhi</s>, <s>ardha</s>, or <s>pūrva</s>, the suffix undergoes <s>luK</s> (deletion), except in proper names.
5.01.029 Optionally, after <s>kārṣāpaṇa</s> and <s>sahasra</s>.
5.01.030 After <s>niṣka</s> preceded by <s>dvi</s> (two) or <s>tri</s> (three).
5.01.031 And after <s>bista</s>.
5.01.032 After <s>viṃśatika</s>, [the suffix] <s>kha</s>.
5.01.033 After <s>khārī</s> (a measure), [the suffix] <s>īkaN</s>.
5.01.034 After <s>paṇa</s>, <s>pāda</s>, <s>māṣa</s>, and <s>śata</s>, [the suffix] <s>aT</s>.
5.01.035 Optionally, after <s>śāṇa</s>.
5.01.036 And [the suffix] <s>aÆ</s> after [a word] preceded by <s>dvi</s> (two) or <s>tri</s> (three).
5.01.037 [In the sense of] 'bought with that.'
5.01.038 [In the sense of] 'the cause of that,' and when in contact or rising [from it].
5.01.039 After <s>go</s> (cow), a disyllabic word that is not a number or measure, <s>aśva</s> (horse), and <s>ade</s>, [the suffix] <s>yaT</s>.
5.01.040 And after <s>putra</s> (son), [the suffix] <s>cha</s> also.
5.01.041 After <s>sarvabhūmi</s> and <s>pṛthivī</s> (earth), [the suffixes] <s>aÆ</s> and <s>aÑ</s>.
5.01.042 [In the sense of] 'the lord of that.'
5.01.043 And [in the sense of] 'known in that [place].'
5.01.044 After <s>loka</s> (world) and <s>sarvaloka</s> (entire world), [the suffix] <s>ṭhaÑ</s>.
5.01.045 [In the sense of] 'the sowing of that.'
5.01.046 After <s>pātra</s> (vessel), [the suffix] <s>ṢṭhaN</s>.
5.01.047 [In the sense of] 'interest, income, profit, tax, or tribute is given on that.'
5.01.048 After a word denoting an ordinal number or 'half,' [the suffix] <s>ṭhaN</s>.
5.01.049 And after <s>bhāga</s> (share), [the suffix] <s>yaT</s>.
5.01.050 [In the sense of] 'one who carries, conveys, or brings that,' after <s>bhāra</s> (load) and words of the <s>vaṃśa</s> class.
5.01.051 After <s>vasna</s> (price) and <s>dravya</s> (goods), [the suffixes] <s>ṭhaN</s> and <s>kaN</s>.
5.01.052 [In the sense of] 'it arises,' 'one takes away,' or 'one cooks.'
5.01.053 After <s>āḍhaka</s> (a measure), <s>ācita</s>, and <s>pātra</s> (vessel), [the suffix] <s>kha</s>, optionally.
5.01.054 And [the suffix] <s>ṢṭhaN</s> in a <s>dvigo</s> (numeral) compound.
5.01.055 After <s>kulija</s>, <s>luK</s> (deletion) and <s>kha</s>, as well.
5.01.056 [In the sense of] 'that is his share, price, or wages.'
5.01.057 [In the sense of] 'that is its measure.'
5.01.058 After a numeral, in the sense of a name, group, <s>sūtra</s>, or study.
5.01.059 <s>Paṅkti</s> (ten), <s>viṃśati</s> (twenty), <s>triṃśat</s> (thirty), <s>catvāriṃśat</s> (forty), <s>pañcāśat</s> (fifty), <s>ṣaṣṭi</s> (sixty), <s>saptati</s> (seventy), <s>aśīti</s> (eighty), <s>navati</s> (ninety), and <s>śata</s> (hundred).
5.01.060 <s>Pañca</s> (five) and <s>daśa</s> (ten), optionally, when referring to a group.
5.01.061 After <s>saptan</s> (seven), [the suffix] <s>aÑ</s>, in Vedic usage.
5.01.062 After <s>triṃśat</s> (thirty) and <s>catvāriṃśat</s> (forty), [the suffix] <s>ḌaÆ</s>, in a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> text, as a proper name.
5.01.063 [In the sense of] 'one who deserves that.'
5.01.064 After <s>cheda</s> (cutting) and similar words, [the suffix is] obligatory.
5.01.065 And after <s>śīrṣaccheda</s> (beheading), [the suffix] <s>yaT</s> also.
5.01.066 After <s>daṇḍa</s> (staff/punishment) and similar words.
5.01.067 And in Vedic usage.
5.01.068 And after <s>pātra</s> (vessel), [the suffix] <s>ghaN</s>.
5.01.069 And after <s>kaḍaṅkara</s> and <s>dakṣiṇa</s> (south/fee), [the suffix] <s>cha</s>.
5.01.070 After <s>sthālī</s> (cooking pot) and <s>bila</s> (hole).
5.01.071 After <s>yajña</s> (sacrifice) and <s>ṛtvij</s> (priest), [the suffixes] <s>gha</s> and <s>khaÑ</s>.
5.01.072 [In the sense of] 'one performs a <s>pārāyaṇa</s>, <s>turāyaṇa</s>, or <s>cāndrāyaṇa</s> [observance].'
5.01.073 [In the sense of] 'one who has fallen into doubt.'
5.01.074 [In the sense of] 'one who travels a <s>yojana</s> [distance].'
5.01.075 After <s>pathin</s> (road), [the suffix] <s>ṢkaN</s>.
5.01.076 [The suffix] <s>Ṇa</s> after <s>panthā</s> (road), obligatorily.
5.01.077 And [in the sense of] 'brought along the northern road.'
5.01.078 After [a word denoting] time.
5.01.079 [In the sense of] 'accomplished during that [time].'
5.01.080 [In the sense of] 'one who has presided over, maintained, summoned, or offered during that [time].'
5.01.081 After <s>māsa</s> (month), when referring to age, [the suffixes] <s>yaT</s> and <s>kha</s>.
5.01.082 In a <s>dvigo</s> (numeral) compound, [the suffix] <s>yaP</s>.
5.01.083 And after <s>ṣaṇmāsa</s> (six months), [the suffix] <s>ÆyaT</s>.
5.01.084 And [the suffix] <s>ṭhaN</s>, when not referring to age.
5.01.085 After <s>samā</s> (year), [the suffix] <s>kha</s>.
5.01.086 Optionally, in a <s>dvigo</s> (numeral) compound.
5.01.088 And after <s>varṣa</s> (year/rain), <s>luK</s> (deletion of the suffix).
5.01.089 [This is] obligatory when the derivative has the sense of a sentient being.
5.01.090 '[Grains] of sixty [days] ripen in a period of sixty nights.'
5.01.091 After [a word] ending in <s>vatsara</s> (year), [the suffix] <s>cha</s>, in Vedic usage.
5.01.092 And [the suffix] <s>kha</s> after [a stem] preceded by <s>sam</s> or <s>pari</s>.
5.01.093 [In the sense of] 'conquered, obtained, performed, or well done by means of that.'
5.01.094 [In the sense of] 'that is his <s>brahmacarya</s> (religious studentship).'
5.01.095 And [in the sense of] 'the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (fee) for that,' after words denoting a sacrifice.
5.01.096 And [in the sense of] 'it is given or done there.'
5.01.097 After <s>vyuṣṭa</s> (dawn) and similar words, [the suffix] <s>aÆ</s>.
5.01.098 After <s>yathā</s>, <s>kathā</s>, <s>ca</s>, and <s>hasta</s>, [the suffixes] <s>Ṇa</s> and <s>yaT</s>.
5.01.099 [In the sense of] 'productive' or 'yielding.'
5.01.101 [In the sense of] 'it is effective for that,' after <s>saṃtāpa</s> (distress) and similar words.
5.01.102 And after <s>yoga</s> (connection), [the suffix] <s>yaT</s>.
5.01.103 After <s>karman</s> (action), [the suffix] <s>ukaÑ</s>.
5.01.104 [In the sense of] 'the time—that has arrived for him.'
5.01.105 After <s>ṛtu</s> (season), [the suffix] <s>aÆ</s>.
5.01.106 In Vedic usage, [the suffix] <s>ghaS</s>.
5.01.107 After [a word denoting] time, [the suffix] <s>yaT</s>.
5.01.108 [The suffix] <s>ṭhaÑ</s> when the meaning is 'excellent.'
5.01.109 [In the sense of] 'purpose.'
5.01.110 After <s>viśākhā</s> and <s>aṣāḍha</s>, [the suffix] <s>aÆ</s>, in the sense of a churning stick or staff.
5.01.111 After <s>anupravacana</s> (recitation) and similar words, [the suffix] <s>cha</s>.
5.01.112 After [a word meaning] completion, together with its preceding compound member.
5.01.113 [The suffix] <s>aikāgārikaṬ</s>, in the sense of a thief.
5.01.114 [The suffix] <s>ākālikaṬ</s>, when expressing 'from beginning to end.'
5.01.115 [The suffix] <s>vati</s> is added if the meaning is 'an action similar to that.'
5.01.116 [In the sense of] 'as if it were his, in that place.'
5.01.117 [In the sense of] 'deserving that.'
5.01.118 After an <s>upasarga</s> (prefix), in Vedic usage, when the meaning of the verbal root is intended.
5.01.119 [In the sense of] 'the state of being that,' [the suffixes] <s>tva</s> and <s>taL</s> are added.
5.01.120 And [the suffix] <s>ā</s>, up to the section on <s>tva</s>.
5.01.121 Not after a <s>tatpuruṣa</s> compound preceded by <s>naÑ</s> (negation), except after <s>catura</s> (clever), <s>saṃgata</s> (united), <s>lavaṇa</s> (salt), <s>vaṭa</s> (fig tree), <s>yudha</s> (battle), <s>kata</s> (mat), <s>rasa</s> (taste), and <s>lasa</s> (playful).
5.01.122 After <s>pṛthu</s> (broad) and similar words, [the suffix] <s>imaniC</s>.
5.01.123 And after <s>varṇa</s> (color), <s>dṛḍha</s> (firm), and similar words, [the suffix] <s>ṢyaÑ</s>.
5.01.124 And after quality-denoting words, <s>brāhmaṇa</s>, and similar words, when the meaning involves action.
5.01.125 After <s>stena</s> (thief), [the suffix] <s>yaT</s>, and there is deletion of <s>na</s>.
5.01.126 After <s>sakhi</s> (friend), [the suffix] <s>ya</s>.
5.01.127 After <s>kapi</s> (monkey) and <s>jñāti</s> (kinsman), [the suffix] <s>ḍhaK</s>.
5.01.128 After compounds ending in <s>pati</s> (lord), <s>purohita</s> (priest), and similar words, [the suffix] <s>aK</s>.
5.01.129 After <s>prāṇabhṛt</s> (living being), <s>jāti</s> (birth), age-denoting words, <s>udgātṛ</s> (chanting priest), and similar words, [the suffix] <s>aÑ</s>.
5.01.131 And after stems ending in <s>iK</s> vowels preceded by a light syllable.
5.01.132 After stems with <s>ya</s> as the penultimate, when heavy or superlative, [the suffix] <s>uÑ</s>.
5.01.133 And after <s>dvandva</s> compounds, <s>manojña</s> (pleasing), and similar words.
5.01.134 After <s>gotra</s> (lineage) and <s>caraṇa</s> (Vedic school) names, in the senses of praise, excessive behavior, and knowledge of that.
5.01.135 After <s>hotrā</s> (priestly offices), [the suffix] <s>cha</s>.
5.01.136 After <s>brahman</s>, [the suffix] <s>tva</s>.
5.02.001 After names of grains, in the sense of a field where they grow, [the suffix] <s>khaÑ</s>.
5.02.002 After <s>vrīhi</s> (rice) and <s>śāli</s> (paddy), [the suffix] <s>ḍhaK</s>.
5.02.003 After <s>yava</s> (barley), <s>yavaka</s>, and <s>ṣaṣṭi</s>, [the suffix] <s>aT</s>.
5.02.004 Optionally, after <s>tila</s> (sesame), <s>māṣa</s> (bean), <s>umā</s> (flax), <s>bharṅga</s>, and <s>aṇu</s> (millet).
5.02.005 After <s>sarvacarman</s> (all-leather), in the sense of 'made of,' [the suffixes] <s>kha</s> and <s>khaÑ</s>.
5.02.006 [The suffix] <s>kha</s> in the sense of seeing face-to-face.
5.02.008 [In the sense of] 'reaching up to the tip of the foot.'
5.02.009 In the senses of following step by step, all food, going, not going, being bound, eating, and leading.
5.02.010 [In the sense of] 'one experiences succession of higher and lower, one after another, sons and grandsons.'
5.02.011 [In the sense of] 'one who goes to this shore, the far shore, to the end, in sequence.'
5.02.012 [In the sense of] 'born year after year.'
5.02.013 [In the sense of] 'relating to today-and-tomorrow,' when firmly established.
5.02.014 [The word] <s>āgavīna</s> is formed similarly.
5.02.015 [In the sense of] 'going after cows' or 'going sufficiently.'
5.02.016 After <s>adhvan</s> (road/journey), [the suffixes] <s>yaT</s> and <s>kha</s>.
5.02.017 And after <s>abhyamitra</s> (facing the enemy), [the suffix] <s>cha</s>.
5.02.018 After <s>goṣṭha</s> (cow-pen), [the suffix] <s>khaÑ</s>, when referring to something that previously existed.
5.02.019 [In the sense of] 'a horse's one-day journey.'
5.02.020 [The words] <s>śālīna</s> (modest) and <s>kaupīna</s> (loincloth) are used for one who is unexcited and ignoble, respectively.
5.02.021 [In the sense of] 'one who lives by a guild.'
5.02.022 'Friendship established by taking seven steps together.'
5.02.023 [The word] <s>haiyaṃgavīna</s> (fresh butter) is formed as a proper name.
5.02.024 In the sense of the cooked root of that, after <s>pīlu</s> and words of the <s>adikarṇa</s> class, [the suffixes] <s>kuṇaP</s> and <s>jāhaC</s>.
5.02.025 After <s>pakṣa</s> (wing/side), [the suffix] <s>ti</s>.
5.02.026 [In the sense of] 'known by that,' [the suffixes] <s>cuñcuP</s> and <s>caṇaP</s>.
5.02.027 After <s>vi</s> and <s>naÑ</s> (negation), [the suffixes] <s>nā</s> and <s>nāÑ</s>, in the sense of 'not together.'
5.02.028 After <s>vi</s>, [the suffixes] <s>śālaC</s> and <s>śarkaṭaC</s>.
5.02.029 And after <s>sam</s>, <s>pra</s>, and <s>ud</s>, [the suffix] <s>kaṭaC</s>.
5.02.030 And after <s>ava</s>, [the suffix] <s>kuṭāraC</s>.
5.02.031 When the nose is bent, as a proper name, [the suffixes] <s>ṭīṭaC</s>, <s>nāṭaC</s>, and <s>bhrāṭaC</s>.
5.02.032 After <s>ni</s>, [the suffixes] <s>biḍaC</s> and <s>birīsaC</s>.
5.02.033 And [the suffixes] <s>inaC</s>, <s>piṭaC</s>, <s>cika</s>, and <s>ci</s>.
5.02.034 After <s>upa</s> and <s>adhi</s>, [the suffix] <s>tyakaN</s>, in the senses of proximity and marriage.
5.02.035 In the sense of action, [the word] <s>ghaṭa</s> takes the suffix <s>aṭhaC</s>.
5.02.036 [In the sense of] 'that has arisen for him,' after <s>tārakā</s> (star) and similar words, [the suffix] <s>itaC</s>.
5.02.037 In the sense of measure, [the suffixes] <s>dvayasaC</s>, <s>daghnaC</s>, and <s>mātraC</s>.
5.02.038 And after <s>puruṣa</s> (person) and <s>hastin</s> (elephant), [the suffix] <s>aÆ</s>.
5.02.039 After <s>yad</s> (which), <s>tad</s> (that), and <s>etad</s> (this), in the sense of measure, [the suffix] <s>vatUP</s>.
5.02.040 After <s>kim</s> (what) and <s>idam</s> (this), [the suffixes] <s>va</s> and <s>gha</s>.
5.02.041 And after <s>kim</s>, in the sense of counting or measuring, [the suffix] <s>Ḍati</s>.
5.02.042 After a numeral, in the sense of a fraction, [the suffix] <s>tayaP</s>.
5.02.043 After <s>dvi</s> (two) and <s>tri</s> (three), [the suffixes] <s>taya</s>, <s>ya</s>, and <s>yaC</s>, optionally.
5.02.044 After <s>ubha</s> (both), the accent is <s>udātta</s>, obligatorily.
5.02.045 [In the sense of] 'that is in excess of this,' after numerals ending in <s>daśa</s> (ten), [the suffix] <s>Ḍa</s>.
5.02.046 And after numerals ending in <s>śata</s> (hundred) and <s>viṃśati</s> (twenty).
5.02.047 After a numeral, in the sense of measuring a quality, [the suffix] <s>mayaṬ</s>.
5.02.048 In the sense of the ordinal of that, [the suffix] <s>ḌaṬ</s>.
5.02.049 Not after stems ending in a numeral that does not begin with a number, [the suffix] <s>maṬ</s>.
5.02.050 And [the suffix] <s>thaṬ</s>, in Vedic usage.

5.04.001 After a numeral compound denoting a hundred <s>pādas</s> (feet/verses), in the sense of repetition, [the suffix] <s>vuN</s>, and there is deletion.
5.04.002 And in the senses of punishment and release.
5.04.003 After <s>sthūla</s> (thick) and similar words, in the sense of manner/kind, [the suffix] <s>kaN</s>.
5.04.004 After a word with suffix <s>kta</s>, when the meaning is not gone to the extreme.
5.04.005 Not in the sense of 'partially.'
5.04.006 After <s>bṛhatī</s> (a meter), in the sense of covering.
5.04.007 The suffix <s>kha</s> after compounds not having <s>ṣaḍakṣa</s>, <s>āśitaṃgu</s>, <s>alaṃkarman</s>, <s>alampuruṣa</s>, or <s>adhi</s> as the latter member.
5.04.008 Optionally, after <s>añc</s>, when not referring to a direction or woman.
5.04.009 After a compound ending in a caste name, [the suffix] <s>cha</s>, in the sense of a kinsman.
5.04.010 After a compound ending in <s>sthāna</s> (place), optionally, if the meaning is 'together with the place.'
5.04.011 After <s>kim</s> (what), <s>eT</s>, verbal endings, indeclinables, <s>GHĀ</s>, and <s>āmu</s>, when not referring to a substance or limb.
5.04.012 And after <s>amu</s>, in Vedic usage.
5.04.013 After <s>anugādin</s> (one who echoes), [the suffix] <s>ṭhaK</s>.
5.04.014 After a stem with suffix <s>ṆaC</s>, in the feminine, [the suffix] <s>aÑ</s>.
5.04.015 The suffix <s>aÆ</s> after suffix <s>inuÆ</s>.
5.04.016 After <s>visārin</s> (spreading), when referring to fish.
5.04.017 After a numeral, in the sense of repetition of action or counting, [the suffix] <s>kṛtvasuC</s>.
5.04.018 After <s>dvi</s> (two), <s>tri</s> (three), and <s>catur</s> (four), [the suffix] <s>suC</s>.
5.04.019 And for <s>eka</s> (one), the form <s>sakṛt</s> (once).
5.04.020 Optionally, after <s>bahu</s> (many), the suffix <s>dhā</s>, when referring to a remote time.
5.04.021 In the sense of 'made of that,' [the suffix] <s>mayaṬ</s>.
5.04.022 And with the meaning 'like a collection,' when there are many.
5.04.023 After <s>ananta</s> (endless), <s>āvasatha</s> (dwelling), <s>itiha</s> (tradition), and <s>bheṣaja</s> (medicine), [the suffix] <s>Ñya</s>.
5.04.024 After a compound ending in <s>devatā</s> (deity), in the sense of 'for that purpose,' [the suffix] <s>yaT</s>.
5.04.025 And after <s>pāda</s> (foot) and <s>argha</s> (value).
5.04.026 After <s>atithi</s> (guest), [the suffix] <s>Ñya</s>.
5.04.027 After <s>deva</s> (god), [the suffix] <s>taL</s>.
5.04.028 After <s>avi</s> (sheep), [the suffix] <s>ka</s>.
5.04.029 After <s>yāva</s> and similar words, [the suffix] <s>kaN</s>.
5.04.030 After <s>lohita</s> (red), when referring to a gem.
5.04.031 And in reference to color, when not permanent.
5.04.032 In the sense of 'colored/dyed.'
5.04.033 And after a word denoting time.
5.04.034 After <s>vinaya</s> (discipline) and similar words, [the suffix] <s>ṭhaK</s>.
5.04.035 After <s>vāc</s> (speech), in the sense of 'uttered speech.'
5.04.036 After <s>karman</s> (action) connected with that, [the suffix] <s>aÆ</s>.
5.04.037 After <s>oṣadhi</s> (plant/herb), when not yet grown.
5.04.038 And after <s>prajña</s> (wise) and similar words.
5.04.039 After <s>mṛd</s> (clay/earth), [the suffix] <s>tikaN</s>.
5.04.040 When with a bath, in the sense of praise.
5.04.041 And after <s>vṛka</s> (wolf) and <s>jyeṣṭha</s> (eldest), [the suffixes] <s>tiL</s> and <s>tātiL</s>, in Vedic usage.
5.04.042 After a word meaning 'many' or 'few,' [the suffix] <s>śas</s>, after a case-marked word, optionally.
5.04.043 And after a numeral in the singular, in the sense of distribution.
5.04.044 In the sense of opposition, after a stem in the fifth case (ablative), [the suffix] <s>tasi</s>.
5.04.045 And in the sense of taking away, but not after the roots <s>hīya</s> and <s>ruh</s>.
5.04.046 In the senses of excessive seizure, not-paining, and abuse, after a stem in the third case (instrumental), when the referent is not the agent.
5.04.047 And after a word connected with deterioration or sin.
5.04.048 After a stem in the sixth case (genitive), in the sense of dependence.
5.04.049 And after <s>roga</s> (disease), in the sense of removal.
5.04.050 The suffix <s>Cvi</s> is added when there is a connection with the roots <s>kṛ</s> (do), <s>bhū</s> (become), or <s>as</s> (be), when the subject attains a state, as the agent.
5.04.051 And for <s>arus</s> (wound), <s>manas</s> (mind), <s>cakṣus</s> (eye), <s>cetas</s> (thought), <s>rahas</s> (secret), and <s>rajas</s> (dust), there is deletion.
5.04.052 Optionally, the suffix <s>sāti</s>, in the sense of completeness.
5.04.053 And in the sense of pervasion and attainment.
5.04.054 In the sense of 'dependent on that.'
5.04.055 And the suffix <s>trā</s>, in the sense of 'to be given.'
5.04.056 After <s>deva</s> (god), <s>manuṣya</s> (human), <s>puruṣa</s> (person), <s>puru</s>, and <s>martya</s> (mortal), in the senses of the second case (accusative) and attainment, frequently.
5.04.057 After an onomatopoeic word, excluding those with <s>vi</s>, <s>aC</s>, <s>vara</s>, or <s>ardha</s>, when the meaning is 'not going,' [the suffix] <s>ḌāC</s>.
5.04.058 After the root <s>kṛ</s> (do), with stems meaning second, third, <s>śamba</s> (a crop), or <s>bīja</s> (seed), in the sense of plowing.
5.04.059 After a numeral compound ending in a quality word.
5.04.060 And after <s>samaya</s> (agreement), in the sense of sustaining.
5.04.061 After <s>sapattra</s> (with leaves) and <s>niṣpattra</s> (without leaves), in the sense of effort.
5.04.062 After <s>niṣkula</s> (without family), in the sense of stripping.
5.04.063 After <s>sukha</s> (pleasant) and <s>priya</s> (dear), in the sense of conformity.
5.04.064 After <s>duḥkha</s> (painful), in the sense of opposition.
5.04.065 After <s>śūla</s> (stake/spit), in the sense of cooking.
5.04.066 After <s>satya</s> (truth), when not an oath.
5.04.067 After <s>madra</s>, in the sense of shaving around.
5.04.068 These suffixes come at the end of compounds.
5.04.069 Not after a word meaning honor.
5.04.070 After <s>kim</s> (what), in the sense of contempt.
5.04.071 After a <s>tatpuruṣa</s> compound with <s>naÑ</s> (negation).
5.04.072 After <s>pathin</s> (path), optionally.
5.04.073 In a <s>bahuvrīhi</s> compound, after a countable word, [the suffix] <s>ḌaC</s>, when not meaning 'many' or 'group.'
5.04.074 For <s>ṛc</s> (verse), <s>pur</s> (city), <s>ap</s> (water), <s>dur</s> (door), and <s>pathin</s> (path), the replacement is the <s>a</s>-stem form, when not before suffix <s>akṣa</s>.
5.04.076 After <s>akṣan</s> (eye), when the meaning is 'not seeing.'
5.04.077 [Lists numerous irregular compound forms with their special stem replacements in <s>bahuvrīhi</s> compounds.]
5.04.079 After <s>ava</s>, <s>sam</s>, and <s>andha</s>, the special form is used for <s>tamas</s> (darkness).
5.04.080 After <s>śvas</s> (tomorrow), the forms <s>vasīyas</s> (better) and <s>śreyas</s> (superior).
5.04.081 After compounds with <s>anu</s> and <s>avatapta</s> (heated), the special form is used for <s>rahas</s> (solitude).
5.04.082 After <s>prati</s>, the special form is used for <s>uras</s> (chest), when in the locative sense.
5.04.083 The word <s>anugavam</s>, in the sense of extent.
5.04.084 The words <s>dvistāvā</s> and <s>tristāvā</s> refer to the altar (<s>vedi</s>) of double or triple measure.
5.04.085 After a prefix, the special form is used for <s>adhvan</s> (road).
5.04.086 In a <s>tatpuruṣa</s> compound, the special form is used for <s>aṅguli</s> (finger), after a numeral or indeclinable.
5.04.087 And the special form is used for <s>rātri</s> (night), after <s>ahan</s> (day), <s>sarva</s> (all), <s>ekadeśa</s> (a part), a numeral, <s>ta</s>, and <s>puṇya</s> (meritorious).
5.04.088 The forms <s>ahna</s> and <s>ahna</s>, after these words, for <s>ahan</s> (day).
5.04.089 Not after a numeral-initial compound, in the sense of a collective.
5.04.090 And after <s>uttama</s> (best) and <s>ekā</s> (one).
5.04.092 For <s>go</s> (cow), the special form is used when not having undergone <s>luK</s> (deletion) of a <s>taddhita</s> suffix.
5.04.093 For <s>uras</s> (chest), in the sense of a chief designation.
5.04.095 And after <s>grāma</s> (village) and <s>kauṭa</s>, the special form is used for <s>takṣan</s> (carpenter).
5.04.096 After <s>ata</s>, the special form is used for <s>śvan</s> (dog).
5.04.097 After a word denoting comparison, when not referring to living beings.
5.04.098 And after <s>uttara</s> (upper), <s>mṛga</s> (deer), and <s>ūru</s>, the special form is used for <s>sakthi</s> (thigh).
5.04.099 For <s>nau</s> (boat), in a <s>dvigo</s> (numeral) compound.
5.04.100 And after <s>ardha</s> (half).
5.04.101 For <s>khārī</s> (a measure), in the eastern dialect.
5.04.102 After <s>dvi</s> (two) and <s>tri</s> (three), the special form is used for <s>añjali</s> (cupped hands).
5.04.103 After a neuter stem ending in <s>anas</s>, in Vedic usage.
5.04.104 For <s>brahman</s>, in a regional designation.
5.04.105 After <s>ku</s> (bad) and <s>mahat</s> (great), optionally.
5.04.106 After a <s>dvandva</s> compound ending in <s>cU</s>, <s>da</s>, <s>ṣa</s>, or <s>ha</s>, in the sense of a collective.
5.04.107 In an <s>avyayībhāva</s> compound, after <s>śarad</s> (autumn), <s>ṛ</s>, and <s>bhṛti</s>.
5.04.108 And after stems ending in <s>anas</s>.
5.04.109 After a neuter stem, optionally.
5.04.110 After <s>nadī</s> (river), <s>paurṇamāsī</s> (full moon), and <s>āgrāyaṇī</s>.
5.04.111 After a stem ending in <s>jhaY</s> consonants.
5.04.112 And for <s>giri</s> (mountain), in the compound of <s>senaka</s>.
5.04.113 In a <s>bahuvrīhi</s> compound, for <s>sakthi</s> (thigh) and <s>akṣan</s> (eye), after <s>sva</s> (own) and <s>aṅga</s> (limb), [the suffix] <s>ṢaC</s>.
5.04.114 After <s>aṅguli</s> (finger), when made of wood.
5.04.115 After <s>dvi</s> (two) and <s>tri</s> (three), [the suffix] <s>Ṣa</s>, for <s>mūrdhan</s> (head).
5.04.116 The suffix <s>aP</s> in the senses of ordinal and measure.
5.04.117 And after <s>antar</s> (inside) and <s>bahis</s> (outside), for <s>loman</s> (hair).
5.04.118 The suffix <s>aC</s> after <s>nāsikā</s> (nose), in a proper name, and the replacement <s>nas</s>, when not meaning 'thick.'
5.04.119 And after a prefix.
5.04.120 [Irregular compound forms:] <s>suprāta</s>, <s>suśva</s>, <s>sudiva</s>, <s>śārikukṣa</s>, <s>caturaśra</s>, <s>eṇīpada</s>, <s>ajapada</s>, <s>proṣṭhapada</s>, and others.
5.04.121 After <s>naÑ</s> (negation), <s>dus</s> (bad), and <s>su</s> (good), for <s>hali</s> and <s>sakthi</s> (thigh), optionally.
5.04.122 Obligatorily, the suffix <s>asiC</s> for <s>prajā</s> (progeny) and <s>medhā</s> (sacrifice/intellect).
5.04.123 The form <s>bahuprajāḥ</s>, in Vedic usage.
5.04.124 After <s>dharma</s> (duty/law) alone, the suffix <s>aniC</s>.
5.04.125 The form <s>jambhā</s>, after <s>suharita</s>, <s>tṛṇa</s> (grass), and <s>soma</s>.
5.04.126 The form <s>dakṣiṇermā</s>, in connection with greed.
5.04.127 The suffix <s>iC</s>, in the sense of reciprocal action.
5.04.128 And after <s>dvidaṇḍin</s> (one with two staffs) and similar words.
5.04.129 After prefixes <s>pra</s> and <s>sam</s>, for <s>jānu</s> (knee), the replacement <s>jñu</s>.
5.04.130 After <s>ūrdhva</s> (upward), optionally.
5.04.131 For <s>ūdhas</s> (udder), the suffix <s>anaṄ</s>.
5.04.132 And for <s>dhanus</s> (bow).
5.04.133 Optionally, in a proper name.
5.04.134 For <s>jāyā</s> (wife), the suffix <s>niṄ</s>.
5.04.135 For <s>gandha</s> (smell), the augment <s>iṬ</s>, after <s>ud</s>, <s>pūti</s> (foul), <s>su</s> (good), and <s>surabhi</s> (fragrant).
5.04.136 In the sense of a minor designation.
5.04.137 And after a word of comparison.
5.04.139 And in the senses of <s>kumbha</s> (pot) and <s>pada</s> (foot).
5.04.140 For a word preceded by a numeral and <s>su</s> (good).
5.04.141 For <s>danta</s> (tooth), in the sense of age, the replacement <s>dat</s>.
5.04.142 And in Vedic usage.
5.04.143 In reference to a woman, in a proper name.
5.04.144 Optionally, after <s>śyāva</s> (brown) and <s>arokā</s>.
5.04.145 And after <s>agra</s> (tip), <s>anta</s> (end), <s>śuddha</s> (pure), <s>śubhra</s> (bright), <s>vṛṣa</s> (bull), and <s>varāha</s> (boar).
5.04.146 For <s>kakuda</s> (hump/peak), in the sense of a condition, there is deletion.
5.04.147 The form <s>trikakud</s>, when referring to a mountain.
5.04.148 After prefixes <s>ud</s> and <s>vi</s>, for <s>kākuda</s> (relating to the hump).
5.04.149 After <s>pūrṇa</s> (full), optionally.
5.04.150 The forms <s>suhṛd</s> (friend) and <s>durhṛd</s> (enemy), for <s>mitra</s> (friend) and <s>amitra</s> (enemy).
5.04.151 After <s>uras</s> (chest) and similar words, [the suffix] <s>kaP</s>.
5.04.152 After a stem ending in suffix <s>in</s>, in the feminine.
5.04.153 And after <s>nadī</s> (river) stems and stems ending in <s>ṛṬ</s>.
5.04.154 After the remainder, optionally.
5.04.155 Not in a proper name.
5.04.156 And after stems ending in the comparative suffix <s>īyas</s>.
5.04.157 For <s>bhrātṛ</s> (brother), when greeted.
5.04.158 After stems ending in <s>ṛṬ</s>, in Vedic usage.
5.04.159 For <s>nāḍī</s> (tube/vein) and <s>tantrī</s> (string), when referring to one's own body.
5.04.160 And the form <s>niṣpravāṇi</s>.

6.04.156 sthūla-dūra-yuva(n)=hrasva-kṣip-ra-kṣudrā-ṇ-āṃ yaṆ=ādi param pūrva-sya ca guṇa-ḥ
6.04.157 priy-a-sthi-ra-sphi-ra-uru-bahu-la-guru-vṛd-dha-tṛp-ra-dīrgha-vṛndārakā-ṇ-ām pra-stha-spha-var-baṃhi-gar-varṣi-trap-drāghi-vṛnd-ā-ḥ
6.04.158 baho-r lopa-ḥ=bhū ca baho-ḥ
6.04.159 iṣṭha-sya yiṬ ca
6.04.160 jy-āt=āt=īyas-aḥ
6.04.161 ra ṛT=aḥ=haL-āde-r lagho-ḥ
6.04.162 vibhāṣā=ṛj-os=chandas-i
6.04.163 pra-kṛ-ty-ā eka=aC
6.04.164 in aṆ-i=an-apaty-e
6.04.165 gāth-i(n)=vidath-i(n)=keś-i(n)-gaṇ-i(n)=paṇ-in-as=ca
6.04.166 saṃ-yog-a=ādi-s=ca
6.04.167 an

6.04.169 ātma(n)=adh-vān-au kh-e

6.04.171 brāhm-a-ḥ=a-jā-t-au

6.04.173 aukṣ-a-m an-apty-e
