body.translated_text:
6.01.001 The first [syllable] of a monosyllabic [vowel-initial word] is doubled [in reduplication]
6.01.002 The second [syllable] from the beginning of a vowel-initial [root is reduplicated]
6.01.003 [Clusters beginning with] <s>na</s>, <s>ṅa</s>, <s>da</s>, <s>ra</s> [and the like] are the initial [consonants of conjuncts for reduplication purposes]
6.01.004 The former [syllable] is the <s>abhyāsa</s> (reduplicative syllable)
6.01.005 Both [syllables] together constitute the <s>abhyasta</s> (reduplicated form)
6.01.006 [The roots] <s>jakṣ</s> and the following six [are treated as reduplicated already]
6.01.007 For [the roots] beginning with <s>tuj</s>, the <s>abhyāsa</s> (reduplicative syllable) is long
6.01.008 [The <s>abhyāsa</s> is long] for the non-reduplicated portion of a root in <s>lIṬ</s> (perfect tense)
6.01.009 [And also in] <s>saN</s> (desiderative) and <s>yaṄ</s> (intensive)
6.01.010 [And also in] <s>Śl</s> (the class marker of the second conjugation)
6.01.011 [And also in] <s>CaṄ</s> (the causative marker)
6.01.012 [The forms] <s>dāśvān</s>, <s>sāhvān</s>, <s>mīḍhvān</s> also [have long <s>abhyāsa</s>]
6.01.013 The <s>samprasāraṇa</s> (vowel substitution for semivowels) of [a root followed by] <s>ṢyaṄ</s> [occurs] in a <s>tatpuruṣa</s> compound with <s>putra</s> and <s>pati</s>
6.01.014 [And also] with <s>bandhu</s> in a <s>bahuvrīhi</s> compound
6.01.015 [<s>samprasāraṇa</s> occurs] for [the roots] <s>vac</s>, <s>svap</s>, <s>yaj</s>, and the rest before a <s>KIT</s> [suffix]
6.01.016 [And also] for [the roots] <s>grah</s>, <s>jyā</s>, <s>vay</s>, <s>vyadh</s>, <s>vaṣ</s>, <s>vic</s>, <s>vṛśc</s>, <s>praśch</s>, <s>bhṛjj</s> [also] before a <s>ṄIT</s> [suffix]
6.01.017 [The <s>samprasāraṇa</s>] of the <s>abhyāsa</s> [occurs] for both [kinds of roots] in <s>lIṬ</s> (perfect)
6.01.018 [<s>samprasāraṇa</s>] of <s>svāp</s> [occurs] in <s>CaṄ</s> (causative)
6.01.019 [<s>samprasāraṇa</s> occurs] for <s>svap</s>, <s>syam</s>, <s>vyeÑ</s> before <s>yaṄ</s> (intensive)
6.01.020 Not for <s>vaś</s> [before <s>yaṄ</s>]
6.01.021 [For] <s>cāy</s>, [the <s>samprasāraṇa</s> is] <s>kī</s>
6.01.022 [For] <s>sphāy</s>, [the <s>samprasāraṇa</s> is] <s>sphī</s> before <s>niṣṭhā</s> (past passive participle suffix)
6.01.023 [For] <s>sty</s> preceded by <s>pra</s>
6.01.024 [For] <s>śy</s> [the <s>samprasāraṇa</s> of] substances in liquid or solid form and contact
6.01.025 And [also] after <s>prati</s>
6.01.026 Optionally, [for that] preceded by <s>abhi</s> or <s>ava</s>
6.01.027 [The form] <s>śṛta</s> [is used] in cooking
6.01.028 [For] <s>pyāy</s>, [the <s>samprasāraṇa</s> is] <s>pī</s>
6.01.029 [And also] in <s>lIṬ</s> (perfect) and <s>yaṄ</s> (intensive)
6.01.030 Optionally for <s>śve</s>
6.01.031 And also in <s>Ṇau</s> (causative) before <s>saN</s> (desiderative) and <s>CaṄ</s> (causative)
6.01.032 [For] <s>hv</s>, [the result of] <s>samprasāraṇa</s> [is <s>u</s>]
6.01.033 And also for the <s>abhyasta</s> (reduplicated form)
6.01.034 Variously in the <s>chandas</s> (Vedic)
6.01.035 [For] <s>cāy</s>, [the <s>samprasāraṇa</s> is] <s>kī</s>
6.01.036 [The forms] <s>apaspṛdhethām</s>, <s>ānṛcus</s>, <s>ānṛhus</s>, <s>cicyuṣe</s>, <s>tityāja</s>, <s>śrātāḥ</s>, <s>śritam</s>, <s>āśīrtaḥ</s> [are exceptional forms attested in the tradition]
6.01.037 <s>samprasāraṇa</s> does not [occur] upon <s>samprasāraṇa</s>
6.01.038 [For] <s>vay</s>, [the <s>samprasāraṇa</s> in] <s>lIṬ</s> (perfect) is <s>y</s>
6.01.039 And also [the form] <s>vas</s> of this [root] optionally before a <s>KIT</s> [suffix]
6.01.040 [And also] <s>veÑ</s>
6.01.041 And also before <s>LyaP</s> (absolutive suffix)
6.01.042 And also [for] <s>jy</s>
6.01.043 And also [for] <s>vy</s>
6.01.044 Optionally [for] <s>par</s>
6.01.045 <s>āṬ</s> [is augmented] before <s>eC</s>-initial [suffixes] in the teaching [of roots] not marked with <s>ŚIT</s>
6.01.046 Not [so] for <s>vy</s> in <s>lIṬ</s> (perfect)
6.01.047 [The substitute is] before <s>GHaÑ</s> for [the roots] <s>sphur</s> and <s>sphul</s>
6.01.048 [<s>samprasāraṇa</s>] in the causative <s>Ṇau</s> for [the roots] <s>krī</s>, <s>iṄ</s>, <s>jī</s>
6.01.049 [And also] for <s>sidhyate</s> in the non-transcendental [sense]
6.01.050 And also before <s>LyaP</s> for [the roots] <s>mī</s>, <s>nā</s>, <s>ti</s>, <s>mi</s>, <s>no</s>, <s>ti</s>, <s>dīṄ</s>
6.01.051 Optionally for <s>līyate</s>
6.01.052 [And also] for <s>khid</s> in the <s>chandas</s> (Vedic)
6.01.053 [And also] for <s>apagur</s> before <s>ṆamuL</s>
6.01.054 [And also] in the causative for [the roots] <s>ci</s> and <s>sphur</s>
6.01.055 [And also] for <s>vīyate</s> in the sense of procreation
6.01.056 [And also] for <s>bibheti</s> when the cause is fear
6.01.057 Always for <s>smayate</s>
6.01.058 For [the roots] <s>sṛj</s> and <s>dṛś</s>, [the augment <s>aM</s>] before <s>jhaL</s> [not marked] <s>KIT</s>
6.01.059 And optionally for the [root with] <s>anudātta</s> (unaccented) [vowel] having <s>ṛ</s> as the penultimate
6.01.060 [The word] <s>śīrṣan</s> in the <s>chandas</s> (Vedic)
6.01.061 And also [the final consonant is retained] before a <s>taddhita</s> (secondary) suffix
6.01.062 [<s>śīrṣa</s> occurs] before vowels
6.01.063 [The stems] <s>pad</s>, <s>dat</s>, <s>nas</s>, <s>māṣ</s>, <s>hṛd</s>, <s>niś</s>, <s>asan</s>, <s>yūṣan</s>, <s>doṣan</s>, <s>yakan</s>, <s>śakan</s>, <s>udan</s>, <s>āsan</s> [retain their full form] beginning from <s>Śas</s> [case ending] onward
6.01.064 The initial <s>ṣ</s> of a root becomes <s>s</s>
6.01.065 [Initial] <s>ṇ</s> becomes <s>n</s>
6.01.066 [The final] <s>v</s> and <s>y</s> are dropped before a <s>vaL</s> consonant
6.01.067 [The final] <s>ver</s> [is dropped] when unpaired [i.e., alone]
6.01.068 A consonant [in] <s>sU</s>, <s>ti</s>, <s>si</s> [case endings] that is unattached to a vowel and follows a long [vowel] after <s>haL</s> (consonant), <s>Ṅī</s>, <s>āP</s> — [is dropped]
6.01.069 [The <s>sU</s> ending is dropped] after a short <s>eṄ</s> vowel in the vocative (<s>saṃbuddhi</s>)
6.01.070 [The <s>Śes</s> ending is dropped] variously in the <s>chandas</s>
6.01.071 The augment <s>tuK</s> [is inserted] before a <s>PIT</s> <s>kṛt</s> (primary) suffix after a short [vowel]
6.01.072 [This applies] in <s>saṃhitā</s> (continuous speech)
6.01.073 And also before <s>ch</s>
6.01.074 And also before <s>āṄ</s> and <s>māṄ</s>
6.01.075 [And also] after a long [vowel]
6.01.076 And optionally after a word-final [vowel]
6.01.077 <s>iK</s> vowels become <s>yaṆ</s> (semivowels) before a vowel
6.01.078 <s>eC</s> vowels become <s>ay</s>, <s>av</s>, <s>āy</s>, <s>āv</s> [respectively]
6.01.079 [A word] ending in <s>va</s> [becomes <s>u</s>] before a suffix beginning with <s>y</s>
6.01.080 [This applies] only for the root itself, not for what comes about because of it
6.01.081 [The forms] <s>kṣayya</s> and <s>jayya</s> [are used] in the sense of what is possible
6.01.082 [The form] <s>krayya</s> [is used] in that same sense
6.01.083 [The form] <s>bhayya</s> [and] <s>pravayye</s> also in the <s>chandas</s> (Vedic)
6.01.084 One [phoneme] replaces both the preceding and following [phonemes]
6.01.085 And it has the properties of both the initial and final [elements]
6.01.086 <s>ṣatva</s> (the change to <s>ṣ</s>) and <s>tuK</s> are not operative [with respect to each other]
6.01.087 [After] <s>āt</s> [comes] <s>guṇa</s> (the <s>guṇa</s> substitution)
6.01.088 <s>vṛddhi</s> [occurs] before <s>eC</s> vowels
6.01.089 [<s>vṛddhi</s> occurs] before <s>e</s>, <s>edha</s>, and <s>ūṬH</s>
6.01.090 And also after <s>āṬ</s>
6.01.091 [<s>vṛddhi</s> occurs] after a prefix before an <s>ṛT</s>-initial root
6.01.092 Optionally [this applies also] with <s>suP</s> according to <s>Āpiśali</s>
6.01.093 [The <s>ā</s>] of <s>oṬ</s> becomes [something else] before <s>am</s> and <s>Śas</s>
6.01.094 Before <s>eṄ</s>, [there is] identity with the following [sound — <s>pararūpa</s>]
6.01.095 And also before <s>om</s> and <s>āṄ</s>
6.01.096 Before <s>us</s>, not at the end of a <s>pada</s>
6.01.097 [After] <s>aṬ</s>, [there is] <s>guṇa</s>
6.01.098 [The augment <s>āṬ</s>] of an indistinct imitative sound ending in <s>a</s> [occurs] before <s>it</s>
6.01.099 But optionally [not] the final [syllable] of an <s>āmreḍita</s> (repeated word)
6.01.100 Always in the <s>āmreḍita</s> before <s>ḌāC</s>
6.01.101 An <s>aK</s> vowel before a homogeneous [vowel] becomes long
6.01.102 Before the first [of two homogeneous vowels], [the result is] the homogeneous sound of the preceding [vowel]
6.01.103 Thence, <s>Śas</s> [ending] becomes <s>n</s> in the masculine
6.01.104 Not after <s>ā</s> before an <s>iC</s> vowel
6.01.105 And also before <s>Jas</s> after a long [vowel]
6.01.106 Optionally in the <s>chandas</s>
6.01.107 [The preceding phoneme is the substitute] before <s>am</s>
6.01.108 And also after <s>samprasāraṇa</s>
6.01.109 A final <s>eṄ</s> of a <s>pada</s> (word) [becomes a semivowel] before an <s>aṬ</s> vowel
6.01.110 And also before <s>ṄasI</s> and <s>Ṅas</s>
6.01.111 [After] <s>ṛT</s> [comes] <s>uT</s>
6.01.112 [The change applies] to the following [phoneme] after <s>khyāti</s>6.01.113 [After] <s>aṬ</s>, before <s>rO</s>, not when pluta (protracted), and not in a pluta [context]
6.01.114 And also before <s>haŚ</s> [consonants]
6.01.115 The interior of a <s>pāda</s> [verse foot] is treated as its natural form when not followed by a vowel
6.01.116 [The natural form is maintained in the words] <s>avyāt</s>, <s>avadyāt</s>, <s>avakramus</s>, <s>avrata</s>, <s>ayam</s>, <s>avantu</s>, <s>avasyu</s>
6.01.117 [And the word] <s>uraḥ</s> in the <s>Yajus</s> (Yajurveda)
6.01.118 [And the words] <s>āpo</s>, <s>jusāṇo</s>, <s>vṛṣṇo</s>, <s>varṣiṣṭhe</s>, <s>ambe</s>, <s>ambāle</s>, <s>ambike</s> [in compounds] where these are the prior member
6.01.119 And also [words beginning with] <s>aṅga</s> etc.
6.01.120 And also [words with] <s>anudātta</s> (unaccented) [vowel] when followed by <s>kU</s> (guttural) or <s>dha</s>
6.01.121 And also in <s>avapathās</s>
6.01.122 Everywhere optionally for <s>go</s> (cow)
6.01.123 [The form] <s>avaṄ</s> [is the view of] <s>Sphoṭāyana</s>
6.01.124 Before <s>Indra</s> [it is] always [so]
6.01.125 <s>pluta</s> (protracted) [vowels] and <s>pragṛhya</s> (exempt from sandhi) [vowels] always [remain unchanged] before a vowel
6.01.126 The <s>āṄ</s> [class vowel] becomes nasal in the <s>chandas</s> (Vedic)
6.01.127 According to <s>Śākalya</s>, an <s>iK</s> vowel before a non-homogeneous [vowel becomes a semivowel and] also [becomes] short
6.01.128 An <s>aK</s> vowel before <s>ṛT</s>
6.01.129 [The vowels remain] as if not protracted when [the following word] is present
6.01.130 [The vowel is] <s>ī3</s> (long <s>ī</s> with pluta) according to <s>Cākravarmaṇa</s>
6.01.131 [The word] <s>div</s> [becomes] <s>uT</s>
6.01.132 The <s>sU</s> ending is dropped after <s>etad</s> and <s>tad</s> before <s>ak</s> [i.e., not at word boundary], not in a compound with <s>naÑ</s>, and before a <s>haL</s> consonant
6.01.133 [The <s>sU</s> ending of] <s>syas</s> variously in the <s>chandas</s>
6.01.134 [When] <s>sas</s> is elided before a vowel, it is [done] for the sake of completing the <s>pāda</s> (verse foot)
6.01.135 The augment <s>suṬ</s> comes before [a word beginning with] <s>k</s>
6.01.136 [The augment <s>aṬ</s>] even when separated by the <s>abhyāsa</s> (reduplicative syllable)
6.01.137 [<s>sam</s>], <s>pari</s>, and <s>upa</s> [precede the form <s>karot</s>] in the sense of ornamentation
6.01.138 And also in the sense of union
6.01.139 [<s>upa</s> precedes the form] when [the meaning involves] effort, artificial [speech], or supplementation
6.01.140 [The prefix <s>sam</s>] before [the form <s>kirat</s>] in the sense of scattering
6.01.141 And [also] after <s>prati</s> in the sense of injuring
6.01.142 After <s>ap</s> with quadrupeds and birds in the sense of scratching
6.01.143 [The words] <s>kus</s>, <s>tumburū</s> [etc.] are a class name
6.01.144 [These words are used] non-reciprocally in the sense of continuity of action
6.01.145 [The word] <s>goṣpada</s> (cow's footprint) [is used] in the senses of frequented, unfrequented, and standard measure
6.01.146 [The word] <s>āspada</s> [is used] in the sense of a firm footing
6.01.147 [The word] <s>āścarya</s> [is used] in the sense of the impermanent
6.01.148 [The word] <s>avaskara</s> [is used] in the sense of ordure
6.01.149 [The word] <s>apaskara</s> [means] a part of a chariot
6.01.150 [The word] <s>viṣkira</s> [means] a bird, optionally
6.01.151 [The augment <s>suṬ</s>] after a short [vowel] before <s>candra</s> in the second member [of a compound] in a <s>mantra</s>
6.01.152 And [the form] <s>pratiṣkaśa</s> [is derived] from <s>kaś</s>
6.01.153 [The names] <s>Praskaṇva</s> and <s>Hariscandra</s> are sages
6.01.154 [The words] <s>maskara</s> and <s>maskaraṇa</s> [mean] a bamboo [staff] and a wandering ascetic respectively
6.01.155 [The words] <s>kāstīra</s> and <s>ajastuṇḍa</s> are city names
6.01.156 [The word] <s>kāraskaras</s> is a tree
6.01.157 And [the words] <s>pāraskara</s> and the rest [of this class] are proper names
6.01.158 A <s>pada</s> (word) is <s>anudātta</s> (unaccented) except for one [syllable]
6.01.159 The <s>GHaÑ</s> derived from [a root like] <s>karṣa</s> with an <s>āṬ</s>-like [form] is final-accented
6.01.160 And [so are the words] beginning with <s>uñcha</s> etc.
6.01.161 And [the accent of] the <s>anudātta</s> [compound member] where the <s>udātta</s> has been dropped
6.01.162 [The above rule applies] to the root
6.01.163 [And also] to a <s>CIT</s>-marked [suffix]
6.01.164 [And also] to a <s>taddhita</s> (secondary) suffix
6.01.165 [And also] to a <s>KIT</s>-marked [suffix]
6.01.166 [The <s>anudātta</s> rule applies] from <s>tisṛ</s> for the <s>Jas</s> [ending]
6.01.167 [And] from <s>catur</s> before <s>Śas</s>
6.01.168 In a monosyllabic [stem], <s>sU</s> [and] the third and following <s>vibhakti</s> (case endings) [are accented]
6.01.169 Optionally [the accent shifts to] the initial [vowel] of the second member of a compound with final accent, not in the <s>āmreḍita</s> [construction]
6.01.170 [The rule applies] to <s>añc</s> in the <s>chandas</s> when not in <s>sarvanāmasthāna</s> [case positions]
6.01.171 [The accent is on] <s>ūṬH</s> [of compounds] with <s>idam</s>, <s>pada</s>-initial [words], <s>ap</s>, the masculine, <s>rai</s>, and <s>dyu</s>
6.01.172 [The accent shifts] after a long [vowel] for <s>aṣṭan</s>
6.01.173 The <s>Śatu</s> [present participle suffix] without the <s>nuM</s> [nasal augment] [follows the accent rules for] <s>nadī</s>-type, <s>aC</s>-initial, and the like
6.01.174 The <s>yaṆ</s> [replacement] with <s>udātta</s> accent [occurs] after a <s>haL</s>-preceded [vowel]
6.01.175 Not for the <s>ūṄ</s> [suffix] or a verbal root
6.01.176 The suffix <s>matUP</s> [is accented] from a short [vowel] or from [a stem with] <s>nuṬ</s>
6.01.177 Optionally [the accent is] on the <s>n</s>
6.01.178 [The accent of <s>Ṅy</s>] variously in the <s>chandas</s>
6.01.179 [The accent is on the] initial <s>haL</s>-consonant from [the stems] <s>ṣaṣ</s>, <s>tri</s>, <s>catur</s>
6.01.180 [The accent is on] the penultimate [syllable] before <s>jhaL</s>
6.01.181 Optionally in ordinary speech
6.01.182 Not for [stems like] <s>go</s>, <s>śvan</s>, <s>sAU</s>, vowel <s>a</s>, <s>rāj</s>, <s>aṛ</s>, <s>kruṛ</s>, <s>kṛd</s>
6.01.183 [The accent is on] the <s>jhaL</s> consonant for <s>div</s>

6.04.021 [There is] elision after <s>rā</s>
6.04.022 [The rule is] not operative here up to [the rule about] <s>bha</s>
6.04.023 The <s>n</s> of <s>Śnā</s> is dropped

6.04.025 [The nasal is dropped] for <s>daṃś</s>, <s>sañj</s>, <s>svañj</s> before <s>Śap</s>
6.04.026 And also for <s>rañj</s>
6.04.027 And also before <s>GHaÑ</s> in the senses of state and instrument
6.04.028 [The form] <s>syad</s> [is used] in the sense of swift movement
6.04.029 [The forms] <s>avoda</s>, <s>edha</s>, <s>odman</s>, <s>praśratha</s>, <s>himaśratha</s> [are exceptional forms]
6.04.030 Not [so] for <s>añc</s> in the sense of reverence
6.04.031 [The nasal is dropped] before <s>Ktvā</s> for <s>skand</s> and <s>syand</s>
6.04.032 Optionally for [roots] ending in <s>ja</s> and [for] <s>naś</s>
6.04.033 And also for <s>bhañj</s> before <s>CiṆ</s>
6.04.034 [The vowel of] <s>śās</s> [is replaced by] <s>iṬ</s> before <s>aṄ</s> and <s>haL</s>
6.04.035 [The stem becomes] <s>śā</s> before <s>h</s>
6.04.036 [The suffix] <s>ja</s> [replaces the final consonant] of <s>hanti</s>
6.04.037 [The nasal is dropped] for <s>anudātta</s>-taught [roots] ending in <s>van</s>, <s>ati</s>, [and roots like] <s>tanoti</s> etc. before <s>jhaL</s> and <s>KṄIT</s>
6.04.038 Optionally before <s>LyaP</s>
6.04.039 Not before <s>KtiC</s>, and [the vowel becomes] long
6.04.040 [The nasal is dropped] for <s>gam</s> before <s>Kv</s>
6.04.041 [The augment] <s>āṬ</s> [is inserted] for the nasal of [the roots] <s>viṬ</s> and <s>van</s>
6.04.042 [The nasal is dropped] for <s>jan</s>, <s>san</s>, <s>khan</s> before <s>saN</s> and <s>jhaL</s>
6.04.043 Optionally before <s>ya</s>
6.04.044 [The nasal is dropped] for <s>tanoti</s> before <s>yaK</s>
6.04.045 Optionally [the nasal of] <s>san</s> is dropped before <s>KtiC</s>, and also [the <s>KtiC</s>-suffix may be] dropped
6.04.046 [The nasal is dropped] before an <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> (secondary) suffix
6.04.047 Optionally for <s>bhrasj</s>, the <s>ra</s> of the penultimate [is replaced] with <s>raM</s>
6.04.048 [The final <s>a</s>] of <s>aṬ</s> is dropped
6.04.049 [The <s>a</s> is dropped] for [a root ending in] <s>ya</s> before a <s>haL</s>-consonant [suffix]
6.04.050 Optionally [the <s>a</s> is dropped] for [the suffix] <s>Kya</s>
6.04.051 [The <s>a</s> is dropped] of <s>Ṇe</s> before a non-<s>iṬ</s> [suffix]
6.04.052 [There is] <s>iṬ</s> before <s>niṣṭhā</s>-[suffix] with <s>seṬ</s> [roots]
6.04.053 [The form] <s>janitā</s> [is used] in a <s>mantra</s>
6.04.054 [The form] <s>śamitā</s> [is used] in a sacrifice
6.04.055 [The <s>ay</s>-ending is replaced] before [suffixes like] <s>ām</s>, <s>anta</s>, <s>ālu</s>, <s>āyya</s>, <s>itnu</s>, <s>iṣṇu</s>
6.04.056 [The <s>a</s> of <s>ay</s> is dropped] before <s>LyaP</s> after a light [syllable]
6.04.057 Optionally [the <s>a</s> is dropped] for [the root] <s>āp</s>
6.04.058 [The vowel] is long in the <s>chandas</s> for <s>yu</s> and <s>plu</s>
6.04.059 [And also] for <s>kṣi</s>
6.04.060 [The nasal is dropped] before <s>niṣṭhā</s>-[suffix] when not in a <s>ṆyaṬ</s>-sense
6.04.061 Optionally [so] in the senses of cursing and misery
6.04.062 Before <s>sya</s>, <s>siC</s>, <s>sīyuṬ</s>, <s>tāsi</s> in the sense of state and action — in the teaching of <s>aC</s>-initial, <s>han</s>, <s>grahA</s>, <s>dṛś</s> — [the substitution is] like <s>CiṆ</s> and [the augment] <s>iṬ</s>
6.04.063 [The augment] <s>yuṬ</s> [is inserted] for <s>dīṄ</s> before a vowel-initial <s>KṄit</s> suffix
6.04.064 [The <s>āṬ</s>] is dropped and also [before] <s>iṬ</s>
6.04.065 [The form becomes] <s>īṬ</s> before <s>yaṬ</s>
6.04.066 [The long vowel or <s>ā</s>] [is replaced] before <s>haL</s> for [the roots] <s>GHU</s>, <s>mā</s>, <s>sthā</s>, <s>gā</s>, <s>pā</s>, <s>jahāti</s>
6.04.067 [The <s>ā</s> is replaced] by <s>e</s> before <s>lIṄ</s>
6.04.068 Optionally [so] for another [root] beginning with a consonant cluster
6.04.069 Not before <s>LyaP</s>
6.04.070 Optionally the <s>iṬ</s> [augment applies] for <s>mayate</s>
6.04.071 The augment <s>aṬ</s> before <s>lUṄ</s>, <s>lIṄ</s>, and <s>lṚṄ</s> [past tenses] carries <s>udātta</s> accent
6.04.072 The augment <s>āṬ</s> [is used] for <s>aC</s>-initial [roots]
6.04.073 [This] is also seen in the <s>chandas</s>
6.04.074 Not [so] when preceded by <s>māṄ</s>
6.04.075 Variously in the <s>chandas</s> even without <s>māṄ</s>
6.04.076 [The form] <s>ir</s> of <s>iray</s> [becomes] <s>re</s>
6.04.077 Before a vowel, <s>y</s> and <s>v</s> of <s>Śnu</s>, a root, and <s>bhrū</s> [become] <s>iyaṄ</s> and <s>unaṄ</s> [respectively]
6.04.078 [The rule applies] for the <s>abhyāsa</s> (reduplicative syllable) before a non-homogeneous [vowel]
6.04.079 [And also] in the feminine
6.04.080 Optionally [so] before <s>am</s> and <s>Śas</s>
6.04.081 [A <s>iṆ</s>-vowel is replaced by] <s>yaṆ</s> [semivowel]
6.04.082 [The rule applies] to [a final] <s>e</s> of a polysyllabic [stem] not preceded by a consonant cluster
6.04.083 [The rule applies] to [a final] <s>o</s> before <s>sUP</s> (nominal case ending)
6.04.084 And also [for] <s>varṣābhu</s>
6.04.085 Not for [the roots] <s>bhū</s>, <s>su</s>, <s>dhi</s>
6.04.086 [Both forms occur] in the <s>chandas</s>
6.04.087 [The rule applies] to <s>hu</s> and <s>Śnu</s> before a <s>sārvadhātuka</s> (general verbal) [suffix]
6.04.088 [The augment] <s>vuK</s> [is added] to <s>bhu</s> before <s>lUṄ</s> and <s>lIṬ</s>
6.04.089 [The vowel] <s>ūṬ</s> [replaces the penultimate] of <s>goha</s>
6.04.090 [The rule applies] to <s>doṣa</s> in the causative <s>Ṇau</s>
6.04.091 Optionally [so] in the sense of mental dispassion
6.04.092 [The vowel is] short for <s>MIT</s>-marked [suffixes]
6.04.093 [The vowel is] long before <s>CiṆ</s> and <s>ṆamuL</s>, optionally
6.04.094 [The vowel is] short before <s>KHaC</s>
6.04.095 [The rule applies] to <s>hlāda</s> before <s>niṣṭhā</s>
6.04.096 [The rule applies] to [the root] <s>chad</s> before <s>GHa</s> when not doubly prefixed
6.04.097 And also before <s>is</s>, <s>mantran</s>, <s>Kvi</s>
6.04.098 [The final of] <s>gam</s>, <s>han</s>, <s>jan</s>, <s>khan</s>, <s>ghas</s> is dropped before <s>KṄIT</s> and not before <s>aṄ</s>
6.04.099 [The rule applies] to <s>tani</s> and <s>pati</s> in the <s>chandas</s>
6.04.100 And also for <s>ghasi</s> and <s>bhas</s> before a <s>haL</s>-consonant
6.04.101 [The imperative ending <s>hi</s>] is replaced by <s>dhi</s> after <s>hu</s> and <s>jhaL</s>-ending [roots]
6.04.102 [And also for the roots] <s>śru</s>, <s>śṛ</s>, <s>ṇu</s>, <s>pṝ</s>, <s>kṛ</s>, <s>vṛ</s> in the <s>chandas</s>
6.04.103 And also for non-<s>ṄIT</s> [roots]
6.04.104 [The suffix <s>CiṆ</s>] undergoes <s>luK</s> (deletion)
6.04.105 [The rule applies] to <s>aṬ</s>-initial [forms] before the imperative <s>hi</s>
6.04.106 And also from <s>uṬ</s> before a suffix not preceded by a consonant cluster
6.04.107 And optionally the [<s>hi</s>] is dropped for [roots ending in] <s>m</s> and <s>v</s>
6.04.108 Always [so] for <s>karoti</s>
6.04.109 And also before <s>ye</s>
6.04.110 [After] <s>aṬ</s>, [the vowel becomes] <s>uṬ</s> before a <s>sārvadhātuka</s> [suffix]
6.04.111 The <s>aṬ</s> of <s>Śna</s> and [the root] <s>as</s> is dropped
6.04.112 [The <s>āṬ</s>] of <s>Śnā</s> and the <s>abhyasta</s> (reduplicated form) [is dropped]
6.04.113 [The ending is replaced by] <s>ī</s> before a <s>haL</s> consonant, not before <s>GHO</s>
6.04.114 [The augment] <s>iṬ</s> [is added] to <s>daridra</s>
6.04.115 Optionally [so] for <s>bhi</s>
6.04.116 And also for <s>jahāti</s>
6.04.117 And [the ending is replaced] by <s>ā</s> before <s>h</s>
6.04.118 [The ending is] dropped before <s>y</s>
6.04.119 [Before the imperative ending <s>hi</s>], for <s>GHU</s> and <s>as</s> — [the ending becomes] <s>eṬ</s> [and] the <s>abhyāsa</s> is dropped
6.04.120 [The <s>abhyāsa</s> is dropped] for a single-consonant medial [stem] not beginning with a substitute, in the <s>lIṬ</s> (perfect) after <s>aṬ</s>
6.04.121 And also in <s>thaL</s> with a <s>seṭ</s> [root]
6.04.122 And also [the rule applies] to <s>tṝ</s>, <s>phal</s>, <s>bhaj</s>, <s>trap</s>
6.04.123 [And also to] <s>rādha</s> in the sense of injuring
6.04.124 Optionally [so] for <s>jṝ</s>, <s>bhram</s>, <s>tras</s>
6.04.125 And also for the seven [forms of] <s>phaṇ</s>
6.04.126 Not for [stems like] <s>śas</s>, <s>dadA</s> [that begin with] <s>ādi</s> [vowels] [that are subject to] <s>guṇa</s>
6.04.127 [The stem] <s>arvaṇas</s> [takes the form] <s>tṚ</s> except before <s>sAU</s> and without a <s>naÑ</s>
6.04.128 [The stem] <s>maghavā</s> variously
6.04.129 [The rules in this section apply to] the <s>BHA</s>-[designation of the stem]
6.04.130 [The stem] <s>pāda</s> [becomes] <s>pad</s>
6.04.131 [The vowel of] <s>vasu</s> undergoes <s>samprasāraṇa</s>
6.04.132 [The stem] <s>vāha</s> [takes the form] <s>ūṬH</s>
6.04.133 [The final <s>n</s> is dropped] for <s>śvan</s>, <s>yuvan</s>, <s>maghon</s> before a non-<s>taddhita</s> suffix
6.04.134 [The <s>na</s>] of the <s>aṬlupa</s>-[suffix] is dropped
6.04.135 [The rule applies] to <s>ṣa</s>-preceded [roots], <s>han</s>, <s>dhṛ</s>, <s>ta</s>, <s>rājñ</s> before <s>aṆ</s>
6.04.136 Optionally [so] before <s>Ṅi</s> and <s>Śy</s>
6.04.137 Not [so] after a consonant cluster ending in <s>va</s>, <s>ma</s>
6.04.138 [The rule applies] to a vowel [final stem]
6.04.139 [The vowel <s>ud</s>] takes <s>īṬ</s>
6.04.140 [The <s>āṬ</s>] of a root [is dropped]
6.04.141 In <s>mantras</s>, before <s>āṄ</s>, the initial of [the word] <s>ātman</s> [is affected]
6.04.142 [The form] <s>ti</s> [replaces <s>viṃśati</s>] before a <s>ḌIT</s>-marked [suffix]
6.04.143 [And also for] <s>ṬE</s>-ending [stems]
6.04.144 [The final <s>n</s> is dropped] before a <s>taddhita</s> suffix
6.04.145 [The rule applies] only before <s>Ṭa</s> and <s>kha</s> for <s>ahan</s>
6.04.146 [The vowel] <s>o</s> [undergoes] <s>guṇa</s>
6.04.147 [The <s>dh</s>] is dropped before <s>ḍh</s>, except for <s>kadrū</s>
6.04.148 And [the <s>ya</s>] takes <s>īṬ</s>
6.04.149 [The <s>y</s>] of the penultimate [is dropped] for [the words] <s>Sūrya</s>, <s>Tiṣya</s>, <s>Agastya</s>, <s>matsya</s>
6.04.150 [The rule applies] to the consonant of a <s>taddhita</s> suffix
6.04.151 And also for [the suffix] <s>āpatya</s> before a <s>taddhita</s> not beginning with <s>āṬ</s>
6.04.152 And also [before] <s>Kya</s> and <s>Cvy</s>
6.04.153 [The <s>cha</s> suffix undergoes] <s>luK</s> (deletion) from [stems like] <s>bilvaka</s> etc.
6.04.154 [The final] <s>tu</s> [is replaced] before <s>iṣṭhaN</s>, <s>imaniC</s>, and <s>īyas</s>
6.04.155 [And also] for <s>ṬE</s>-ending [stems]
6.04.156 For [the adjectives] <s>sthūla</s>, <s>dūra</s>, <s>yuvan</s>, <s>hrasva</s>, <s>kṣipra</s>, <s>kṣudra</s> — the <s>yaṆ</s>-initial [substitute] is used as the prior member and the preceding [vowel undergoes] <s>guṇa</s>
6.04.157 For [the adjectives] <s>priya</s>, <s>sthira</s>, <s>sphira</s>, <s>uru</s>, <s>bahu</s>, <s>la</s>, <s>guru</s>, <s>vṛddha</s>, <s>tṛpra</s>, <s>dīrgha</s>, <s>vṛndāraka</s> — the [respective substitutes are] <s>prastha</s>, <s>spha</s>, <s>var</s>, <s>baṃhi</s>, <s>gar</s>, <s>varṣi</s>, <s>trap</s>, <s>drāghi</s>, <s>vṛndā</s>
6.04.158 [The final of] <s>bahu</s> is dropped; and [the form] <s>bhū</s> also [replaces] <s>bahu</s>
6.04.159 And [before] <s>iṣṭha</s>, [the augment] <s>yiṬ</s>
6.04.160 [The form] <s>jyāt</s> [is derived] from <s>āt</s> of <s>īyas</s>
6.04.161 [The <s>ra</s> substitute replaces] <s>ṛT</s>-final [stems] that begin with a consonant and are light
6.04.162 Optionally [so] for <s>ṛju</s> in the <s>chandas</s>
6.04.163 [The rule does not apply to] a monosyllabic [stem] naturally
6.04.164 [The suffix] <s>in</s> [is retained] before <s>aṆ</s> when not in the sense of offspring
6.04.165 And also [for the stems] <s>gāthin</s>, <s>vidathin</s>, <s>keśin</s>, <s>gaṇin</s>, <s>paṇin</s>
6.04.166 And also [for] a [stem] beginning with a consonant cluster
6.04.167 [The suffix retained is] <s>an</s>
6.04.168 And also [before] <s>ya</s> not in the senses of state or action
6.04.169 [The stems] <s>ātman</s> and <s>adhvān</s> [undergo the rule] before <s>kha</s>
6.04.170 Not [so] when preceded by <s>ma</s>, in the sense of offspring, and not for <s>varman</s>
6.04.171 [The word <s>brāhma</s>] is [used] not in the sense of class
6.04.172 [The word <s>kārma</s>] is [used] in the sense of habitual nature
6.04.173 [The word <s>aukṣa</s>] is [used] not in the sense of offspring
6.04.174 [The forms] <s>Dāṇḍināyana</s>, <s>Hāstināyana</s>, <s>Ātharvaṇika</s>, <s>Jaihmāśineya</s>, <s>Vāsineya</s>, <s>nibhrauṇahatya</s>, <s>Dhaivat</s>, <s>ya</s>, <s>Sārava</s>, <s>Aikṣvāka</s>, <s>Maitreya</s>, <s>Hiraṇmaya</s> [are exceptional forms]
6.04.175 [The forms] <s>ṛtvya</s>, <s>vāstvya</s>, <s>vāstava</s>, <s>mādhvī</s>, <s>hiraṇyāya</s> [are exceptional forms found] in the <s>chandas</s>

7.04.092 And of <s>ṛṬ</s>

7.04.096 Optionally of <s>veṣṭi</s> and <s>ceṣṭi</s>
7.04.097 And <s>ī</s> [is substituted for the reduplication], being the whole group

body.translated_text:
8.01.001 Of the whole [expression], two [utterances form a repetition]
8.01.002 The second [utterance] of that [repetition] is [called] <s>āmreḍita</s> (iterative/reduplicated)
8.01.003 And [the āmreḍita is] <s>anudātta</s> (unaccented)
8.01.004 In [the senses of] constancy (<s>nitya</s>) and distribution (<s>vīpsā</s>)
8.01.005 [The prefix] <s>pari</s> [is āmreḍita when meaning] exclusion (<s>varjana</s>)
8.01.006 <s>pra</s>, <s>sam</s>, <s>upa</s>, and <s>ud</s> [are āmreḍita when used for] metrical completion (<s>pāda-pūraṇa</s>)
8.01.007 <s>upari</s> (above), <s>adhi</s> (upon), and <s>adhas</s> (below) [are āmreḍita when meaning] proximity (<s>sāmīpya</s>)
8.01.008 The vocative (<s>āmantrita</s>) [is āmreḍita] at the beginning of a sentence, in [the senses of] displeasure (<s>asūyā</s>), agreement (<s>sammati</s>), anger (<s>kopa</s>), contempt (<s>kutsana</s>), and reproof (<s>bhartsana</s>)
8.01.009 [The āmreḍita is treated as] a single [word], like a <s>bahuvrīhi</s> [compound]
8.01.010 And in insistence (<s>ābādha</s>)
8.01.011 Like a <s>karmadhāraya</s> [compound] in the subsequent [uses]
8.01.012 In [the sense of] manner (<s>prakāra</s>), for a word denoting quality (<s>guṇa-vacana</s>)
8.01.013 Without difficulty, for [words meaning] pleasant (<s>priya</s>) and comfortable (<s>sukha</s>), optionally
8.01.014 [The word] <s>yathā-sva</s> (each in their own way) [is treated as] <s>yathā-yatha</s>
8.01.015 A <s>dvandva</s> (copulative compound) [is formed by āmreḍita] in [the senses of] secrecy (<s>rahasya</s>), boundary (<s>maryādā</s>), absence (<s>acana</s>), transgression (<s>vyutkramaṇa</s>), sacrificial implements (<s>yajña-pātra</s>), combination (<s>rayoga</s>), and manifestation (<s>abhivyakti</s>)
8.01.016 Of a <s>pada</s> (word) [the following rules apply]
8.01.017 After a <s>pada</s> [the following operations take place]
8.01.018 Everything [following a non-initial position] in a non-<s>pada</s> [is] <s>anudātta</s> (unaccented)
8.01.019 And of the vocative (<s>āmantrita</s>)
8.01.020 For <s>yuṣmad</s> (you) and <s>asmad</s> (I/we), in the genitive, dative, and accusative [positions], [the substitutes are] <s>vām</s> and <s>nau</s>
8.01.021 In the plural, <s>vas</s> and <s>nas</s>
8.01.022 <s>te</s> and <s>me</s> [are substitutes] for the singular
8.01.023 <s>tvā</s> and <s>mā</s> [are substitutes] for the accusative
8.01.024 Not when joined with <s>ca</s>, <s>vā</s>, <s>ha</s>, <s>aha</s>, or <s>eva</s>
8.01.025 And with words meaning 'to see' (<s>paśya</s>), when not [indicating] looking
8.01.026 Optionally for the nominative preceded by <s>sa</s>
8.01.027 <s>gotra</s> (clan name) and similar [words replace] verbal endings (<s>tiṄ</s>) in [senses of] contempt (<s>kutsana</s>) and repetition (<s>ābhīkṣṇya</s>)
8.01.028 A verbal ending (<s>tiṄ</s>) [replaces the form] of a non-verbal ending
8.01.029 Not <s>lUṬ</s> (periphrastic future)
8.01.030 [Reduplication is] joined with the particles (<s>nipāta</s>) <s>yad</s>, <s>yadi</s>, <s>hanta</s>, <s>kuvid</s>, <s>ned</s>, <s>ced</s>, <s>caṆ</s>, <s>kaccid</s>, and <s>yatra</s>
8.01.031 <s>naha</s> [is used] in reproach (<s>pratyārambha</s>)
8.01.032 <s>satya</s> (truly) [is used] in a question (<s>praśna</s>)
8.01.033 <s>aṅga</s> (O!) [is used] when not [in] reverse [order]
8.01.034 And <s>hi</s> (indeed)
8.01.035 In Vedic [usage] (<s>chandas</s>), even more than one [word may be joined], when there is syntactic expectancy (<s>ākāṅkṣā</s>)
8.01.036 [Also] with <s>yāvat</s> (as long as) and <s>yathā</s> (as)
8.01.037 In [expression of] respect (<s>pūjā</s>), not [when] immediately adjacent
8.01.038 And when separated from the verbal prefix (<s>upasarga</s>)
8.01.039 With <s>tu</s>, <s>paśya</s> (look!), <s>paśyata</s> (look all!), and <s>aha</s> [interjections] in [expressions of] respect
8.01.040 And <s>aho</s> (ah!)
8.01.041 In the remaining [cases], optionally (<s>vibhāṣā</s>)
8.01.042 And <s>purā</s> (before) in [the sense of] desire to obtain (<s>parīpsā</s>)
8.01.043 <s>nanu</s> (is it not?) and <s>iti</s> in [expressions of] permission and request (<s>anujñā-eṣaṇā</s>)
8.01.044 <s>kim</s> (what?) in a question about an action (<s>kriyā-praśna</s>), without a prefix, and not prohibited
8.01.045 In elision (<s>lopa</s>), optionally
8.01.046 <s>ehi</s> (come!) and <s>manye</s> (I think) [take] <s>lṚṬ</s> (conditional) in jest (<s>prahāsa</s>)
8.01.047 <s>jātu</s> (ever) [is used] for something unprecedented (<s>apūrva</s>)
8.01.048 <s>kim-vṛttam</s> (what happened?) is also [joined with] <s>cid</s> following
8.01.049 <s>āho</s> and <s>utāho</s> (or?) [are used] when immediately adjacent
8.01.050 In the remaining [cases], optionally
8.01.051 [A verb of] motion (<s>gati-artha</s>) [in] the imperative (<s>lOṬ</s>) [takes] <s>lṚṬ</s> (conditional) when the <s>kāraka</s> (case relation) is entirely different
8.01.052 And <s>lOṬ</s> (imperative) also [in this context]
8.01.053 [The rule applies] optionally when with a prefix (<s>sa-upasarga</s>) and not in the first person (<s>an-uttama</s>)
8.01.054 And [with] <s>hanta</s> (come on!)
8.01.055 Every other vocative (<s>āmantrita</s>) [is placed] after <s>ām</s>, when not nearby
8.01.056 [A word followed by] <s>yad</s>, <s>hi</s>, or <s>tu</s> [is repeated] in Vedic [usage]
8.01.057 In [constructions with] <s>cana</s>, <s>cid</s>, <s>iva</s>, <s>gotra</s> (clan) and other <s>taddhita</s> [suffixes], and <s>āmreḍita</s> (iterative), not [for the root] <s>gati</s> (to go)
8.01.058 And in [words beginning with] <s>ca</s> and others [in the list]
8.01.059 The nominative (first case ending) [is used] in conjunction with <s>ca</s> and <s>vā</s>
8.01.060 <s>ha</s> [is used with] <s>iti</s> in [expressions of] annihilation (<s>kṣiyā</s>)
8.01.061 <s>aha</s> [is used with] <s>iti</s> in assignment (<s>viniyoga</s>) also
8.01.062 When <s>ca</s> and <s>aha</s> are elided, <s>eva</s> [is used for] emphasis (<s>avadhāraṇa</s>)
8.01.063 When <s>ca</s> and other [particles] are elided, optionally
8.01.064 <s>vai</s> and <s>vāva</s> [replace <s>ca</s>] in Vedic [usage]
8.01.065 [A construction] with <s>eka</s> (one) and <s>anyā</s> (another) when both are meaningfully connected
8.01.066 From [an expression of] conduct (<s>yad-vṛtta</s>), invariably
8.01.067 [A word] honored (<s>pūjita</s>) by [a word of] respect (<s>pūjana</s>) becomes <s>anudātta</s> (unaccented), [starting] from the <s>kāṣṭha</s> [list] and others
8.01.068 [A word functioning as] <s>gati</s> (verbal complement) also [governs] a verbal ending (<s>tiṄ</s>)
8.01.069 In contempt (<s>kutsana</s>), also before a <s>sUP</s> (case ending), not [for words denoting] clan (<s>gotra</s>)
8.01.070 <s>gati</s> (verbal complement) [applies] in [the sense of] going (<s>gatu</s>)
8.01.071 And before a verbal ending (<s>tiṄ</s>) that has <s>udātta</s> (accent)
8.01.072 The vocative (<s>āmantrita</s>) [placed] first [is treated as] if not present (<s>avidyamānavat</s>)
8.01.073 Not when the vocative has a co-referential [word denoting] a general term
8.01.074 [A general term is] optionally [treated as vocative] when [followed by] a specific term in the plural
8.02.001 [A rule in this section is treated as] not having taken effect with respect to a prior [rule] (<s>pūrvatrāsiddha</s>)
8.02.002 Elision of <s>n</s> [does not occur] before <s>sUP</s> (case endings), accent (<s>svara</s>), technical term (<s>saṃjñā</s>), <s>tuK</s> augment, and <s>idhi</s> in a <s>kṛt</s> (primary derivative) [suffix]
8.02.003 Not [the elision] of <s>m</s> before <s>n</s>
8.02.004 [A substitute for] <s>yaṆ</s> (semivowels) between <s>udātta</s> and <s>svarita</s> [vowels] becomes <s>svarita</s> when [followed by] <s>anudātta</s>
8.02.005 A single substitute [for two vowels, one of which is] <s>udātta</s>, is [itself] <s>udātta</s>
8.02.006 [The substitute is] optionally <s>svarita</s> when [followed by] <s>anudātta</s> at the beginning of a <s>pada</s> (word)
8.02.007 Elision of [final] <s>n</s> of a <s>prātipadika</s> (nominal stem)
8.02.008 Not before <s>Ṅi</s> (locative singular) and <s>sambuddhi</s> (vocative singular)
8.02.009 The [final consonant] of <s>māt</s>, <s>padhā</s> [is replaced by] <s>v</s> before <s>matOr</s>, except [in forms from] <s>ayava</s> and others
8.02.010 [Also] of [stems ending in] <s>jhaY</s> (voiced non-nasal stops)
8.02.011 In proper names (<s>saṃjñā</s>)
8.02.012 Like <s>āsandī</s>, <s>aṣṭhī</s>, <s>cakrī</s>, <s>kakṣī</s>, <s>rumaṇvat</s>, and <s>carmaṇvatī</s>
8.02.013 <s>udanvān</s> [is formed] in [reference to] the ocean (<s>udadhi</s>) also
8.02.014 <s>rājanvān</s> [is formed when meaning] good governance (<s>saurājya</s>)
8.02.015 In Vedic [usage], [the substitute] <s>ir</s>
8.02.016 [The augment] <s>nuṬ</s> [is added after the stem] <s>an</s>
8.02.017 [The final] <s>n</s> of <s>GHA</s> [suffix is replaced]
8.02.018 [The] <s>r</s> of [the root] <s>kṛp</s> (to be fit) [is replaced by] <s>l</s>
8.02.019 [The final vowel] of a prefix (<s>upasarga</s>) [is replaced] before <s>ay</s> and <s>at</s>
8.02.020 [The <s>r</s>] of [the root] <s>gṝ</s> (to swallow) [is replaced] before <s>yaṄ</s> (semivowels)
8.02.021 Optionally before a vowel (<s>aC</s>)
8.02.022 And of <s>pari</s> before <s>gha</s> and <s>ṛka</s>
8.02.023 The final [consonant] of a consonant cluster (<s>saṃyoga</s>) is elided
8.02.024 [The] <s>s</s> [is elided] after <s>r</s>
8.02.025 And before <s>dhi</s>
8.02.026 [A consonant of] <s>jhaL</s> [is elided] before [another] <s>jhaL</s> [consonant]
8.02.027 After a short [vowel] before a stem (<s>aṅga</s>)
8.02.028 [The augment] <s>iṬ</s> [becomes] <s>īṬ</s> (lengthened) in the plural
8.02.029 [The elision applies to] <s>s</s> and <s>k</s> at the beginning and end of a consonant cluster
8.02.030 [The] <s>c</s> [of a root] is replaced by <s>k</s>
8.02.031 [The final] <s>h</s> [is replaced by] <s>ḍh</s>
8.02.032 [A root beginning with] <s>d</s> [has its final replaced by] <s>gh</s>
8.02.033 Optionally for [the roots] <s>druh</s> (to be hostile), <s>muh</s> (to be confused), <s>ṣṇuh</s> (to vomit), and <s>ṣṇih</s> (to be affectionate)
8.02.034 [The final of the root] <s>nah</s> (to bind) [is replaced by] <s>dh</s>
8.02.035 [The final of the root] <s>āh</s> (to say) [is replaced by] <s>th</s>
8.02.036 [The finals of the roots] <s>vraśc</s> (to cut), <s>bhrasj</s> (to fry), <s>sṛj</s> (to create), <s>mṛj</s> (to wipe), <s>yaj</s> (to sacrifice), <s>rāj</s> (to shine), and <s>bhrāj</s> (to gleam) and [words ending in] <s>ś</s> [are replaced by] <s>ṣ</s>
8.02.037 [The final of] a single-vowel [root ending in] <s>baŚ</s> [is replaced by] <s>bhaṢ</s> when the root ends in <s>jhaṢ</s>, before <s>s</s> and <s>dhv</s>
8.02.038 And [the root] <s>dadh</s> (to place, reduplicated form) before <s>ta</s> and <s>th</s>
8.02.039 [The sounds of] <s>jhaL</s> [are replaced by] <s>jaŚ</s> at the end [of a word]
8.02.040 [The sounds of] <s>jhaṢ</s> before <s>ta</s> and <s>th</s> [are replaced by] <s>dh</s>, and <s>dh</s> [replaces the following consonant]
8.02.041 [The sounds] <s>ṣ</s> and <s>ḍh</s> [are replaced by] <s>k</s> before <s>s</s>
8.02.042 After [the roots] <s>rad</s> (to dig) and <s>dā</s> (to give), the <s>t</s> of <s>niṣṭhā</s> (past participle) [is replaced by] <s>n</s>; but the preceding <s>d</s> [is also replaced]
